row.short_description: A VR 3D Image Viewer.

row.name: The New Sheriff
row.detailed_description: A new sheriff, with memory problems, has arrived in town, robberies and silence are rampant; Hunt down the bandits, find their leader, protect the citizens. As the new sheriff you will have to patrol the city, find the wanted people and eliminate them, foil robberies, challenge the bosses to a duel. You can arm yourself at the emporium, receive expert care from the doctor, visit the saloon, play cards at the table with the cheaters and much more. The New Sheriff is a bullet hell western game with roguelike elements, all seasoned with a pinch of luck... Features Procedurally created city maps Procedurally created wanted faces Over 10 enemies' type with very nice AI Over 10 NPCs to interact with Different types of guns Various items, special places and surprises 1 minigame in the lounge
row.short_description: A shooter where you won't have to shoot everything, presented in black and white like classic westerns.

row.name: Drop It: Block Paradise! Builder Edition
row.detailed_description: Gameplay Objective: Get the Star safely to the Ground Click on other Blocks to remove them or interact with them Let Gravity and Physics do its work Success! Level Editor & Online Levels: Multiple Level Sizes and Visual Styles Various fun Game Mechanics (Hazards, Bombs, Moving Platforms, Portals & More) Make fun, creative and exciting levels Upload and Share your level with others online Play levels made by others! Features: 100 Starter Levels to play - Giving you chance to learn the mechanics and have some fun. 50 of them will be remixed from the original game with 50 brand new ones made for Builder Edition. 50 Bonus Levels - Even more free levels to enjoy Level Editor: Create and share your own unique levels with friends Block Database: Play more levels online from around the world from strangers and friends Can be played locally with friend with 2 controllers for puzzle co-op solving Leaderboards Achievements Cloud Saves - Sync up your levels across devices as well as with the Main Version Want More? Check Out The Full Game! Enjoyed making custom Levels or playing the Online Levels and want more? Check out the full game (Drop It: Block Paradise!) to unlock the Arcade Mode & Full Bonus Mode to gain 200+ more levels, a fun Versus Mode and more Achievements and unlocks. Your custom levels you made will be synced between both games so you can pick back up where you started!
row.short_description: Builder Edition is all about using various physic game mechanics, like gravity, bouncy blocks, bombs and more to safely get the Stars to the ground floor to solve Physics-based Puzzle levels. Play the 150+ included levels and then try your hand at making your own and sharing them with the community!

row.name: redroom
row.detailed_description: redroom is a fast-paced one-versus-one fighting game where a single hit means death. Maneuver around your opponent using dashes, slams, and wall jumps in order to hit them before they can hit you. Use snappy movement abilities to outmaneuver your opponent. Duel on over 30 different procedural map arrangements. Play a variable amount of rounds or until one person gets too far ahead. Join your friends or play with randoms through an integrated server finder. Use the Menu Console to completely customize your experience. Recolor absolutely everything. Note: Some users may find the menus difficult to use as they rely on a command-line format.
row.short_description: A fast-paced one-versus-one FPS where a single hit means instant death. Destroy opponents in seconds, dashing around tightly-constructed arenas with an ultra-powerful shotgun. Configure *everything* in an extensive in-game console menu. There are two colors - alive and red.

row.name: Thing & Fist
row.detailed_description: Thing & Fist is an isometric couch co-op brawler where two players battle their way through the city of St. Avalon as they work to pull off the heist of the century. St. Avalon is a shady city that is home to gangsterism and sorcery in equal measure, and players will need to work together if they hope to stand a chance against the nefarious baddies that lurk around every corner. As Thing, players can zap enemies from a distance using powerful bolts of lightning while keeping the hordes of goons guessing by swiftly dashing around, behind, and even through them! For those that prefer a more direct approach to trouncing foes, playing as Fist will allow players to make short work of opponents with powerful punches and a dash attack that bulldozes anything in their way. When the throngs of opponents seem like too much to handle, players can stun crowds of enemies with a powerful slam as Fist or conjure a convenient bribe as Thing to direct their attention elsewhere. Players can also support their partner in crime with their character's unique shield ability to ensure that Thing & Fist will be able to pull through each chaotic brawl they find themselves in on their quest to become filthy rich! As they make their way through the two unique levels of the game, players will find themselves going up against numerous different enemies including slime cops, gunslingers, walking cauldrons, and shadow hands; each of which has their own methods of attack that players will need to work together to outmaneuver. Starting in downtown St. Avalon, players will make their way through the city streets, break in and out of the bank, and scurry towards the escape raft with the cash!
row.short_description: Team up with a friend and play as either the artful wizard Thing or the stalwart golem Fist to pull off the heist of the century in this couch co-op top-down brawler!

row.name: Giresun
row.detailed_description: This is a 3rd person shooter game created with Unreal Engine 5 There is Elimination mode and Control mode in game that you can play 1v1, 2v2, 4v4, 5v5 versions. In Elimination mode, you are defeating enemy and when a team reach enough points, wins. In Control mode, there will be 3 areas, you can capture an area and defend it. If you control 2 or more areas, you will start to collect points and when a team reach enough points, wins. This is not an online multiplayer game. You are playing against bots. It is a free game and there is no marketplace in it. In 2024 we are planning to add new maps like Giresun Island and Giresun Castle and much more maps with new mods. Have Fun !
row.short_description: This is a 3rd person shooter game that you can play 1v1, 2v2, 4v4, 5v5 mods against bots.

row.name: Dreadrun
row.detailed_description: In DreadRun, the game kicks off with the Exploration Phase, where you explore the island , gathering valuable items to gear up for what’s ahead. This phase sets the stage for the Payload Phase, the bullet hell action of the game, where you face a fast-paced, action-packed challenge, navigating through a horde of bullets, while trying to escort a payload till the end, to emerge victorious. In the Exploration Phase of DreadRun, your goal is to quickly gather a variety of potions, superior weapon, and upgrades before time runs out. Your adventure leads you through numerous randomly located rooms on a vast island, with each session presenting new rooms and loot. The upgrades you come across are random each time, making every game a distinct and exciting challenge. Utilize every second as efficiently as possible so that you will be prepared for what's ahead After gearing up in the Exploration Phase, the Payload Phase of DreadRun is where the intense bullet hell action unfolds. In this phase, you’re challenged with fighting off a swarm of enemies and simultaneously escorting the payload to its end goal. As you advance, you’ll encounter various enemy types that will try to block your path and make your mission tougher. It’s a thrilling test of your combat skills and strategy as you push through to the end. The Team This game is a college project made in less than 3 months by a team of passionate 6 developers, Avinash Prabhu, Somno, Hassan Abusalih, Dev Trivedi, Armaan Takyar and Armaan Sheikh
row.short_description: DreadRun is a top-down bullet hell with roguelike elements. Where you must explore and gather various forms of loot  such as guns, potions, and perks in a limited period of time in order to evade and shoot  hordes of various enemies  while escorting a payload to safety.

row.name: Crimson Echoes
row.detailed_description: Synopsis 음악을 좋아하는 14살 소녀 아리아. 그녀는 피아노 레슨을 받기 위해 자신의 롤 모델이자 당대 최고의 음악가인 삼촌, 마틴의 저택에 방문한다. 삼촌과 재회하여 레슨 삼매경에 빠진 아리아, 봄기운에 졸음이 몰려와 한숨 자고 일어났더니... 삼촌의 모습이 온데간데없다! 삼촌을 찾으며 저택을 탐험하는 과정에서 숨겨진 비밀을 알게 된 아리아. 그녀는 과연 어떤 결정을 내릴 것인가...! About The Game Crimson Echoes는 공포 쯔꾸르 게임입니다. 다양한 퍼즐들을 해결하고 다양한 함정들을 피하며 아리아의 조력자들과 함께 그녀가 무사히 삼촌을 찾을 수 있도록 이끌어 주세요!
row.short_description: Crimson Echoes is a horror themed puzzle-adventure game. By solving various riddles and avoiding deadly traps, help Aria and her companions find her Uncle.

row.name: Cursedville
row.detailed_description: Cursedville is a party game that can be played between 4-10 people with two roles. Try to co-operate with other players with positional voice chat. Werewolves hunt peasants at night, while peasants try to survive the night and collect gold. The werewolf is the villain of the game. The werewolf can transform into wolf form at any time during the night. The werewolf's goal is to hunt down all the villagers before the blood moon ends. The peasants are the innocent role of the game. Peasants must try to survive until the bloody moon ends. They can earn gold by killing monsters that appear on the map at night. With gold they can buy new and more powerful items from merchants in the morning and fight against werewolves. Features Day Cycle: The game has 3 day states, each with different features Night: Werewolves can transform. Creatures appear in their territory. Morning: Werewolves can't leave human form. Merchants are activated. Creatures do not spawn. Bloody Moon: Werewolf can't leave wolf form. Creatures do not spawn. Creatures: There are two types of creatures in the game. These creatures can harm peasants. Gold or items can be earned by killing creatures. It has a spawn and attack area depending on the creature type. Skeleton: Drops a small amount of gold. Deals a small amount of damage. Does not drop items. Golem: Drops a good amount of gold. Deals a large amount of damage and throws the player he hit. It drops the lightning potion, the most powerful potion in the game. Lightning potion can only be obtained this way. Merchants: Weapons and potions can be purchased from merchants using gold. Merchants are only open in the morning. These items have various properties and tactics can be created with different combinations.
row.short_description: A party game for 4-10 players. Play as a peasant or werewolf, cooperate with your friends and survive or hunt before all the nights are over.

row.name: Kingdom of Fallen: The Last Stand Playtest
Deepest World
row.detailed_description: Deepest World is a coding sandbox MMORPG where you can write your character's AI with JavaScript. Explore a 3D open world, hunt monsters, gather resources, craft deep builds and items, acquire programming skills, grind 24/7. The main goal is to program a bot that plays the game for you. To do so, we provide you with a client-side web API which exposes data objects that represent your surroundings, API call functions to communicate with the server, and some utility functions. Early Access The game is still in the relatively early stages of development, and many features are being designed, implemented, and tested. As such, you may encounter bugs, unfinished content, or changes to gameplay mechanics. Your feedback and bug reports are always welcome and greatly appreciated. Thank you for your understanding and support as the game continues to be improved. Feature Overview Scripting with Deepest World JavaScript API A non-instanced procedurally generated 3D open world A single server that can support hundreds of concurrent players Procedurally generated skills and gear Single and group PVE Crafting, farming and gathering professions Uncapped levels Missions
row.short_description: Deepest World is a coding sandbox MMORPG where you can automate your character with JavaScript. Explore a 3D open world, hunt monsters, gather resources, craft deep builds and items, acquire programming skills, grind 24/7.

row.name: Cat Purrtrol: Find All 100!
row.detailed_description: Cat Purrtrol: Find All 100! Welcome to my completely free Point-&-Click where you find 100 cats hidden in a drawing! I have been blessed to work with my three voice actors: Butterscotch (Butters), Wolfenstein (Wolfy), and Solaire (Sol)! All drawings and music are created by me. I hope you enjoy my game and I appreciate you for checking it out :) 🕹️ One Level 🎨 Original Artwork 🎹 Original Soundtrack 🏆 Achievements
row.short_description: Cat Purrtrol: Find All 100! is a relaxing, short game where you find 100 cats hidden in a drawing. It is completely free to play and is a fun quick game to spend a few minutes on!

row.name: Fox Fairy Saga · Nine Nights Playtest
Hidden Among Thieves
row.detailed_description: The game is free to play with no in-app purchases. It is a social multiplayer shooter/strategy game, but can be played offline. It can be played with a gamepad or keyboard . keyboard: Space bar to use gun, mouse to aim & shoot. AWSD or arrows to move. mouse: Touch gun or player for gun. Touch arrows to move. gamepad: - (a) for gun. analog stick to move. (x) or (y) for items. The main objective is to gather more loot than other players while avoiding detection. GREED and RAGE may get you more loot but make you stand out. CAUTION and STRATEGY will help you defeat your opponents. Each round becomes progressively longer and unveils more tantalizing secrets to help you gain an edge over opponents. Your actions dictate your worth to other players. Try to find all the different colored diamonds.
row.short_description: Gather loot and hide from other players.
row.notes: Pixel art blood & death scenes.

row.name: LAZERZ
row.detailed_description: Summary Welcome to LAZERZ! The fast paced, free to play movement shooter. Master the art of hydraulic power movement and wall running. Fly like an angel through the arena and shoot with powerful ricocheting lazerz to obliterate your enemies with style! LAZERZ currently offers Free For All chaos, the precursor ranking for highly detailed statistics about your ingame performance and tons of character customization and cosmetics. Let's shoot some lazerz... with style! Gameplay Movement Rebounds Dying
row.short_description: The smoothest, free to play, movement shooter. Master the art of hydraulic power movement, fly like an angel through the arena and shoot with powerful ricocheting lazerz to obliterate your enemies with style!

row.name: 狗胆枪手
row.detailed_description: A 2D shooter game in which you control Dog Shen to fight monsters, you can get different guns, and communicate and talk to NPCs, in the game I tried to map real characters to NPCs. By purchasing guns to strengthen Goushen, you can clear the level after defeating different types of monsters.
row.short_description: A 2D survival shooter game that controls Goshin to move and shoot to destroy monsters. Looking for NPC dialogue, buying guns in the shop to strengthen myself, and then destroying enemies, I made real-life characters into NPCs in the game to control Goushen Daxia to save the world.

row.name: Idle Hero TD - Tower Defense
row.detailed_description: WEEKLY UPDATES WITH TONS OF NEW CONTENT ON THE WAY! If you're a fan of classic old-school tower defense strategy games or endless idle games where you deal impossibly large numbers of damage, then you will LOVE  Idle Hero TD ! Discover a fantasy world of epic heroes, monsters, and magic! Command a team of heroes to defend your base, and stop the evil creatures from capturing the tower! Although Idle Hero TD is an idle game that can mostly play itself (which is perfect for casual players without much time), it was also designed to be extremely strategic and rewarding for those who play actively and efficiently. The most powerful bonuses in the game revolve around optimizing the placements of your Heroes to activate their synergies and special abilities. A lot of planning and puzzle-solving is required to achieve the ideal build for your personal play style! This is an endless idle game, so if you enjoy grinding and watching numbers go up from big to impossibly huge - this is the game for you. IDLE TD GAMEPLAY Featuring non-stop, idle, and endless gameplay! Destroy endless swarms of evil monsters to bolster power, speed, and other stats - and the more monsters you obliterate, the more heroes you’ll unlock. Face off against Ultra Bosses such as the Ancient Shadow and Exotic Alien for the most powerful rewards. DOZENS OF UNIQUE HEROES Unlock 48 unique heroes, all of which have different skill sets that make tower synergy crucial to success. Determining the most effective combination of their skills and synergies will keep you entertained and speculating for weeks! Discovering new unique heroes is part of the fun. CONQUER MULTIPLE MAPS Unlock and complete several different maps, each with different perks and requiring different strategies to defend. Find the one that suits your current goals best, and conquer its challenges! COUNTLESS UPGRADES Collect various resources to unlock literally millions of upgrades, such as Research, Spells, Technology, Runes, and more! CROSS-PLAY & CROSS-PLATFORM Idle Hero TD fully supports cross-play and cross-platform functionality. Start the game on your PC, then load it up on your mobile device to continue your progress while out of the house. Compete against millions of others from around the world on Windows, Mac, Android, or iPhone! FEATURES: Easy to pick up and play - no previous experience is required! Idle offline resource gains and progress while the game is closed! Weekly PvP tournaments give this casual game a competitive edge. Complete numerous daily missions, achievements, and challenges. Cross-play and cross-platform support. Fantasy RPG-based world and classes. Fun, cute, and colorful artwork. Idle Hero TD is the perfect blend of the Idle and Tower Defense genres. The game is endless and can mostly play itself without much effort from you. However, an immense amount of strategy is required to play efficiently and place well against your peers on the leaderboards. Go on an epic never-ending quest, explore a fantastic world, battle heroes and monsters, and defeat epic bosses in Idle Hero TD!
row.short_description: Endless idle tower defense game full of deep strategy and combat mechanics. Unlock and upgrade dozens of epic fantasy heroes to defeat an infinite swarm of enemy monsters. Strategize hero positions, synergies, and skills for an effective defense, then sit back and let the auto-battler do its thing!

row.name: HIDDEN NEMESIS
row.detailed_description: Gamestory Trapped in an office, immobilized in a chair, you face a terrifying reality. Two doors and a window are the potential entry points for a demon that relentlessly hunts you. Your only ally is a computer, your gateway to a labyrinthine network of secrets and dangers. Through cameras, the Tor browser, and hidden websites, you are called upon to unravel the mystery that surrounds you and escape the nightmare. You have only SIX DAYS at your disposal to reach the truth, solving puzzles and searching in the dark corners of the internet. Your fight for survival will not be easy. The demon lurks, ready to devour you. Monitor the cameras with a watchful eye to spot it, close the doors wisely, and manage your energy carefully. Key Features Immersive and Terrifying Setting Strategic Gameplay Mechanics Resource and Energy Management Auditory Horror and Jump Scares Immersive and Terrifying Setting Players are trapped in an office, immobilized in a chair, facing a demon that relentlessly hunts them. The game’s atmosphere is designed to evoke intense fear and suspense. Strategic Gameplay Mechanics Utilize a computer to navigate a labyrinthine network of secrets and dangers. Players must use cameras, the Tor browser, and hidden websites to unravel the mystery, solve puzzles, and manage their survival over six days. Resource and Energy Management Carefully monitor and close doors to keep the demon at bay, while managing energy reserves. Each action must be calculated to ensure survival against the relentless threat. Auditory Horror and Jump Scares The game features sudden terrifying appearances and sound-based horror elements. Players must remain vigilant, as sound cues play a crucial role in survival, filling the environment with nerve-wracking messages and warnings. Footnotes Prepare for sudden appearances that will take your breath away. Sound will become your worst enemy, filling your ears with terrifying messages. Will you manage to escape the nightmare? Or will you be lost forever in the darkness?
row.short_description: Survive six nights of terror in a deadly cat-and-mouse game. Immobilized in a chair, solve intricate puzzles, monitor cameras, and scour the dark web to uncover secrets—all while a relentless demon hunts you. Will you outsmart the darkness before time runs out?

row.name: Rent A Car Simulator 24: Prologue
row.detailed_description: This Prologue is a limited version of the full game to stop waiting and jump into running your Rent A Car Bussiness already. Don't forget to wishlist the full game version to continue your most fun Rent A Car experience. In Rent A Car Simulator 24, you start your car rental business by renting a single car and build a fleet of dozens of luxury cars. Each car will bring you daily income. Modify and repair cars to earn more. Buy new cars and grow your car rental business. You can drive your cars and speed up the road with them. Prologue Version Main Features: Renting your cars to customers and tracking their rental status. Buy new cars and grow your car rental business. Earn income by selling your cars. You can repair cars. You have a living map. There are in-game characters around with whom you can engage in dialogue.
row.short_description: Rent A Car Simulator. Start by renting your first car. Expand your rental car fleet by purchasing different vehicles and grow your car rental business. Drive your cars and get them fixed when they break down. Find new customers.

row.name: Mellstroy Survivor
row.detailed_description: description: . Join an exciting adventure in the world of Melstroy Survivor! Embark on an epic quest where your control and combat skills will be put to the test in endless battles and dangerous challenges. features: Simple gameplay, grandiose possibilities: In Melstroy Survivor, control is limited only to your character's movement, but his abilities for battle are unlimited. Kill enemies, collect experience, and pump unique skills to become a true hero. Character Upgrades and Equipment: Prepare your hero for battles by choosing from a wide range of equipment that will give you an edge in battle. Increase your damage, add health, and create a unique fighting style. Shop and Roulette: Visit the store to purchase the best equipment and upgrade items. Try your luck in roulette, where you can win virtual money to buy unique items and unlock new abilities. delightful Graphics And Atmosphere: . Melstroy Survivor recreates the spirit of retro gaming with beautifully detailed artwork and breathtaking visuals. Immerse yourself in a unique atmosphere and enjoy every moment of your adventure.
row.short_description: Enter the world of Melstroy Survivor, where your skills are tested in battles and quests. With simple controls and deep leveling, each battle brings you closer to glory. Fight, collect loot, level up your hero, and enjoy the gorgeous retro graphics.

row.name: Yokai Rescue
row.detailed_description: Yokai Rescue is a short but intense experience where your reflexes are put to the challenge. Drag yourself into the air with your magical Yokai powers to ascend through the various levels of the tower. But beware, the Selvos are everywhere and will try to stop you. Your master has been captured along with other Yokais and you must rescue them. Master your powers Attach your energy rope onto rings and even enemies to drag yourself up and move in the air. Use your dash to evade attacks and adjust your trajectory with precise timing. Eliminate the Selvos with a single swift pierce to make your way up. Various environnement As you progress upward, you will reach new levels of the tower with each one having its own environment and challenges. Discover new enemies, obstacles and mechanics and test your mastery of the controller. Fast-paced combat You will encounter various enemies with very different behaviour and patterns. Learn how to evade their attacks, how to defeat them and survive during intense battles. A little story Uncover the story behind the invasion of the Selvos as you encounter new characters along the way.
row.short_description: Ascend through a futuristic tower in this fast-paced action platformer. Use your Yokai abilities to move swiftly in the air and pierce through your enemies to defeat them. You are the last Yokai capable of saving your people and liberating your homeland from the Selvo robot control.

row.name: Clash for Crust
row.detailed_description: Gather around, Gather around! The Crusty Carnival is in town! Bringing with it lots of food and fun and the Crazy Gulls are here to indulge to their hearts content! Round up your friends for a 4-player local multiplayer brawl to see who among will receive the honor of Top Gull! Style your Gull These gulls are not only crazy, but they also possess a keen eye for fashion! Enter the pre-fight lobby and Style your gull with different Skins and Hats, with Skin options ranging from a dapper tuxedo to a vibrant rainbow plumage, and a variety of Hats including a bottle cap, cowboy hat, and a golden crown there are countless ways to customize your gull! Feeding Frenzy Crazy Gulls love to eat! Eating food and increasing their Calorie Count is the greatest measure of success for these gulls, and those who attain the highest Calorie count will be crowned Top Gull. Players will fight over the most Delicious and Calorie rich food item is the Golden Crust, and make use of other food items to help them in their clash, make use of special items such as burning your opponents with a spicy chill pepper or regurgitating a powerful rolling donut can help you stun gulls and clear a path to the Golden Crust. These Gulls got moves! Why use your power ups when you can just eat them up! Players can choose to swallow their food items to give them a boost in calories and fill their Shot Meter, when full your Gull can shoot out their “Shot” to create a puddle that slows and damages, in addition to the Shot, Players can also use Seagull Spin for AOE damage and Seagull Smash to dash their way to the Golden Crust stunning any Gull in their path. Multiple Maps Take your clash to one of three specialized maps, all of which include randomized obstacle placements, each with their own twist! The Crusty Carnival including a roller coaster with drop the Screw Shield powerup, The Beachside Boardwalk with a rising tide concentrates the battle to a small area, and Pirate Peak with crashing waves that sway the boat back and forth. Auspicious Awards Need extra Calories to secure your victory? Or perhaps your performance wasn’t up to snuff and you’re looking for a comeback! The awards ceremony has you covered, at the end of the game players will be granted up to 3 awards depending on how they played, from Manure Marksman to the Pity Party, these awards all award Calories which can turn the tides of victory!
row.short_description: Clash for Crust is a 2-4 Player local multiplayer party brawler. Customize and take control of a Crazy Gull and fight using your Seagull Attacks and Power-Ups to grab the Golden Crust and to battle for the honor of becoming Top Gull.

row.name: Seaside Racing
row.detailed_description: Experience the thrill of driving a soapbox car down a mountain in this chaotic cult classic kart racer, accidentally knocking your competitors into the sea or getting lost in green fields without as much as a road sign to help you find your way. Actual features Physics-based multiplayer kart racing! Up to 12 players over the Internet or local network 1-4 local players split screen (online or offline) Share-a-gamepad option for up to 4 players using 2 game pads Questionable features 3 large seaside maps (no more, no less) Randomly generated avatars (you can switch but not choose) Possible to get lost (the game doesn't even know where to go) Unpredictable respawn logic (that makes it possible to reach tricky places) No placement indicator Cult classic This is a remastered version of the original Seaside Racing that was released on Xbox Live Indie Games in 2010. The original game has a cult following among at least one group of friends in Indiana, USA, since its original release on Xbox Live Indie Games in 2010. Since publishing this, I’ve also been notified that there is a cult following in High Wycombe, England, UK in addition to the aforementioned cult following in the USA.
row.short_description: Drive down a mountain with your friends in this chaotic cult classic kart racer!

row.name: Arcane Raiders
row.detailed_description: Wizards from across the land journey to the Arcane Tower in hopes of claiming its bounty. Do you and your mates have what it takes to reach the top? Arcane Raiders is a rogue-like dungeon-raider where you blast enemies with spells and maneuver through traps to pillage the Tower of its treasure. Tight dodging controls and powerful elemental synergies will help you in your quest to take down the Tower's fearsome bosses and make it out with as much gold as possible. Features Fast-paced dodge-and-strike combat Create powerful elemental synergies to decimate foes Face of against dangerous traps, enemies and bosses Randomized rooms and spell drops keeps each run fresh and exciting Local and online multiplayer to team up with friends
row.short_description: Team up with your wizard friends to pillage the magic tower! Create elemental synergies, defeat powerful bosses and claim the tower's treasure in this rogue-like dungeon-raider.

row.name: HOLOSAGA: Invasion of the HoloX
row.detailed_description: About this game Liberated from the shackles of power, La+ led the holoX members and the army to invade Earth! You must gather the members of the HoloLive and stop them. This is a casual defense RPG game. You can upgrade your unit more strongly while playing the game in a row. Choose the unit you want for each game, and stop incoming enemies from going off the screen. At each stage stage, members of holoX appear as bosses, and they have STRONG PATTERNS that are different from normal monsters. You have to actively move the units, breaking down the patterns and knocking down the bosses. Controls Mouse and some Keydowns Furthermore We will prepare more Hololive members as a unit in the future. Each unit will have different patterns that are different from other units. row.short_description: Liberated from the shackles of power, La+ led the HoloX members and the army to invade Earth! You must gather the members of the HoloLive and stop them.

row.name: Apocalypse Slave x Warlord
row.detailed_description: In a post-apocalyptic setting where zombies, raiders, and military fascists have taken over, you can either take the role of a warlord or a slave and roleplay surviving. Depending on the route you choose, you'll have different goals and objectives. As a slave, you'll do various labor for your mistresses as well as converse with other slaves and the guards keeping watch over you. Different groups will want different things that may impact your survival. Making deals and helping one group will have consequences that you need to take into account. Nothing is free, and even as a slave, you will need to buy food as well as manage your health and stress in any way you can, even if it means buying drugs. Your mistresses may also deign to play with you to relieve your stress in a more physical way, but this may affect your pride, which is another stat you have to maintain to prevent your character from losing his sense of self. As a warlord, you'll likewise be maintaining stats, but they take the form of things like manpower, income, authority, and settlement happiness. You'll need to maintain these stats to stay in power as well as to wage war against the other warlords that will want to take you out. Take prisoners, make them submit and work for you, as you seek to take over the entire city.
row.short_description: In a post-apocalyptic setting where zombies, raiders, and military fascists have taken over, you can either take the role of a warlord or a slave and roleplay surviving. Depending on the route you choose, you'll have different goals and objectives.
row.notes: This game contains graphic sexual content, BDSM (whipping and bondage play), including questionable consent, non-consensual sex, and consensual sex.

row.name: 热血街头
row.detailed_description: 《热血街头》是由本人基于某Flash小游戏，个人原汁原味重制的一款经典回合制RPG小游戏。游戏设定在大陆八九十年代的架空世界，玩家扮演的主角失去了记忆但获得了特别的力量。你将跟从指示行动，周旋于大陆式黑社会、小混混与警察之间，一步步发掘指令背后人物的身份，你的抉择也会影响游戏故事的走向。在完成游戏剧情之后，玩家会对整个故事的脉络有一个新的认知。你可以升级，加点，强化技能，搭建自己的流派，打击敌人，畅快通关。游戏中还保留了一些有趣的小特性（不是bug）以供玩家利用。
row.short_description: 《热血街头》是个人基于Flash小游戏重制的一款回合制RPG游戏。游戏使用本人最熟悉的UE4引擎进行开发，全面参考Flash游戏的制作流程，玩家仅需要鼠标点击按钮即可全程游玩。通过升级、加点、强化技能等方式，玩家可以搭建自己的流派进行攻略。整个游戏的设计安排类似于黑社会电影，熟练的小伙伴或许可以在一场电影的时间内通关，也期待给大家带来紧凑节奏的刺激与酣畅淋漓的享受。
row.notes: fighting

row.name: 飛天歷險2025(Dream Of Mirror Online)
row.detailed_description: 經典《軒轅劍》網絡版2，2024年再次出發！ 故事背景發生在「崑崙鏡」所創造的神器世界發生異變，除了引人入勝的劇情外，遊戲方式多元創新，禦劍飛行自由自在，一人可兼所有職業，無論是群體冒險或是單人歷險都能夠輕鬆實現。令人想要一探究竟的劇情，歷險過程精彩刺激，玩家選定角色後可和劇情角色互動演出，豐富的情感表達搭配快節奏的劇情變化，譜出動人心弦故事。 一、 創新的職業系統： 01. 轉職限制低，隨時可以玩不同的職業 飛天歷險打破線上遊戲職業設計的傳統，職業間的轉換不再有重重的限制，不需要重生，不需要重建角色或是多開帳號，只要這個職業是你想玩的，完成簡單的轉職任務，你就可以隨時轉換到這個職業，不會倒退等級，不需要重練，飛天歷險就是這麼自由。 02. 附掛天賦，變化多端的組合 職業是法師就要穿法袍拿法杖，躲在旁邊放魔法嗎？飛天歷險的法師可不見得是這樣，擁有了傭兵的裝備重甲技能，再加上劍客的裝備劍技能，一個手持寶劍砍怪，口唸咒語施法的肉搏型法師就誕生了，會補血的狂戰刀客、擅長竊盜的醫師、喜好採集與製作服裝的道士，許許多多不同類型的玩法，玩家透過天賦的附掛，就能玩到，也因為如此，玩家練就各個職業的技能，就像在收集牌卡，手上擁有越多技能，組合也就越多越自由，玩法也越豐富。 二、 獨特豐富的劇情： 01. 結合單機的豐富腳本內容 「飛天歷險」的世界，是參考歷代「軒轅劍」單機版背景劇情，所發展設計出來的一個神器世界。裡頭結合上古神話與民間傳說，展現出中國文化的特殊色彩，玩家不僅可以在這裡體會成仙成魔的快感，更能夠自由扮演世界中獨一無二的重要角色，透過充滿想像力、高潮迭起的冒險情節，帶領世界走向康莊大道。 02. 專業的運鏡手法，電影般的劇情呈現 突破Online Game在劇情呈現上的侷限，劇情任務不在只是單純的打寶與對話了！飛天以如同電影般的「第三人稱」視角，專業流暢的運鏡手法搭配上劇情的互動，玩家將會體驗到有別於其他Online Game的全新視覺感受，讓人產生彷彿置身於電影院般的觀感。 03. 生動活潑的逗趣演出，融入飛天世界的真實感 飛天中的所有角色事物都有屬於自己的專屬背景，在與豐富的世界觀融合後形成一個密不可分的網脈。玩家置身在此不但可以探索到整個世界的奧秘，透過與豐富逗趣的角色互動，依照自己的選擇有時可以像個大俠、有時可以當個惡人，就像在真實世界般的活耀。 三、 中國神話再創新 01. 中國神話式世界觀 《飛天歷險》的世界，是參考歷代《軒轅劍》單機版背景劇情所設計出來的一個神器世界，而《軒轅劍》單機版是一系列結合中國神話與歷史為背景的劇情大作。創造這個世界的神器為「崑崙鏡」，它與軒轅劍、煉妖壺等，都是中國上古神話時代所傳承下來的，有著創世毀天之能。由於「崑崙鏡」不存在生死與時間，呈現一個混合各個年代、歷史背景和國家的超時空世界，讓玩家可以在《飛天歷險》一口氣以全新的方式經歷《軒轅劍》單機版所有的故事背景及有中國神話內涵的冒險旅程。 02. 參考傳統黃曆的命運設定 在《飛天歷險》的世界裡有著一套非常複雜與詳細的命運設定，包含先天的命格、緣分，後天的運勢、環境都會影響到玩家的遊戲結果。玩家在進入遊戲時提供的生日與生肖，會經過根據中國黃曆設計的系統計算建立自己的命格，再加上玩家的個性分類，在遊戲中的走向也各有不同。在遊戲中會發現許多人與自己在命格上有些特別的關係，分別有宿親、宿敵與真愛，每個關係都是一種緣分，讓玩家在人際關係的建立上有著許多驚喜。除此之外，透過運氣系統，玩家可以選擇是否要配合運氣進行各種活動，讓《飛天歷險》的世界每天都有不一樣的變化。 03. 以可愛的卡通呈現傳統風味 卡通貼圖效果表現出獨特的效果，表現出最美觀、最可愛的視覺享受。年輕一代的玩家或許會覺得中國傳統的元素過於沉悶死板，但是透過生動可愛的卡通模式呈現後，一切都變的平易近人。生動逗趣的人物表情甚至可以結合網路上盛行的表情符號隨時表現令人會心一笑的動作。角色對話時的泡泡對話框、多樣的肢體動作與表情，取代一向呆板的訊息欄文字，徹底滿足玩家視覺上的享受。 四、 多樣的玩法選擇 生活性與故事性 飛天歷險擁有完整的生活機制規劃設計，並同時具備豐富的故事架構。在遊戲中， 你可以扮演一個名聞遐邇的名人俠士，也可以扮演一名默默無名的市井小民；可以 是闖蕩江湖的英雄豪傑，也可以是經營一方的萬元大戶。 01. 打怪練功與生產煉化 角色的成長是角色扮演遊戲不可或缺的一環。打怪練功可以增加經驗值和等級，採集和生產則可以增加金錢收入。 02. 主動消耗與協助供給 飛天歷險裏，玩家可以從事各式各樣的職業。擅於戰鬥的職業會消耗物資來完成任務、獲得經驗值，而擅於生產的職業可以提供戰鬥系所需的物資來換取報酬；同樣是戰鬥系職業，有些是專司主動攻擊的，其他也有些是負責補血、輔助攻擊的；生產系中亦可分為有負責合成煉化的以及提供原物料等不同的職業。 03. 個人主義與社群關係 在飛天歷險遊戲中，玩家可以成立公會認識各地英雄豪傑，也可以結成師徒、朋友與戀人等特殊關係；亦可以自立更生、特立獨行，隱性埋名做個獨行俠。 04. 冒險史詩與休閒小品 除了大時代淒美的劇情，在遊戲世界中還有許多輕鬆的小品故事。另外還有轉蛋取得寵物來飼養等附加的遊戲系統，增加遊戲的可玩性。
row.short_description: 經典《軒轅劍》網絡版2，2025年再次出發！故事背景發生在「崑崙鏡」所創造的神器世界發生異變，除了引人入勝的劇情外，遊戲方式多元創新，禦劍飛行自由自在，一人可兼所有職業，無論是群體冒險或是單人歷險都能夠輕鬆實現。令人想要一探究竟的劇情，歷險過程精彩刺激，玩家選定角色後可和劇情角色互動演出，豐富的情感表達搭配快節奏的劇情變化，譜出動人心弦故事。

row.name: Screen Wonders
row.detailed_description: If you're tired of the motionless pictures on your desktop, if you're ready to welcome the magic of various places around the world and even parallel universes, we have gathered the best live wallpapers in this app! The variety of themes, seasons, and festive scenes are sure to appeal to you. They say beauty demands sacrifice but you don't need to worry because the smart energy-saving settings will slow down the wallpaper if you need your computer to work at full capacity or if your notebook is running low on power. So sit back comfortably and relax - the wonders are already on your screen! And we continue creating new ones. Features: Large, constantly updated, collection of highly artistic, well-developed 3D scenes Convenient search by tags and playlist creation Full control over the order and period of wallpaper change Instant switching to screensaver mode and exit by password Support for monitors with any resolution and aspect ratio, up to ultra-wide-angle and multi-monitor systems Save disk space - quick installation and removal of scenes in one click Smart system load control and power saving All previously bought and currently installed screen savers from 3Planesoft will be detected and will become automatically available in Screen Wonders.
row.short_description: A collection of the best 3D screensavers and live wallpapers is now available to you in one click. There you will find both scenes that have become classics over the past 20 years and our newest releases. Let the magic come to your screens and enjoy!

row.name: Incident Survival
row.detailed_description: Incident Survival is a Role-playing ( board ) game. It is multiplayer game for 6 to 20 players. At least one player is appointed as the game master (the host). You will have a fictional incident available - a situation that will place you and your characters in an unusual and challenging situation from which they need to find a way out, or just survive as long as possible. The main help is a shelter, a temporary place with limited amenities and living spaces. Incident is a short description of the event. Here you can encounter anything, starting with possible natural disasters and ending with the invasion of fantasy creatures in your world. Shelter is your closest way to escape from problems. It can be an ordinary basement filled with canned food, or even a fortified military base deep underground. Don't forget to keep an eye on life support systems and any problems or threats that arise as the game progresses. Character is an avatar that is represented by each player. He has a number of attributes, such as profession, hobby, age, personalities, body and health status. To make the game dynamic, each character has a number of active and passive skills, as well as inventory and some special information. Your fate is in your own hands. Join together with others who want to test their abilities in a challenging situation and use the right arguments to convince others of your worth.
row.short_description: Role-playing board game. Your fate is in your own hands. Join together with others who want to test their abilities in a challenging situation and use the right arguments to convince others of your worth.

row.name: Early Mellow
row.detailed_description: Early Mellow is an experimental puzzle-adventure game. You can walk, use an axe, pick up a radio and blast drum 'n' bass in an abandoned mill. It's short but it's made with love !
row.short_description: A short walking sim game where after a car crash you wander into strange lands. Chop some cactus and turn an old mill into a concert hall. That's your life now.

row.name: Marriage Impossible!
row.detailed_description: Marriage Impossible! is a real time strategy game playable for a streamer with 45~ viewers. Gather gold and upgrade viewer's looks! The goal is to collaborate with viewers and streamers to marry all viewers!❤️ *The game supports streaming service like Twitch,YouTube, Chzzk. *Photo Mode Take a picture with viewers! Capture memories in photos that will last a lifetime! Streamer : Mouse and keyboard to use spells. Chat Viewer : Command : 'Join' to join game 1/2/3 : Spawn a unit to each number's position. Key Feature : -streamer-only game. Twitch, YouTube, Chzzk supports. -Fast paced realtime strategy. -Various unique events. -Photo mode.
row.short_description: Marriage Impossible! is a real time strategy game playable only for a streamer with 45~ viewers. Gather gold and upgrade chat viewer's Unit! Collaborate with chat and streamers to capture the ❤️Love❤️

row.name: Nine Realms Prologue
row.detailed_description: WHISLIST THE FULL GAME About the Game DESTROY ALL THE GODS! The body of the thunder god has been taken over by the most cunning god of the universe. Find the gods hidden in different realms and destroy them all until you are the only god left standing! YOU'RE THE VERY RAGNAROK ITSELF There's no hero's tale here. On the contrary, you will be the nightmare of heroes! Develop your strategy and unleash the cosmic calamity. EVERY DEFEAT IS A NEW BEGINNING Giving up is not in the nature of the thunder god. Each time you are defeated, warp time and start over with what you've gained. Embark on your next journey more experienced and powerful. CUSTOMIZE YOUR CHARACTER TO FIT YOUR STRATEGY Various weapons, armors, abilities, allies, and more have been specifically designed for you to develop your own strategy. Choose what suits you best and develop it permanently. You are free to choose whatever you want before you start fighting. REALMS, CHARACTERS, AND CREATURES TO DISCOVER With dynamic and voiced dialogues, realms offering different experiences and challenges, a vast bestiary, and dozens of characters you will get to know, Nine Realms presents a new universe and a deep story that tackles Norse Mythology in a different reality, waiting for you to discover. FATE BOWS BEFORE THE INEVITABLE Enjoy being the thunder god with detailed leveling and development systems, an immersive story, and realistic graphic quality! Remember, there are no rules here, you are here only to destroy.
row.short_description: Rule the god of thunder and challenge all the gods of the nine realms! In this Rogue-like, hack and slash game, develop your strategy and skills, subject all the gods who challenge you to your wrath, and become the only god of the universe.

row.name: BalloonBreaker
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Balloon Breaker, the addictive and exhilarating game that will keep you entertained for hours! Your mission is simple but challenging: inflate and pop as many balloons as possible using your trusty mouse. But be warned, this isn't your ordinary balloon-popping game. In Balloon Breaker, the more balloons you pop, the higher your score climbs! And if you're a true balloon-popping master, you can aim for special achievements, such as popping a certain number of balloons or popping within a specific time limit. Enjoy your balloons!!!
row.short_description: Welcome to Balloon Breaker, the addictive and exhilarating game that will keep you entertained for hours! Your mission is simple but challenging: inflate and pop as many balloons as possible using your trusty mouse. Enjoy your balloons!!!

row.name: Trash Pandamonium
row.detailed_description: Get ready to unleash the ultimate trash-tossing mayhem in Trash Pandamonium , the wild and fun couch co-op party game that turns garbage collection into an all-out brawl! Take control of 1 of 4 raccoons to beat the garbage out of your opponents, boost your stats, and compete in a high-stakes minigame gauntlet across unique and dynamic levels. With these interactive maps packed with environmental hazards and events, every match is uncharted territory! Customize your raccoon with all sorts of goofy hats and accessories to suit your style. Trash Pandamonium is pure chaotic fun. Simple controls make it a blast for players of any skill level, but mastering the deeper strategies will give you what it takes to come out on top of the trash heap! Whether you're gaming with your friends on the couch, or trying to dethrone rivals on Steam, get ready for an endlessly entertaining night of mayhem, laughs, and probably some spilled soda. The party doesn't start until the trash starts flying! Grab your controllers, gather your crew, and prepare for pandamonium! Features: - Couch Co-op Chaos: Enjoy hilarious multiplayer battles with friends in a local couch co-op setting. - Dynamic Maps: Navigate through interactive environments filled with hazards and surprises. - Mini-Game Gauntlet: Compete in a series of high-stakes mini-games for ultimate trash-tossing supremacy. - Customization Options: Personalize your colorful raccoons with a variety of fun hats and accessories. - Competitive Leaderboards: Climb the ranks and compete against friends and players locally to see who is the best Trash Panda. - Environmental Events: Experience random events and challenges that keep each match fresh and exciting. - Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: Simple controls make it accessible to all skill levels, but mastering the game requires strategy and skill. - Endless Fun: With countless ways to play and endless laughter, Trash Pandamonium promises non-stop entertainment for players of all ages. Trash Pandamonium was developed by students in the Division of Games at the University of Utah
row.short_description: Get ready for Trash Pandamonium: the ultimate couch co-op party game! Control colorful raccoons, beat the trash out of opponents, and dominate dynamic maps full of hazards. Customize your raccoon, gather your crew, and prepare for pandamonium!

row.name: Ivorfall
row.detailed_description: Ivorfall City is in danger and its up to you to risk it all to save it! Ivorfall is a steampunk, roguelike, twin-stick shooter where you play as the mysterious and capable Detective Flintlock tasked with taking out hordes of enemies to save Ivorfall city! Fight enemies, modify one of the three gun types in the game to discover a dozen ways to clear through the evil Raven's thugs. Move from level to level collecting weapon mods, spend money in the market on health upgrades, combat items, and weapon mods, and blast your way through boxes, crates, walls, and bank vaults in your quest to uncover the truth. Gameplay Features: -Weapon modifications allow for 12 distinct styles of play -Destructible environments allow players to take on combat challenges in unique ways -Environmental hazards such as traps put the player on the move -Variety of gameplay options and varying rarity in weapon mods add to replay-ability Ivorfall is produced by Inquiry Games LLC, a student game studio from the University of Utah Games program's class of 2024. We hope you enjoy Ivorfall, and that you will support us on our development journey! Play with Keyboard and Mouse or Xbox Controller!
row.short_description: Ivorfall City is in danger and only you have what it takes to save it! Ivorfall is a Steampunk, roguelike, twin-stick shooter where you take up the mantle of Detective Flintlock who must face off against hordes of enemies in destructible environments.

row.name: Stray Cats in Cozy Town
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Cozy Town, where every day is International Cat Day! Be part of a village community where every stray is respected, loved and fed. Explore the charming streets and alleys to discover all the stray cats in this hidden-object game. Free to Play 150 Cats to Find Find food bowls and feed stray cats! Join us in STRAY CATS IN COZY TOWN and be a part of something special. Can you find all the stray cats?
row.short_description: Welcome to Cozy Town, where every day is International Cat Day! Be part of a village community where every stray is respected, loved and fed. Explore the charming streets and alleys to discover all the stray cats in this hidden-object game.

row.name: Five Nights at Silver Pine
row.detailed_description: 'Five Nights at Silver Pine' is a fan made take of 'Five Nights at Freddy's'. Make sure you use your resources sparingly in order to survive. 'Five Nights at Silver Pine' is a fan made game based of the 'Five Nights at Freddy's' franchise made by Scott Cawthon. F.N.a.S.P. has you taking on the night shift at Silver Pine Hospital. Use the computer screen to monitor the cameras. Keep an eye out for the creature. Hit the big red button to close and open the doors. Letting the creature in will be a huge mistake.
row.short_description: Fight for your life as the creature tries to turn you into their next meal.

row.name: 星影の館殺人事件

row.name: 奇天烈相談ダイヤル
row.detailed_description: あらすじ 舞台は怪異が実在する1994年の日本。 かつては畏怖の対象であった怪異が 昨今ではイタズラや犯罪に利用され、 真贋入り乱れる世の中となってしまった。 アナタは、都内に設立された無料電話サービス 『奇天烈お悩み相談室』の新人相談員・ミサコとなり、 まずはお試しで1週間、活動をしてみることにする。 ゲームシステム 《矛盾を探し　怪異であるかを判定する》 本作は『Papers, Please』から着想を得た怪異判定ADVだ。 相談員のアナタは、 資料と相談者の話を照らし合わせて矛盾を探し、 相談者の悩みが怪異の仕業かそうでないかを判定する。 矛盾がなければホンモノ、 ひとつでも矛盾があればニセモノだ。 《ランダムで決定する人物と相談内容》 相談者・相談対象の怪異・相談内容は すべてランダムで決定される。 登場する怪異は全部で100体だ。 プレイする度に変化する相談を次々と解決し、 100体すべてコンプリートしよう。 《難易度を自由に設定可能》 今作では制限時間の長さやライフの最大値、 メモ機能の自動化・手動化などを プレイヤー自身で設定することができる。 設定した難易度によって 毎日の自己評価にボーナススコアが加算される。 クリア後にはDからSのランクが付けられるので、 プレイに慣れてきたら高難易度を目指してみよう。 《周回プレイのスパイス　達人モード》 相談室には、相談員を怪異から守るために 特別なチカラが込められた『清めの塩』が用意されている。 ランクA以上を獲得すると解放される『達人モード』では、 この清めの塩をスルーすることで ワザと怪異に襲われるという酔狂なプレイを楽しめる。 やって来るのは『話を聞いた相手の元に現れる』怪異だ。 もし相談者がこのタイプの怪異を相談してきたら 怪異資料をくまなく確認することを忘れずに…。 ゲーム概要 ○タイトル　　　　　　奇天烈相談ダイヤル ○ジャンル　　　　　　怪異判定アドベンチャー ○プレイ時間　　　　　2～10時間（設定した難易度によって大幅に変動します） ○ゲームオーバー　　　あり ○エンディング分岐　　あり（分岐に関する情報はオンラインマニュアルをご覧ください） ○対象年齢　　　　　　12歳以上推奨 ご注意 この物語はフィクションです。 実在する人物・地名・団体・事件等とは一切関係ありません。 特定の思想・信条を肯定する内容ではありません。 直接的な描写はありませんが 暴力性・残虐性・犯罪行為を含む文章及び 人によっては恐怖を感じかねない表現が含まれています。 操作方法について オンラインマニュアルをご覧ください。 本ゲームはキーボードによる文字入力を必要とします。 ゲーム実況/配信について 公式サイトにガイドラインがございます。 ご利用の際は必ずご一読ください。 規約は予告なく変更となる場合があります。 投げ銭について 当ゲームはすべて無料でプレイできます。 面白いと思っていただけましたら投げ銭をよろしくお願いいたします。 webサイトから「奇天烈相談ダイヤル」のBOOTHページまでお越しください。 開発者より 皆さまこんにちは、本ゲーム開発者の笹森簀児です。 今作は『Papers, Please』というインディーゲームからインスピレーションを受け、 突発的に開発を始めて、5ヶ月で完成させました。 物語の時代設定ですが、我々の知る90年代ではなく 『70年代に生きる人々が、当時に思い描いていたかもしれない90年代』となっています。 ちょっと複雑ですが、パラレルワールドのお話だと思ってください。　 今作はゲームの難易度をプレイヤー自身で設定できる仕様にしました。 設定によってはご自身でメモを取っていただきますので、予め用意しておくことをオススメします。 サークル初となる『周回プレイが前提のゲーム』ですので、ぜひ何度もプレイしてみてくださいね。 制作（敬称略） ○シナリオ/演出/スクリプト/CM・キャライラスト/エンドロールナレーション 　笹森簀児 ○CM・システムボイス/ジングル 　マザえもん ○エンドロールBGM作曲 　真島こころ ○企画・開発 　法螺会

row.name: Arcanists
row.detailed_description: Arcanists is a thrilling competitive + casual, multiplayer, turn-based, artillery game. Players take turns in a race against the clock, utilizing an array of spells to defeat their opponents in battle! Victory is accomplished by becoming the 'last man standing' (or last team) after all other players have been reduced to zero hitpoints. ------------------------------------- 100+ Achievements to Earn Achievements are given for completing certain challenges in Arcanists and unlock special awards such as new outfits to use within Character Creation. These award Orb Points and Orb Coins, some of which are needed for the Prestige requirements (see below re. Prestige). While some achievements are very easy to get, others are very difficult and could take several weeks to execute as one waits for the right circumstances to occur within the game! ------------------------------------- Character Creation Customise your very own Arcanist character, with over 100,000 costume combinations to choose from! ------------------------------------- Spell Selection Choose from a vast selection of 150+ extraordinary spells to bring in multiplayer battle! - There are a total of 15 uniquely themed spellbooks, each containing 12 magical spells. - Selecting all spells from one spellbook unlocks a 'Familiar' effect enabling use of a special ability/extra spells. - You're limited to just 16 spells in your book... so choose wisely and be sure to read the descriptions...! Map Environments Select one of 16 unique map arenas on which to battle and vanquish your opponents! Beware! Most maps have a powerful 'Armageddon' effect which initiates after a 10-turn countdown... ...Gradually destroying the map terrain, making it difficult for you to escape its destructive wrath! ------------------------------------- Gameplay Special Features Choose from a wide range of game options and decide how you want to play! - 24 Player Battles: Play with up to 24 players online in epic free for all's or team games! More players = crazier gameplay! - Play either Casual or Competitively: Play casual games in unranked with up to 24 players, or climb the rankings ladder in Ranked battles and climb the ladder to Rank #1! - Random Spells Mode: Unsure which spells to use? No problem! All players' spells become randomised by the game. RNG will decide your fate now! - Save your Custom Outfits & Spellbooks: As your game data is stored locally on your PC, you can save your costumes and spellbooks locally. Choose one of the presets in-game using a quick select menu! - On-Demand Gameplay Replay: Save replay files after spectating or playing a game and watch them whenever you like, on demand. Replay files can also be shared with others, accessible via the Main Menu! - Share Spellbooks & Outfits: Show off your custom outfit designs and spellbook creations with other players in the multiplayer lobby. - Design and Create Tutorials: Our tutorial framework enables you to create custom guides to help teach others how to become an Arcanists expert! -------------------------------------
row.short_description: Players take turns in a race against the clock, utilising an array of spells to defeat their opponents in battle! Victory is accomplished by becoming the 'last man standing' (or last team) after all other players have been reduced to zero hitpoints.

row.name: JUMPNG DISABLE

Complete each stage within the given time to earn the prestigious Perfect Clear title! But don’t worry if you miss the time limit—clear the stage before the Retire Time and you can still continue your challenge. Don’t fear failure—keep pushing forward and go for the win! Face a Variety of Obstacles! Unpredictable and outlandish gimmicks await to block your path. Overcome these thrilling moments, dodge every obstacle, and strive for victory!

row.name: 光之守护者:贤者之石
row.detailed_description: Game gift code: shoufa1 xinshou1 Customer service email: liming9964@outlook.com QQ: 1595584560 (add customer service QQ, receive gift code, add friends, note: Guardian of Light) Before she fell asleep, she was one of the gods of creation. Due to the excessive use of the power of the original light element, the side effects were changes in appearance, long sleep and amnesia. After waking up, the protagonist has been an apprentice in the Dehamer Alchemy Academy. She has lived and studied carefree in the academy since she was a child, and studied alchemy. Because of this, she knows almost nothing about what happened outside the town in the past few days. Although she is often proud and complacent, and occasionally tinkers with strange objects, she particularly admires and respects the alchemist Dehamer. She always hopes that one day she can travel around the Brulim continent like Dehamer and explore the higher mysteries of alchemy. After the Void Demon feasted on human evil thoughts, the second war on the continent of Brulim began: 'Nightfall' began, the Philosopher's Stone was snatched away, and the protagonist followed the clues to track Loki. The protagonist and the twelve zodiac guardians in the academy (the entry point of the 'Nightfall' war) embarked on an adventure to find the Philosopher's Stone and save the continent of Brulim. During this period, they fought various monsters and purified them into demons. They gained experience and growth in the adventures of various empires, and also gained precious friendships. In the end, from various fragments of clues, the protagonist slowly pieced together his own memories, the mystery of elemental power, and the truth of the tearing war and Dehammer. The battle part of the game adopts real-time battles, and players can fight in the scene with demons of different attributes. Demons are divided into five attributes, gold, wood, water, fire, and earth. The five attributes restrain each other, and using corresponding demons in battle can achieve twice the result with half the effort.
row.short_description: You will play the role of an adventurer with the power of light element, leading the guardians of the zodiac on an adventure to find the philosopher's stone and save the continent of Brulim.

row.name: Armored of Doom
row.detailed_description: ' Armored Of Doom ' is a fascinating TPS game with 'tank vehicle' + 'MOBA' gameplay. A variety of tank types are available for players to choose from, including light tanks, medium tanks, heavy tanks, anti-tanks, etc. The game takes diversified strategy combinations and teamwork as its core, providing players with a real and brutal battlefield fighting experience.   Players can choose from multiple different tank types, including light tanks, medium tanks, heavy tanks, anti-tanks, etc. Each tank has its own unique characteristics and positioning. Players can choose the right tank according to their personal style and tactical needs, and build a strong team with their teammates.   Techniques and tactics The game emphasizes personal skill and tactical resourcefulness. Players need to learn to target the enemy's weaknesses and use skills and buffs appropriately to cause maximum damage. At the same time, players need to master hiding skills and formulate response strategies by analyzing the opponent's tank type and tactical intentions.   Diverse game modes: Provides multiple game modes such as single player matching and team matching battles. Whether playing alone or in a team, players can enjoy a challenging and exciting gaming experience.   Personalized development system: In-game development: Players can obtain resources during battles and use them to upgrade different attributes of tanks to adapt to the changing battlefield environment. Outside development: Unlock new accessories, choose crew members, and customize tank capabilities according to your personal style to enhance combat effectiveness.   These features together constitute the unique gaming experience of 'Armored Of Doom', aiming to provide players with a rich gaming battlefield full of strategy and skills. Follow our development: 1.Discord: 2.Telegram: 3.Twitter: @ARMORED_OF_DOOM 4. VK: 872928465 Thank you for your continued support! We value all commanders' feedback.
row.short_description: 'Armored of Doom' is a TPS game with 'tank vehicle' + 'MOBA' gameplay. You will use famous active and retired tanks to compete on the battlefield. The game combines the strategic depth of traditional tank battles with the excitement of MOBA games, bringing an unprecedented gaming experience.

row.name: Gym Manager: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Gym Manager Prologue is a game where you get to manage, build, and expand your own gym. After being fired by the gym owner, you decided to get revenge and spend all your savings on opening a new gym, with the goal of making your former boss bankrupt. The Prologue version is limited to one hour of gameplay time and fewer game mechanics. As the main mechanic of the game, you will have to manage, build, and expand your gym. You can buy new equipment, upgrade existing ones and sell supplements. You can also expand your gym by demolishing walls, buying new decorations. Meanwhile, you must protect your gym from potential danger, keep the gym clean and manage your members. Outside of managing your gym, you can engage in various activities in town, including flirting with girls, sabotaging the competition gym, partying, doing illegal business with a shady guy in the backstreet and lockpicking and stealing from the town while avoiding the police.
row.short_description: Gym Manager: Prologue is a free simulation game where you can build, expand and manage your own Gym. To attract more clients - invest in new equipment, keep the room clean and sabotage your competitors.

row.name: Daisy Dangerous
row.detailed_description: Daisy Dangerous is a short but captivating 2D puzzle and precision platformer that immerses players in a dark, treacherous world filled with intricate challenges, strongly based on the 1989 classic, Rick Dangerous. Players will guide Daisy through a series of perilous levels that require keen environmental awareness and precise movements to navigate successfully. Players must deftly maneuver through platforms, avoiding deadly traps such as rolling boulders, spikes, and other hidden hazards that demand quick reflexes and careful planning. Daisy is equipped with a rifle and limited supplies of bombs and bullets. This scarcity forces players to conserve ammunition and utilize it only when absolutely necessary. Much of the gameplay involves using the environment to outsmart and defeat enemies. Players must lure adversaries into traps or use the terrain to their advantage to progress, adding a layer of strategic depth to the platforming challenges. The game's limited resources and hazardous environments compel players to stay alert and adapt to each new challenge, making for a thrilling and immersive gaming experience.
row.short_description: A 2D puzzle and precision platformer based on the 1989's classic, Rick Dangerous.

row.name: The Final Prize is Soup
row.detailed_description: After a disastrous break up, Qian Hailu wakes up to find that she's dead. Luckily (or unluckily), she's been given a chance to turn back the clock and avert her death—as long as she can pass three rounds in the game of life. Story You who are unqualified to drink Meng Po's soup, you have been chosen for the game of life. Three worlds, three rounds. Win all three and you may avert your fated death. Lose any and your bones are forfeit for tomorrow's lunch broth. Good luck. Our ghosts have prepared their takeout containers, all plastic, non-microwaveable. —A horror death-game yuri visual novel. Features ~45k word main story 2 main heroines - 2 major endings and plenty of dead ends 5 CGs Cinematographic storytelling Accessibility options A CG gallery, a music gallery, dev notes, and an achieved endings screen Exclusive developer Q&A 15k word bonus side story Steam achievements
row.short_description: You who are unqualified to drink Meng Po's soup, you have been chosen for the game of life. A horror yuri visual novel following a series of death games in the afterlife.
row.notes: Please be advised that this visual novel contains violence, blood, death, jump scares, cannibalism, child abuse, human sacrifice, monsters, domestic violence, alcohol, drowning, fire, snakes.

row.name: Demon Core
row.detailed_description: Going Free This is a notification to let you know Demon Core will be free to play shortly. If you were planning on buying the game, you may wish to wait a few weeks and download it for free. About the Game Abandon hope and delve into the core of an old nuclear power plant in this psychological survival horror experience. You must trust your map and radiation detector to navigate the bowels of the irradiated plant... And be forced to discover the monstrous cause of its sudden reawakening. There are no waypoints. Navigating the plant's interior is up to you. Demon Core is a short and intense semi-linear horror experience, focusing on atmosphere and player skill to provide a good scare. Confined in your radiation suit, there's no parkour chase sequences - only tension and release. Areas of the plant are heavily irradiated and nuclear waste litters the corridors. Pay attention to your geiger counter and plan your route to survive. Core Design Player Skill: No waypoints, navigation and survival relies on a paper map and geiger counter. Atmosphere: Detailed visuals, immersive sound design and frightening lore make the plant come to life. Stalking Horror: Something intelligent and highly irradiated stalks the plant... combat or escape is not an option. Confront the source of the horror confined in the bowels of Gray Bay Warning The game contains intense graphic imagery, death, and frequent frightening elements.
