row.name: Along the River During the Qingming Festival
row.detailed_description: This is a hidden object game with historical and cultural interpretations, attempting to carefully and seriously investigate and verify the intriguing stories expressed in 'Along the River During the Qingming Festival'. The main gameplay currently involves finding 352 objects or characters in the painting. Each item comes with annotations explaining its function and situation in the painting. Many objects and customs shown in the ancient painting no longer exist today and can only be guessed and inferred from existing books and experience. Naturally, there are some unsolved mysteries worth discussing and debating. Therefore, the game includes some unverified conjectures that may not align with mainstream views and are the author's personal interpretations, provided for reference only. 'Along the River During the Qingming Festival' mainly showcases the ships, bridges, houses, marketplaces, festive activities, and cultural customs of the Northern Song Dynasty. The details are so vivid it's as if the social landscape of that time was captured by a camera. On that wooden bridge with no pillars, whose manufacturing technique has long been lost, a crowd surges, with nearly a hundred merchants, officials, sailors, fishermen, and passersby filling the space. The streets are full of shops, signboards, and vendors, including fortune tellers, storytellers, bicycle repairmen, medicine sellers, doctors, barbers, touts, porters, sedan chair bearers, and gamblers - people from all walks of life. In terms of ships, it meticulously depicts the ship structure, detachable raise-and-lower stern rudder technology, anchor chain assembly, decoration styles of passenger and cargo ships, types of goods transported, and details of people's lives on boats such as cooking, worshiping, doing laundry, rowing, punting, sightseeing, and resting. Let's journey with Mr. Zhang Zeduan through the urban life of the Northern Song Dynasty 1100 years ago.
row.short_description: What if a game were made not for profit, but purely to spread culture and art? 'Along the River During the Qingming Festival' is such a game. The author approaches it with an academic attitude to study this masterpiece, aiming to let more people appreciate the folk customs of ancient China.

row.name: Astrometica: Prologue
row.detailed_description: SURVIVE IN SPACE Dive into Astrometica Prologue, a free space survival adventure where you're tested against the cosmos's harshest environments. This prologue offers a taste of our full game, featuring innovative systems for battery management, vehicle operation, crafting, and research to enrich your gameplay. It's more than survival; it's about strategy, adaptation, and exploration in the vast unknown—now accessible for free. Welcome to your cosmic playground and battlefield. Embark on this journey and conquer the mysteries of space. 🌠COLLECT USEFUL RAW MATERIALS: In Astrometica Prologue, the cosmos is rich with resources waiting to be discovered. You'll venture into the vast recesses of space and abandoned bases to collect dozens of raw materials, each integral to your survival and progression. Elevate your resource gathering with advanced technology: deploy drills to bore into the heart of asteroids and set up automatic miners, sophisticated machines designed to autonomously extract raw materials. This intricate system of resource collection not only fuels your journey but also immerses you in the role of a space pioneer, strategizing the best ways to utilize these assets for survival, crafting, and beyond. Embark on this adventure, where the wealth of the cosmos is yours to claim—all in the free prologue of Astrometica. ⚙️ CRAFTING AND TOOLS: In Astrometica Prologue, crafting is at the core of survival and exploration. With the resources you gather from the depths of space, you have the power to craft essential tools for your journey. From drills that penetrate asteroid cores, to lasers that cut through the unknown, and base builders that allow you to establish your own corner in the cosmos—each tool is vital for survival. But it doesn’t stop there; modifications are available to enhance every tool’s efficiency and adaptability to the challenges you face. Moreover, your survival kit can be expanded with crafted items crucial for enduring the harsh space environment. Shield modules to protect against cosmic hazards, oxygen tanks for extended ventures, and a jetpack to navigate the zero-gravity realms with ease. Each crafted item is designed to boost your capabilities—whether it’s speeding across asteroid fields, bolstering your defenses against unforeseen dangers, or expanding your carry capacity to hoard more resources. Astrometica Prologue invites you to leverage these crafting opportunities to tailor your survival strategy. Strengthen your arsenal, optimize your gear, and ensure your survival in the sprawling universe of Astrometica. Your ingenuity and resourcefulness are your best allies in this grand space adventure. 🏗️ BASE BUILDING: Base building in Astrometica Prologue transcends mere survival—it's about creating a stronghold that reflects your strategic prowess and innovative spirit. Even in this free version, you are empowered to establish a robust base that serves not just as a shelter, but as your operations center against the backdrop of space's infinite challenges. Living quarters are just the beginning. Here, you can rest, plan your next moves, and safeguard your collected resources. Energy is a critical aspect of survival, and Astrometica Prologue allows you to harness the power of the cosmos through solar panels. These installations ensure your base remains operational, powering everything from life-support systems to research labs. A vehicle station adds another layer of depth to your base, serving as a hub for crafting, upgrading, and deploying vehicles essential for exploration and resource collection. It's not just about building a base; it's about creating a foundation for expansion, exploration, and domination of the cosmic frontier. In Astrometica Prologue, your base is more than a sanctuary—it's a testament to your journey, growth, and resilience in the vastness of space. 🔭 SIGNAL FOLLOWING: In Astrometica Prologue, your adventure is guided by the pursuit of signals and the exploration of enigmatic territories. Within this free version, two primary types of signals beckon you into the unknown, each promising new discoveries and challenges. These signals might lead you to resource-rich asteroids, abandoned outposts, or reveal new mysteries to unravel within the cosmic expanse. 🚀 SPACE SHIPS: In Astrometica Prologue, you'll have access to two types of spacecraft, each designed to enhance your exploration and survival in space. First, the fast space bike: sleek, agile, and perfect for quick reconnaissance or darting between asteroids and mysterious islands where gravity binds you to the surface. It's your go-to for speed and efficiency. The second is a more advanced ship, a versatile vessel equipped not only for travel but survival. It serves as a mobile base of sorts, providing a crucial source of oxygen and basic protection against the harshness of space. This ship is ideal for longer voyages, offering safety and sustenance as you delve deeper into the unknown of Astrometica Prologue. Your space survival odyssey is about to commence. The cosmos await you in Astrometica: Prologue - are you ready to venture into the unknown? 🚀
row.short_description: Astrometica: Prologue is the free game about surviving in space. You need to use your skills and tools to stay alive. There are many challenges to face, and you need to fight to survive. You also need to build a new base in space.

row.name: Pantheon Rift Prototype
row.detailed_description: Pantheon Rift is a prototype/prologue to our future unannounced title. Pantheon Rift will be released as a playable, but aspects are subject to change. Step into the battle of this thrilling party-style battle arena, where your only weapon is medieval style weapons and your sole objective is to take down other players while avoiding the constant environmental chaos and destruction. The game is designed to be fast-paced and intense, with matches lasting just a few minutes each. To emerge victorious, players must navigate through a destructible environment that is full of obstacles and dangers, and use their sword skills to defeat their opponents. Adaptability and strategy are essential, as the environment can change rapidly, leaving players vulnerable to surprise attacks from both other players and the environment itself. As the game progresses, the stakes get higher, and the environment becomes more chaotic and destructive, making survival even more challenging. Only the strongest and most skilled players will be able to emerge as champions. With its unpredictable environment and high-octane action, this party-style battle arena promises an exhilarating gaming experience. Grab your sword, stay alert, and fight for your life! Core Features The Weather System - contend with not only your enemies, but the weather too. We won’t give too much away, but let’s say you’re an archer, maybe you fire into the wind and the arrow loses its speed, perhaps it will do less damage? Game is entirely made in Unreal Engine 5, with striking graphics allowing for full immersion. Souls-Like combat where you will be swiping with your sword, dodging, and staggering your way to victory. Hundreds of cosmetics from steel armors to silly baker’s aprons.
row.short_description: Get ready for a thrilling party-style battle arena where your only weapon is a sword. Take down other players while avoiding environmental chaos and destruction. The fast-paced matches and unpredictable environment require quick thinking, adaptability, and strategy.

row.name: Greedfall II: The Dying World Playtest
Earth~Quack
row.detailed_description: Earth~Quack is an adventure focused game with some survival elements where you play as a young boy on a mission to save a group of lost little ducklings and return them to their worried mother. As you journey through these lands you will encounter many things that will both help and hinder you in your quest to save the ducklings: Exploiting the Environment - As you travel you will need to harvest materials from the local environment in order to craft many tools that will aid you in your journey, ranging from hard hitting baseball bats, to long range sling-shots, to fancy flying boomerangs. Utilize Earth~Quack's inventory and crafting system to make tools both simple and complex. Furthermore, local flora can also be a bounty for many delicacies that may prove fruitful in tight situations. However, be careful, as it is not only you that might find these foods to be quite delicious. Fending off Wild Beasts - With your newfound tools, you will be able to face harder and harder foes. It may be simple at first with squirrels and bees being quite easy to fend off; however, as you progress you will encounter more and more difficult beasts. This may range from dangerous encounters with venomous snakes in the scorching sands of the desert to fending off ferocious alligators in the moss filled waters of the swamp, both of which may need stronger equipment to fend off. Save the Ecosystem - Your journey ultimately culminates in a final encounter with the mighty Mountain Goat, who resides at the tallest peak of the nearby mountain range, constantly ramming into the mountainside causing vicious earthquakes, or 'Earth~Quacks' as the locals refer to them, in the lands below. These constant disturbances spark fear and anger into the animals of the local ecosystems. Time and time again they are uprooted from their homes, taking out their frustration on the nearest thing to them. Your journey now becomes not only one of saving some little ducklings, but saving entire ecosystems.
row.short_description: Journey your way through environments both peaceful and harsh, seeking to save the lost ducklings as you fend off wild beasts angered by constant disturbances. Exploit local ecosystems to craft means of protection as you seek to stop the source of the fabled 'Earth~Quacks'

row.name: Scurri
row.detailed_description: Careful! You are a small squirrel lost in the woods in the dead of winter. While searching for your missing family you spot them on a small island, trapped. You need to rescue them! You must now search your environment for five keys in the snow, all while avoiding the very hunters that captured your parents before they freeze to death in the cold. This is a small 2D puzzle game in which you are a small squirrel exploring a dimly lit and dreary environment in order to find five keys so that you can save your family from impending peril, all while avoiding the overwhelming hunters which trapped you parents originally. Key Features In this game you’ll: Explore an actively hostile environment. Search for several keys lost in the snow. Avoid the hunters and see as they slowly starve in the snow without their access to food Watch as the environment degrades with each collected key. Save your family from the desperate hunters! Thank You! Scurridaes is composed of a small group of developers who imagined, designed, and built this game in the span of twelve weeks, all while learning the basics of game design, scripting, and programming as university freshmen.
row.short_description: Scurri is an action-adventure indie game in which you play as a young squirrel who is searching for the means in which to save your family from certain peril, while you avoid peril yourself from the hunters that hide in the darkness around you!
row.notes: A squirrel gets killed and eaten in some end scenes, and the werewolves have a minor amount of blood on their teeth.

row.name: Custom Party
row.detailed_description: Custom Party, the free indie online party game based on customization ! Custom Party is a party game for 2 to 8 players online . It contains a unique customization system and lots of mini-games to play ! Which makes this game a great experience to play with friends or even in competition! All elements of customization for your character are essential ! Choose your hats, shoes, tops, and colors wisely! All items affect your playstyle by changing stats or even powers ! Combined with the fact that it is a multiplayer game, this gives each playthrough a unique experience ! All hats, tops, bottoms and colors will not be paid for, all items are completely free. We are introducing an innovative new ranking system called « Take A Risk ! » ! It works by choosing a number of Ranking Points that you must stake in each game you play ! So this gives players who feel underranked a chance to face higher ranked players by taking a risk ! Additionally, it encourages cautious players to bet less, and slowly but surely progress to new ranks ! Everyone can play however they want !
row.short_description: Custom Party is a free indie party-game. Players can use different powers (dash, explosion...) and have different stats based on their character customization. It introduces an innovative ranking system named «Take a Risk». The game allows everybody to play in the playstyle they want.

row.name: Day at the Office - Prologue
row.detailed_description: Roadmap Next Fest and Next Steps [Feedback Survey Open!] Next Fest has started and several people are already trying out the Day at the Office Prologue demo. I'm currently working on fixing bugs and adding the remaining content in preparation for releasing the full game on Halloween (at which point the Demo will no longer be available). Improvements I'm working on: Full controller support. Voice actors. Bug fixes (Graphics and gameplay issues such as dead ends). Design changes to some confusing puzzles. General UI improvements. Ending/Content expansion + 'Good' ending. Achievements. Just in case I'm leaving something out or just to take into account your opinion as players, I've created a short survey so that, if you have 5 minutes to spare, you can help me improve. Survey link available in the 'Discussions' section: Thanks to everyone who is trying out Day at the Office Prologue! Roadmap ABOUT THE FUTURE OF DAY AT THE OFFICE Scheduled for release on October, 'Day at the Office - Prologue' will offer an initial experience of the game in a Free to Play format. This is a free introduction to the series, future titles and content will be paid. About the Game 'Work is good for your health! Or so they say, right?' SYNOPSIS You wake up in the middle of the office, but... you shouldn't be there anymore. Try to escape from a maze of rooms that will test your wits while you answer the phone to a malicious entity that knows a lot about you. You don't have time to waste... the phone is already ringing. SURVIVE You will have to endure the stress in the office, but don't worry, you'll have some tools to help you: Anxiolytic Meds Gun Lighter 'Not too many resources, right? They wouldn't pay so much if it were easy...' FIGHT OR FLIGHT 'Does making decisions under pressure stress you out? That wasn't in your resume...' The sound of the phone won't be your only enemy. Facing horrors or running from them when possible is an important decision. Think fast and act, but remember... bullets are limited. DO YOUR JOB... OR NOT Each time you answer a call, the entity will try to learn more about what you think about your past, or perhaps test you. The only rule at work is to answer with a simple 'Yes' or 'No.' Picking up the phone or not, and the answer you give if you dare to answer, will change your fate within the office. INVESTIGATE 'I hope you're not one of those who takes sick leave over any little problem... Death doesn't mean the end.' The situations you face may have multiple solutions. Try different options, think again about that call, or thoroughly investigate the places you find, and who knows... maybe little by little you'll find a way to cheat your fate at work.
row.short_description: Try to escape from the office, make your decisions carefully, and keep your cool to get home safe and sound... Do you hear that...? The phone is ringing, and it's for you.
row.notes: This game may contain content not suitable for all ages or to be viewed at work: Frequent violence or gore, self-harm, General mature content.

row.name: Culling of Normality
row.detailed_description: This game is a psychological horror VN set on a rural farm in middle-America. It is very short, taking only 15-20 minutes to read through once. It was made for the farmjam2024, and panic horror jam over the course of a month by a single person (myself). The theme of the game is really simple: What do you do when your memory seems to be unreliable, and not line up with what you can see in front of you?
row.short_description: 'A very short psychological horror Visual novel. My first ever game made for a gamejam.'
row.reviews: “I love how you crafted a story that can be so ambiguously interpreted. It really leaves it up to the viewer paint their own narrative with the context clues laid out in the story!” Itchio “This was a really nice read. I didn't know what to expect from it, but after getting what I think was all the endings it came full circle.” itchio “Wow, fantastic art! Makes me want to leave my job, pull a Stardew Valley, and move to the countryside right away. :) Of course, the peaceful opening tone makes... the twist that much more radical and gripping. I am ambivalent about the choice to speak about the player character in the third person. Most games would say 'I' or 'you.' Saying 'The Farmer' puts a little distance between the player and the player character.” itchio
row.notes: off-screen child deaths, mention of a miscarriage.

row.name: Magic Archery
row.detailed_description: Train your archery skills by crafting and shooting targets. Complete quests for gold and clout. Buy upgrades to improve training and equipment. Help train the greatest archer! No In-App purchases A short and active incremental/upgrade game Definite ending
row.short_description: Train a commoner to become the greatest archer in this short incremental game! Increase your stats, gather wealth from quests, buy upgrades, and infuse your arrows with magic.

row.name: IKEV
row.detailed_description: Lost your mind stamping a stool? Failed to understand the manual? Had to move back to your parents after these setbacks? Not anymore! IKEV is a simulator kindly designed to prepare you for the challenges of moving into your new home. Step into the 'Training Void', a virtual space where your modern apartment awaits, and encounter various tasks that mimic real-life moving scenarios. From dealing with incomplete orders to having no manuals, every aspect of the moving process is meticulously recreated to provide an immersive learning experience! Your assigned audio assistant will be your trusty guide throughout the simulation. Whether you need advice on organizing your belongings or assistance with troubleshooting definitely not purposefully created problems, your assistant is there to provide advice, encouragement, and even the occasional dose of... tough love? Ready to master the art of moving? Prepare yourself for the ultimate test in IKEV! Features Four fully interactable furniture pieces to build 🤩 Zero manuals to follow 🤑 Hidden extra hard puzzles to solve 🤯 Learning fake Norwegian to understand what you have to build 🇳🇴 A cute voice assistant!! 💁‍♀️
row.short_description: IKEV is a furniture assembling simulator in VR where the main antagonist is a lack of manuals! Be creative and resourceful, work through the incorrectly delivered orders, and stay diligent in furnishing your apartment.

row.name: Hidden Corgi Mansion
row.detailed_description: Hidden Corgi Mansion - is a relaxing hidden object game. Explore an abandoned mansion in search of cute corgi puppies and collect toys so they have something to play with. Features: An old mansion with atmospheric rooms 125 hidden objects Endless hints Saving progress Relaxing music Artist:  Vampy_Art
row.short_description: Hidden Corgi Mansion - is a relaxing hidden object game. Explore an abandoned mansion in search of cute corgi puppies and collect toys so they have something to play with. Woof, woof! 🐶

row.name: Unnatural Selection
row.detailed_description: “Four Player Party-Shooter Featuring Cute Animals Wielding Wacky Guns.” Play as animals and fight your friends to win the tournament! Eliminate the most players to win the round! Use the terrain, traps, and events to your advantage to take home the win! - Fight with a variety of unique guns, including weapons such as the Plunge-O-Matic and the D.A.R.T. Gun! - Play with a wacky cast of characters, from Foxes to Whales! - Events add an additional level of crazy to gameplay, changing the movement and the environment! - Player with the most wins after 4 rounds will take home the Victory! - Watch out for that hammer!
row.short_description: Four Player Party-Shooter Featuring Cute Animals Wielding Wacky Guns! Play as animals and fight your friends to win the tournament, eliminating the most players to win the round!

row.name: Whispers of silence
row.detailed_description: Dive into the haunting narrative of 'Whispers of Silence,' a first-person exploration game where every object tells a story, and every note reveals a fragment of the past. You step into the shoes of a friend of Nolan Blackwood, guided by a cryptic invitation back to his home. With no one to greet you but the echoes of your footsteps, you engage in detailed interactions - opening doors, switching lights, inspecting objects, and reading through forgotten notes - to piece together the story of a family.
row.short_description: Dive into the haunting narrative of 'Whispers of silence' a first-person exploration game where every object tells a story and every note reveals a fragment of the past.

row.name: Sunset Motel: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Step into the enchanting embrace of the free version of Sunset Motel! A haven that caresses weary souls, and encourages travelers to pause and unwind. In this one-of-a-kind simulation experience, start on a journey to breathe life into dilapidated rooms and ensure the radiant smiles of your cherished guests. Building on Guest Satisfaction: Experience the stunning transformation of Sunset Motel's rooms! Use vibrant colors on walls, lay new tiles, and adorned with stylish furnishings for unparalleled guest comfort and blissful peace of mind. Use Your Own Creativity: Welcome to your motel! This game offers complete freedom in creating a unique space. You decide on every detail. The design of rooms, entertainment areas, and even the pool - all depends on your creativity. Take control and craft a motel that reflects only your unique visions! Manage your motel: The success of your motel is measured by the smiles of your guests. As a savvy business owner, skillfully manage your team to ensure the happiness of every customer. Let your motel shine like a star in the hospitality universe, creating a haven where satisfaction is the brightest constellation. Entertainment and Recreation Facilities: No more boredom in your motel! Craft your own vibrant entertainment spaces and a refreshing pool. Design areas where your guests can unwind, have fun and create unforgettable memories. Your motel, their playground – let the excitement begin! Create a place where your travelers are comfortable and want to return every time. At Motel Kingdom, we believe that there is a place where everyone can relax and have fun.
row.short_description: Sunset Motel: Prologue is a free motel management game. Ensure customer satisfaction, renovate interiors, design entertainment spaces! Manage your motel in your own style and provide travelers with unforgettable experiences!

row.name: Bob Fight
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Bob Fight, the hilarious combat game where you play as fearless Bobs engaging in epic battles for survival! In this wacky party game, up to 4 players can duke it out in arenas filled with traps and dangers. Face off against your friends in furious fights where anything goes! Use hilarious moves, wacky tactics, and anything you can get your hands on to eject your opponents from the arena. Whether it's throwing cream pies, jumping on unstable platforms, or engaging in bare-knuckle brawls, every round victory brings you one step closer to ultimate glory. Collect crowns by winning rounds and be the first to reach the required number of crowns to be crowned the Bob Fight champion! With colorful graphics, comedic movements, and frantic action, Bob Fight is the perfect game for wild nights with friends. Prepare for hours of hilarious chaos, laughter, and fierce competition in Bob Fight. Who among you will become the king of the Bobs? Key Features: Hilarious combat for up to 4 players: Battle your friends in whimsical arenas where anything can happen! Wacky moves: Use ludicrous fighting techniques to eject your opponents from the arena. Interactive arenas: Avoid traps and use the environment to your advantage! Crown collection: Win rounds to earn crowns and become the ultimate Bob Fight champion! Colorful graphics and comedic animation: Dive into a world full of hilarious characters and absurd situations. Join the madness of Bob Fight and show your friends who the real brawl king is!
row.short_description: BobFight is a hilarious party game for 2 to 4 players where you play as quirky characters in a series of chaotic mini-games. Take on your friends in uproarious challenges, earn crowns, and become the undisputed king of the party! Who will be the last Bob standing? Find out in BobFight!

row.name: A Day in the Palace
row.detailed_description: Experience a historical Polish palace A Day in the Palace is a historical visual novel where the player's choices drive the story. You play as Peter and Marysia, newly arrived siblings at the palace in Lidzbark Warminski in 1772. Here you must learn to navigate the court, perform servant duties, and finally solve a mystery regarding a missing silver spoon. Talk to the servants of the palace to get hints that let you catch the culprit. The game's backdrop and story are based on historical sources. Choose your game mode There are two different modes of play. The novel mode is a longer visual novel combined with interactive minigames. The minigames include polishing pewter, lighting a fireplace with flint and steel, and making hot chocolate in 1700s fashion. The minigame mode features a shorter story with more emphasis on the minigames and is suitable for a younger audience. Can you solve the mystery?
row.short_description: Travel to Poland in 1772, experience life as a servant, and solve a mystery at court!

row.name: Scrambled Eggs
row.detailed_description: Scrambled Eggs is an action-packed chicken tower defense game, where we answer the age-old question 'Why did the chicken cross the road' . Take on the chicken hordes by sending wacky vehicles with interesting powers, to stop the clucking menace from attacking your corn crops. Some chickens you may encounter have been gifted strange abilities , that might throw a wrench in your mechanical mayhem. Collect the energy tokens that fuel your gasoline-guzzling Chariots . Place down heavy machinery to deal with the bird brains, with recharging ultimates . Fight through waves of chickens collecting cash to upgrade your capability to unleash more chicken carnage, with different vehicles, ultimate, and player upgrades to suit the best situations. Compete against your friends in our leaderboards to see who is the best at destroying these mother-cluckers .
row.short_description: 'Why did the chicken cross the road? It didn't.' Try to stop the chicken hordes with vehicular combat. Compete for high scores against your friends.

row.name: 小石冒险 Koishi Adventure⁓ Playtest
HIDDEN CATS: The last of cats
row.detailed_description: Test your attention and observation in this cozy and addictive hidden object game. Explore the drawn post-apocalyptic world and find cunningly hidden cute kitties. Cute background music will provide complete relaxation. This game perfect for all the family. Game Features: 101 hidden cats There is a hint The map is coloring 2.5D effect Adjust brightness Saving progress Scaling Relaxing music
row.short_description: Explore this mysterious post-apocalyptic world by finding cute cats and this black and white world will be colore.

row.name: Steel Symphony
row.detailed_description: Join the community here: Inspired by JaGeX's Steel Sentinels , Steel Symphony is a 2D Action-Strategy platformer where players choose from an assortment of components to build their robot, or sentinel. The key to formidable customization is creatively balancing & optimizing statistics such as integrity, shielding, mass, weapon capabilities, modular arrange, and equipment carried. Chassis configuration, weapon loadout, and module selection constitute the essence of a sentinel: Chassis are selected archetypally dependent on class such as runner, jumper, flier, tank, colossus, etc... that are further configured to fill multiple roles. Weapons are chosen based on damage, range, rate of fire, energy dependency, area of effect, synergy with other weapons, and additional effects. Modules are delegated to give the sentinel protection, maneuverability, extra power, and/or more complex effects.
row.short_description: Steel Symphony is a 2D Action-Strategy platformer where players craft combat sentinels by selecting components and balancing stats like integrity, mobility, and weapon capabilities. Chassis, weapons, and modules shape each sentinel's role with varied abilities for strategic customization.

row.name: Cosmotots
row.detailed_description: Get ready for an interstellar adventure like no other! COSMOTOTS: The ultimate third-person shooter team deathmatch. Step into the shoes of fearless toddler explorers as they face off against rival teams in thrilling arena battles. Experience stunning visuals, dynamic environments, and heart-pounding action as you immerse yourself in the whimsical yet dangerous world created by The Ministry of Cosmotots. With custom characters, diverse maps, and endless possibilities for epic showdowns, Cosmotots offers an exhilarating gaming experience that will keep you coming back for more. Arm yourself with an arsenal of futuristic weapons and gear designed specifically for our pint-sized heroes. Engage in intense multiplayer matches where teamwork and strategy are key to victory. Flank your opponents using hidden teleporters throughout the arena. Whether you're getting blasted or blasting the enemy, every match in Cosmotots is an adrenaline-fueled rush of excitement and chaos. Are you ready to join the Cosmotots and conquer the stars? Suit up, lock and load, and prepare for an adventure of astronomical proportions! Signed, The Ministry of Cosmotots ***************************************************** IMAGE DECLASSIFIED IMAGE DECLASSIFIED
row.short_description: A frantic third-person Team Deathmatch arena shooter. Flank your enemies using hidden teleporters, tunnels, and floating islands. First team to 30 takes the glory. Get your loadout ready, engage in intense matches, and conquer the stars!

row.name: Startup Quest Bakery
row.detailed_description: Dive into the world of social entrepreneurship with Startup Quest Bakery, a brief simulation game that challenges you to set up and run a bakery social enterprise successfully. This game serves as a dynamic introduction to startup operations, putting your strategic decision-making to the test. The Challenge You've made it to the final round of a prestigious European Union competition, contending for a grand prize by demonstrating your prowess in managing a socially responsible bakery. The ultimate test? Navigate a multi-area game simulation where your mission is to 'escape' by establishing a thriving business within 36 months. Explore dedicated rooms—Action, Knowledge, Skills, and Sustainable—to make informed decisions. Achieve profitability while making a positive social impact and minimizing environmental footprints. Getting Started Before the flour settles, you'll tackle critical steps like securing necessary permits and conducting market research to finely tune your product offerings to the community's needs. From selecting the perfect location to choosing sustainable energy options and the right bakery equipment—every decision counts. Strategic Choices Opt between essential business elements such as insurance and energy sources (like going solar). Your bakery’s success hinges on these decisions along with the selection of skilled bakers and salespersons. Their unique talents will significantly influence customer satisfaction and operational efficiency. Operational Dynamics Once set up, take charge of monthly production decisions. Choose from an array of products including white bread, baguettes, whole grain bread, pretzels, and pita bread. Monitor your bakery's performance through straightforward financial reports, adjusting strategies as needed to ensure growth and sustainability. Social Entrepreneurship As a social entrepreneur, balance is key. Your role involves harmonizing economic viability with social responsibility and environmental stewardship. Embark on your Startup Quest Bakery adventure and show the world the impact a socially conscious bakery can make!
row.short_description: Embark on a brief entrepreneurial journey to establish and manage a socially responsible bakery. Obtain permits, prepare the space, choose your equipment, and produce various breads. Aim for profitability while positively impacting society and the environment.

row.name: Thorns: Police never sleeps
row.detailed_description: 'Tell me, do you sleep enough, Mr. Doe? The police never sleeps.' © Thorns: Police never sleeps is a kinetic visual novel that tells the tragic story of a young police officer. Ocean 17 is a city that makes no exceptions. It doesn't care how much money, friends or abilities you have. This is a city that is always ready to move forward towards a bright future, destroying and digesting millions of human lives in its belly. High-quality illustrations that will help you completely immerse yourself in the gloomy atmosphere of the game Sci-fi music SFX accompaniment And of course, a fascinating plot, which became the basis for creating a unique Thorns universe. We invite you to immerse yourself in the atmosphere of urbanism and cybernetic technology with the first game in the series. Duration Approximately 1.5 hours of story and 10+ backgrounds. row.name: Slime Mayhem
row.detailed_description: Mutant Slimes, created to eat garbage waste in a mutant slime production laboratory called Slamus, got out of the control of scientists and began to eat people in the laboratory instead of garbage waste. Collect chemicals to get items from the store to further survive and destroy waves of enemies.
row.short_description: You were created by a few scientists for a suicide mission. How long can you survive by clearing mutant slimes?

Beware of Balbazar in this horror/psychological thriller adventure. Evade the enigmatic Balbazar, use your wits and homemade sleuth kit to capture proof that something ominous is happening, and make it out alive. Do not get caught. row.name: Aliens and Asteroids
row.detailed_description: Explore the laboratory complex, solve problems to move on, find secret documents and don't let the aliens catch you... Meteor shower A meteor shower that passes over the earth leads to the appearance of strange creatures. The meteorite impact sites were surveyed by employees of secret organizations and the fragments were taken to laboratories for study. Soon, workers leave one of these laboratories for unknown reasons. You are a legendary journalist who goes to this laboratory to find out where these asteroids came from and who these creatures are. Laboratory complex A secret laboratory was built deep in the forest for the purpose of studying alien technology. All the UFO debris was taken there and captured aliens were also kept there. Extraterrestrial technologies Study alien technologies located in the complex, such as lasers, teleports, bombs, to clear the way for yourself. Solve puzzles caused by laboratory accidents and try to get to the bottom of the truth... Aliens There are aliens in the laboratory and they are not at all harmless. Be careful and avoid contact with them, it will end badly.
row.short_description: The legendary journalist sets out to investigate an incident that occurred in a laboratory for the study of extraterrestrial technologies. But this trip is not complete without unexpected guests...

row.name: Hollow Survivors: Prologue

row.name: Super Hangman
row.detailed_description: Introducing Super Hangman – the coolest hangman game made just for kids! Get ready for a super fun way to learn and play with words! In Super Hangman, kids get to go on a word-solving adventure filled with vibrant colors and awesome animations. It's like diving into a world where learning feels like a game! Guessing the secret word before the hangman appears is the name of the game. Every right guess gets you closer to victory, but watch out for those wrong ones – they add a dash of suspense to the excitement! From animals to sports, fruits to planets, Super Hangman covers tons of topics to keep the fun going. And with its easy-to-use setup, kids can jump right into the action without any hassle. Whether you're playing solo or challenging your friends, Super Hangman guarantees a blast while boosting your language skills. It's the ultimate combo of learning and entertainment! row.short_description: Super Hangman: the ultimate kids' word game! With colorful graphics and exciting challenges, it's a fun way to learn new words. Guess right, avoid the hangman, and expand your vocabulary across various topics. Let the word adventure begin!

row.name: Ghost For Hire
row.detailed_description: It is a little known fact that ghosts have the option to pursue an occupation even after death. Under the Ghost Protection Management, ghosts will become agents that are tasked to maintain control over areas that are high in spiritual energy. The actions carried out by the Ghost Protection Management have not gone unnoticed by mortals, but they have been generally known as “hauntings” as mortals are not aware of the organization’s existence. After being given a contract, agents will be sent to the location they have been assigned to. Agents are tasked with surveying the personnel, progressively spooking them with efficiency, and scaring them out of the location. In accordance with company policy, agents are allocated funds to spend on gadgets to help them during missions. Step 1: Survey Surveillance and reconnaissance. You will learn the behavioral traits and weaknesses of your targets in order to think about how to deal with them, along with taking into account how to use the environment against them. Step 2: Spook Using all that you've learned from Survey, you will compile a list of abilities and use your knowledge of what to interact with in the environment in order to progressively spook your targets. Target behavior will be affected the more spooked they are and there will be numerous types of reactions. Step 3: Scare The targets believe in the supernatural and now your power is unstoppable. You can manifest yourself in front of the target causing them to run away from the protected properties in fear!
row.short_description: Welcome to Ghost for Hire! As the newest hire for the Ghost Protection Management, your job is to drive off mortal trespassers from various protected properties. Use our state-of-the-art equipment to survey the environment, spook the intruders, and scare them into believing in the supernatural!

Peter's Journey

In this text-based RPG you will go on a journey and see the world through the Peter ’s eyes. You will meet other heroes, each of whom can influence the course of history. Will you rescue the beautiful stranger? Help a kind old lady? Fulfill a fellow traveler's request? It depends only on you whether Peter can overcome the challenges and fulfill his dream. Study the stories of heroes . Explore the heroes’ stories. Defeat bandits. Upgrade your characteristics. And don’t forget to take a diary: it will help you make the right choice. Our Team We are a small development studio specializing in VR and AR projects. 'Peter’s Journey' is our debut project in Steam and a new experience in creating 2D-games. The prototype of the game was developed by a studio employe while completing the task in the final of the second season of the All-Russian competition “Start the Game” in the competence of Unity Developer. The project is completely non-commercial, it is created for the purpose of gaining experience, knowledge and new emotions on pure enthusiasm. We will be very glad to receive any feedback, suggestions, criticism and comments!
row.short_description: Embark on a journey of this text anime quest with RPG elements! Walk through beautiful locations, overcome challenges and make Peter’s dreams come true. Every step you take matters. And don’t forget to take the diary - you’ll need it!

row.name: Playing Kafka
row.detailed_description: The definitive Kafka videogame Although you did nothing wrong, you were arrested one morning. You arrived for work, but you don’t recognize your assistants. And your upbringing left you with a pervasive sense of guilt. Welcome to Playing Kafka, an adventure about the alienation of modern society as well as unresolved family issues. The game adapts three works of the famously absurdist writer and was created with leading Kafka experts. Can you manage to win an unfair trial? Is the job even real? Can you escape your father’s crushing presence? How do you move forward, when all solutions are obfuscated by a web of unclear rules and machinations… a fully voiced branching story, based on Kafka’s The Trial, The Castle and Letter To His Father atmospheric puzzles, fateful decisions and a drag and drop gameplay that makes characters and environments come alive approximately 1.5 hour of story in an ever-changing setting You face an opaque legal trial and are slowly sucked into a web of perplexing bureaucracy. It is up to you how to approach the vague, but insidious accusation – choose who to ask for help and how to talk to judges, procurators, and others as the judgment is slowly closing in on you. Does it even matter if you’re innocent? Drawing inspiration from Kafka's unsent confession to his father, this chapter delves into their tense relationship. Try to find the right words that helped Kafka come to terms with his upbringing. See Franz struggle to connect with his father in scenes from the past. Is there any hope of reconciliation? You arrive at a snow-laden village to work as a land surveyor, but you quickly find that nothing is as it seems – locals talk about the village Castle in hushed tones and each day brings more questions than answers. Will you ever be accepted by the forever out-of-reach Castle? The game was developed to commemorate the centenary of Kafka’s death and was developed in cooperation with the Goethe-Institut, Prague. ​The Chinese language version was initiated and supported by the Czech Centre Taipei.
row.short_description: There are things that often fail on nothing but themselves. Is there even a way out? Playing Kafka is a narrative adventure full of impenetrable schemes, insidious plot twists and conversations that slip out of hand. Based on Kafka’s life and his work, developed with Kafka experts.
row.reviews: “They continue to push the boundaries of what games can achieve, bringing classic literature to life in a fresh and exciting way.” Adventure Gamers “The weight of words in each sentence from Playing Kafka has intense, unforgettable emotional impact.” 9/10 – Indian “As somebody who is no stranger to Kafka’s work, I have to say one thing to developers: good job.” 8/10 – Vortex

row.name: Ember Point
row.detailed_description: Support Ember Point requires the use of a GamePad controller. This game is compatible with computers operating on Windows systems. For the best experience, we recommend using headphones. About the Game A Combination of Melee and Shooting Experience gruesome combat against different enemy types. Switch between a heavy-hitting pickaxe and the Wave Gun to juggle the unrelenting attacks. An Over-Heated World In 2075, most humans migrated to a distant planet as Earth succumbs to the effects of The Overheating. Radiation exposure then caused a disease called Gradual Hyperthermia (GH) that slowly wiped out the remaining survivors on Earth. GH caused hallucinations, unexplained rage, hyper-strength, and emanating heat. Once it reaches its ember point, the survivors, once human, will become monstrous creatures simply waiting for its demise. Discover the Past Play as Gravitus, an ex-soldier and now researcher tasked by Katani Industry to return to Earth. His mission is to explore the possible GH cures, but he crash lands in a desolate town. Explore the ghost town, face the mutated, monster-like heat vacuums, and find out what happened to the townspeople. The Team Ember Point was a capstone game made by a group of eight undergrad students at the NYU Game Center. Bader AlQahtani Beck Mamus Carson Gilford Donovan Robinson Erna Balayan Ginele Tannis Juliana Soranno Yibing (Edith) Chen Contributors: Finn Connoly, Ryan Bevins, Hongke Luo, Peter Seo, Annie Dedas, Noa Kirschbaum, Draftsman79_
row.short_description: Ember Point is a red-hot, combat-focused, third-person action game. Play as a disgraced defector, Gravitus, from a militaristic mega-corporation. He is stuck cleaning up the mess his former employers left behind — all while wielding a top secret “cure” for a gruesome disease.
row.notes: This game features frequent combat scenarios with the main character smashing, kicking, and shooting the enemies. There are visuals of blood splashing. Some finishing moves show enemy dismemberment. Strong language is used in the dialogue.

row.name: Unfinished
row.detailed_description: a (horror style, not violent) game, in pixel art. Welcome to the world of Unfinished. It seems like a world without obstacles, without enemies, just everything as it is in reality. Or is it? Is there a chance of survival? Is there a way out? Can you unravel the secrets that symbolize this world? Or are you just alone in a world filled with monsters? Fear strengthens every monster, they know your every move! And you're just a woman trapped in a forest, longing for home! Does the path seem easy, or difficult? But are you even surprised if you die? Or are you surprised? In truth, there is no real truth about the monsters, but maybe they will be the fate of the world?! Perhaps you will be engulfed in infinite madness, or submerged?! The monsters are always ready to kill you, but you never know WhEn IT WIlL HAPPEN! You must survive every persecution that follows; surely there will be enemies (Because they are always needed, am I not right?) who will pursue you! But maybe something..., something wants to catch you. (Let's say each enemy wants to catch you). You must survive everything before the danger comes for you, you must not get too close to the monsters, for they will defeat you. Before you encounter any monster, you are at peace... (in theory) but maybe you never make it home, because that was actually your purpose. There's only one thing, there may be no way out! If you need to run, RUN! , Nothing stops survival, nothing at all. So, maybe you're not safe. But then again, maybe you are? 'Unfinished' tells a story where the monsters don't behave typically, their goals aren't ordinary either. Perhaps, in the end, you won't even uncover the secret that revolves around this game, as it forms the essence of the game's narrative. And if someone figures it out, they understand why each monster is the way it is. The main antagonist isn't just some hastily assembled entity; it's a significant monster with a twisted mind. What the monsters need is safety, peace, and human suffering. Typically, this is what people imagine when they create monsters, but for them, it's something else entirely. They don't need these things; they need their old lives back, before they became monsters. While you're trying to defeat the enemy, it won't matter who's who; you'll just be running from them. There are those who aren't hostile, and you might befriend them, but who knows if they can be trusted?
row.short_description: a game, in pixel art.

General Roadmap New Level Types More Dynamic Cosmetics Better rewards Recurring Challenge system More leader-boards for stats & new levels More player upgrades and abilities Power ups Background / Scene changes UI overhaul
row.short_description: Lost and alone in a cave, you start your adventure jumping and ducking your way through enemies and different environments. Collect coins to upgrade your player & unlock new abilities and cosmetics. Maybe then you will become the top traveler...

row.name: Owe Money Pay Money
row.detailed_description: In the bustling streets of Shiokmenistan, where the scent of success once lingered, now stands Big Chief, a hoodie-clad enforcer with a score to settle. Fed up with being swindled and left high and dry by his elusive debtors, Big Chief embarks on a quest for justice... and cold hard cash! Welcome to Owe Money Pay Money (O$P$), a retro-infused brawl-fest like no other! Crafted by a plucky team of fresh-faced developers hailing from the heart of Singapore, this free-wheeling side-scroller is a love letter to pop culture, packed to the brim with puns, innuendos, and an electrifying 8-bit soundtrack that'll have your head bopping as you crack skulls. But O$P$ isn't just your run-of-the-mill beat 'em up - it's a wild ride through a world teeming with tongue-in-cheek nods to Singaporean culture and 80's nostalgia. With its eye-popping pixel art and toe-tapping chip tunes, players are thrust into a whirlwind of action as they pummel their way through barmy foes and face off against formidable bosses. Plus, with an array of wacky weapons and power-ups at their disposal, you can add a little spice to the mayhem. So grab your hoodie, dust off your fists, and join Big Chief on a quest for restitution in this offbeat adventure that's sure to leave you grinning from ear to ear. Owe Money Pay Money isn't just a game, it's cathartic! P/S: O$P$ clinched 'Best Video Game' at the inaugural Asian Academy Creative Awards for its captivating backstory and classic design.
row.short_description: Big Chief embarks on a quest for justice & cold hard cash in this retro brawler. Packed with eye-popping pixel art, 8-bit bangers, & a Singaporean twist, it’s as bizarre as beat ‘em ups get. Welcome to Owe Money Pay Money (O$P$)!

row.name: Myth Matrix
row.detailed_description: I made this game all by myself. Yes, it is a real-time online PvP card battle game. I’ve finally managed to made it, congrats to myself 😊 Due to the love of traditional card battle games and to lower the learning curve, I adopted the very basic rules, and added lots of innovative and fun features and cards. For example, a board with slots, Terrain system, Trap mechanism, and fun keywords such as Spy, Melee, Ranged, Provoke, Thorn, etc. I’ll keep updating new and fun stuff (lots of works are planned). If you find this game enjoyable, please share with others. It’s very helpful to a real indie developer. Much obliged! If you’ve also fantasized new cards or gameplay features, you’re welcomed to share your imaginations and other feedbacks. Talk to me and find other players on discord or other SNS. (see links below) Shoutout for Komar, who’s helped me with Polish translation.
row.short_description: A Turn-based strategic card battle game. Collect cards, develop your unique deck and strategy, and have a fun PvP match with players all over the world!

row.name: 1306 Chapter 1: Reactors & Robots
row.detailed_description: 1306 is a third-person story game where you play as a reactor maintenance bot labeled 1306, tasked with keeping the power plant from exploding. In this beginning chapter, it's up to 1306 to fix the reactor and prevent a total meltdown! However, they quickly learn that the task is more of a challenge than they initially thought... The reactor is somehow drained and missing all three coolant rods. It's up to you to retrieve the rods from the warehouse and place them in the reactor's base before it can be filled back up! Journey down to the warehouse to collect the rods! With the help of your trusty wrench, get the lights on! Keep a good balance on your way! Escape... Most importantly! Prevent the place from being wiped off the map! Good Luck, 1306! Total playtime(100% playthrough): 25-35 minutes Controls: W,A,S,D or Up, Left, Right, Down Arrow for Movement T: Equip Wrench/Battery E:  Interact with objects ​F: Flashlight Q: Objective Screen Spacebar: Skip cutscenes and dialog Numpad*: Go into freecam mode
row.short_description: Join 1306, a little reactor maintenance robot, on a terrifying new adventure filled with robotic horrors! Get the rods. Fix the reactor. Prevent the meltdown! Most importantly, don't get disassembled.
row.notes: Features robotic and organic violence in some cutscenes

row.name: Knockout City - Private Server Edition
row.detailed_description: Knockout City is now available in a Private Server Edition, inviting brawlers everywhere to keep the brawl going by hosting servers for their Crews. Team up and duke it out with rival Crews in Knockout City, where you settle the score with epic dodgeball battles. Brace yourself for outrageous fun and intense competition in an all-new take on team-based multiplayer games. Customize your character and form a Crew with friends to start your Knockout City takeover. Knock out opponents with trick shots and coordinated teamwork while dodging and catching balls flying across the map. No ball? No problem! You can literally ball up, roll into a teammate’s hands and become the ultimate weapon. A variety of outlandish ball types, locations and game modes keep it exciting. Plus, each season introduces new maps, ball types, rewards, events and challenges. Throw, catch, pass, dodge and tackle your way to dodgeball dominance. KEY FEATURES Frantic and Fun — Rule the city through lightning-fast multiplayer matches featuring mind-blowing dodgeball mechanics. Increase your attack by passing to power up dodgeballs, targeting your opponents with a variety of specialized balls or “balling up” at any time to get thrown by teammates. Crew Up — Assemble an all-star dodgeball Crew with your friends for multiplayer matches in a seamless cross-play experience. Together, knock out opponents in 3v3, 4v4 or free-for-all matches. Pass, throw and strategize as a team to dominate and unlock distinctive, Crew-only rewards. Define Your Style — Show off your status and unique look through character and Crew designs with expansive character creation options. Customize your appearance, gear and attitude — from body type and hairstyle to a custom glider and Crew vehicle to win, lose and taunt animations. Take On Knockout City — Battle it out with other Crews across dynamic maps all over the city. Each map’s special features make every match an intense, unexpected experience. Dodgeball thrives in back alleys with pneumatic tubes, on skyscraper rooftops, across busy streets and even at the local burger joint and construction sites. While you’re dodging dodgeballs, watch out for moving cars, rooftop drops, and even a wrecking ball or two. Strikingly Fresh Yet Familiar — It’s easy to pick up and play thanks to familiar controls, but practice is key to becoming a champion. On a level playing field, only the most skilled ballers stand out from the crowd. Use your knowledge to master the intricacies of the game for spectacular KOs.
row.short_description: Team up and duke it out with rival Crews in Knockout City, where epic dodgeball battles settle the score in team-based multiplayer matches. Throw, catch, pass, dodge, and tackle your way to dodgeball dominance!
row.reviews: “One of the best games this year” 90/100 – PC Gamer “Masterfully combines the best from both dodgeball and multiplayer shooters” 8.5/10 – Game Informer “One of the best team-based PvP games to come out in years” 9/10 – IGN

row.name: Interweaver
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the whimsical world of Interweaver, where magic, mystery, and adorable creatures await! In this charming puzzle platformer game, players step into the shoes of the Weaver, a courageous necromancy student tasked with a final assignment that delves into the depths of darkness. Set amidst the shadowy corridors and mysterious chambers of Sepultus Academia, players will navigate through beautifully crafted isometric landscapes filled with both wonder and trepidation. As the Weaver, you possess a unique blend of magic and determination, using your powers to unravel the secrets of the world and your academy and its sinister practices. But while your fellow students seek to capture familiars through nefarious means, your compassionate nature drives you to protect these otherworldly creatures from harm. Armed with your abilities, you embark on a perilous journey to thwart the academy's malevolent intentions and free the familiars from their cruel fates. Throughout your quest, you'll encounter a myriad of puzzling challenges and obstacles that will test your wit and courage. rom navigating treacherous terrain to outsmarting cunning adversaries, every twist and turn of the journey is shrouded in mystery and excitement. Interweaver's hauntingly beautiful visuals, combined with its captivating storyline and immersive gameplay, create an unforgettable gaming experience that will send shivers down your spine. So prepare to unravel the mysteries of Sepultus Academia and embark on a journey where magic and danger intertwine in the most unexpected ways.
row.short_description: Embark on a hauntingly beautiful journey in Interweaver, a whimsical puzzle platformer. Play as the Weaver, a necromancy student on a quest to rescue familiars from the clutches of Sepultus Academia. Unravel mysteries and use magic to weave your way through captivating landscapes.

row.name: WC Dream
row.detailed_description: P.S. From the developer: Hi. This game will take you back to childhood and make you the King of your imagination. You can build anything your imagination comes up with using basic items. There are no limits. I've tried to make it very simple and understandable for everyone. Enjoy the game, King. 🏰 Welcome to the exciting game 'WC Dream'✨! Here, every KING becomes a true architect of their own kingdom, where the only limitation is their imagination. You are the KING of your own throne, capable of creating anything you desire. Start by building your dream castle - a castle that embodies your wildest fantasies. Build it however you envision - the sky's the limit. Your throne will be a unique masterpiece of architecture. Create a throne that reflects your power and majesty. Sit upon it and enjoy the breathtaking view of your kingdom. Throughout the game, you will collect crowns to unlock new thrones and build anything the KING desires from basic materials. Game Features: There are 4 types of materials available: Water, Cement, Wood, Stone. Collect crowns to unlock Thrones. Explore the first level with stunning landscapes. Future Plans: Introduce new materials and shapes. Work on many new landscapes for construction: Mars, Winter, Caves, Forests, Space... Get ready for an exhilarating adventure in 'WC Dream'! Build, create, and rule your kingdom with immense satisfaction! YOU are the KING!
row.short_description: You are the KING of your own throne, capable of creating anything you desire. YOU are the KING!🏰

row.name: THRILLKINGS
row.detailed_description: THRILLKINGS is a fast-paced arena first-person shooter, inspired by games from the early 2000s, where mastering your character's movement and controlling all available arsenal is the key to total dominance. Play on a variety of modes like classic Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch, plus new modes like King of The Thrill, where players compete to hold control of the 'Thrill', a capture point that serves also as a drivable combat vehicle and can be used and exploited as a deadly weapon. Move at full speed with classic mechanics like bunny hopping, strafe jumping, rocket jumps, and precise air control which allows total 360 ° vertical view rotation in first person. Jump and move even faster with the Impulse Rifle, which allows you to grab objects around your environment and use them as projectiles, and change trajectory in a matter of seconds. Enjoy playing competitive with friends Online, or with Local Area Network support for old school LAN parties. 8 weapons, 4 maps and 2 Thrills available on Early Access, with many more already in the pipeline and coming soon! The game is currently on Early Access with much more to come. Please join us on the development and get future updates through Steam and Discord!
row.short_description: THRILLKINGS is a fast-paced Arena FPS with a set of weapons and movement inspired by games from the early 2000s. Compete in classic and new game modes, dominate your enemies through a variety of maps with unique traversal mechanics, and become the ultimate King.
row.notes: There is no sexual content of any kind in the game. The game has gore effects like blood and limbs flying when the player's body gets in contact with explosives like grenades or bullets. The game contains no depictions of drugs or alcohol.

row.name: Sorelle
row.detailed_description: Sorelle is a whimsical 3D puzzle-platformer that immerses you in the magical seaside town of Isola Chiara. Meet sisters Alessandra, Bella and Capri. Life in their seaside town goes astray when a violent storm destroys preparations for the annual summer festival and shatters the Duomo’s stained glass, scattering the magic of the town. The clock is ticking — the unrestrained magic seeks to return to the sea, the land, and the sky. Bestowed with fragments of this magic, the three sisters gain unique powers. Alessandra, the oldest and headstrong leader, harnesses the fluidity of the magic and gains the ability to levitate objects. Bella, the brash and brave middle sister, is granted strength to jump to new heights and break down obstacles. Capri, the curious and quiet youngest sister, is gifted with the ability to create light. The sisters realize it's up to them to save the summer festival and restore magic to the town. Swap between the three playable sisters and combine their unique powers to solve puzzles, explore the village, and strengthen the bonds of sisterhood. Includes three Charming Playable Protagonists. Dynamic puzzles that require creative use of every sisters’ power. Gorgeous and immersive Sicilian-inspired seaside scenery. A heartwarming and family-centric story. A whirling and magical original soundtrack.
row.short_description: Welcome to the magical world of Sorelle: a whimsical 3D puzzle-platformer that immerses you in the magical seaside town of Isola Chiara. Play as sisters Alessandra, Bella, and Capri as you explore the magic of sisterhood in a puzzle-solving adventure to restore magic and save the summer festival.

row.name: Atlas Online
row.detailed_description: Atlas Online: 2D MMORPG Pirate Adventure Welcome to Atlas Online, the 2D MMORPG pirate game! In this thrilling pirate adventure, fight for your own glory, conquer islands with your alliance, embark on new adventures, and rule the seas! Step into a world where every wave holds a treasure and danger lurks around every corner. Gather your crew, customize your ship, and venture into dangerous waters in search of fortune and fame. Form alliances, join epic battles, and emerge as the most feared pirate captain of the seven seas. With stunning visuals and immersive gameplay, Atlas Online offers an unforgettable adventure for anyone brave enough to embark on the journey. Are you ready to chart your own course, claim your destiny, and become a legend of the high seas? Join the adventure in Atlas Online today!
row.short_description: Welcome to Atlas Online, the 2D MMORPG pirate game! In this exciting pirate adventure, fight for your own glory, conquer islands with your alliance, embark on new adventures, and rule the seas!

row.name: Digital Audio Wasteland
row.detailed_description: In Digital Audio Wasteland, the apocalypse doesn't have to be bleak. In this comedic first person exploration game, you'll explore the wasteland, collect music from your surroundings, and mix it all together to bring bodacious beats back to the people-- all in the name of the GROOVE! As a member of the Monastic Order of the Groove, you will embark on an audacious adventure as a nameless acolyte of the GROOVE, a seeker of sonic treasures in a world on the brink. In Digital Audio Wasteland, the apocalypse isn't about survival—it's about throwing the ultimate rave amidst the ruins. Harness the power of music to reshape reality itself. Discover the hidden melodies of the world, whether they're natural harmonies or the beats you created, and wield them to craft radical tunes. These rhythms aren't just sounds—they're your companions, your tools, your ticket to revolutionizing the barren landscape around you in the form of musical magical little buddies. Encounter a cast of eccentric characters, each with their own stories and secrets waiting to be uncovered. Solve puzzles not with conventional means, but with the harmonious manipulation of sound itself, unlocking new beats as you explore. As you delve deeper into this quirky apocalypse, immerse yourself in a world where music reigns supreme. Your quest isn't just about throwing a party; it's about bringing hope, joy, and a sense of unity to a world content in its disarray by bringing joy back to the wasteland. Get ready to groove like never before, because the sickest party of the end times awaits. Are you prepared to be the maestro of the Digital Audio Wasteland? Made in the University of Utah's Games program.
row.short_description: In Digital Audio Wasteland, the apocalypse doesn't have to be bleak. In this comedic first person exploration game, you'll explore the wasteland, collect music from your surroundings, and mix it all together to bring bodacious beats back to the people-- all in the name of the GROOVE!

row.name: Warriors of Nova Thera Playtest
row.detailed_description: Warriors of Nova Thera is a dungeon crawler with roguelike elements. Make strategic choices and test your abilities against relentless waves of warrior denizens to see if you have what it takes to emerge victorious.
row.short_description: Warriors of Nova Thera is a dungeon crawler with roguelike elements. Make strategic choices and test your abilities against relentless waves of warrior denizens to see if you have what it takes to emerge victorious.

row.name: Der Königsruf
row.detailed_description: Der Königsruf ist ein kostenloses Trading-Card-Spiel. Im Spiel schlüpfen die Spieler in die Rolle des Herrn von Silberreiher Grat und erhalten und verwenden Karten, um Kreaturen zu beschwören, Zauber zu wirken und Monster zu besiegen, während sie durch verschiedene Regionen kämpfen und ihre Königreiche schützen.Es gibt viele Möglichkeiten, „Der Königsruf“ zu spielen. Die Spieler können aus Hunderten von verschiedenen Monster- und Zauberkarten wählen und sie miteinander kombinieren, um sie noch mächtiger zu machen. Sie können auch die Ressourcen Ihres Königreichs verwalten, um bessere Karten, Waffen und Ausrüstung für deine Charaktere zu erhalten. Sie können auch in 1v1-, 2v2- und 4v4-PvP-Arenen kämpfen oder Ihre Taktiken gegen AI-Gegner testen.
row.short_description: Beschütze dein Königreich | Verwalte die Ressourcen deines Königreichs, um bessere Karten, Waffen und Ausrüstung für deinen Charakter zu erhalten.Spieler gegen Spieler | Tritt in den 1v1-, 2v2- und 4v4-PvP-Arenen von den Königsruf an oder testen Sie Ihre Taktiken gegen AI-Gegner.

row.name: 사설탐정 프리즈
row.detailed_description: 'Private Detective, Freeze' is a single-player mystery game set in futuristic Korea. You play as Freeze, an amateur private detective, investigating the murder of Margarita's fiancé, Hwang Jong-ha. Freeze lives in an eight-floor city-building and must explore six rooms on the 4th floor to find clues about the four suspects. As you progress, you'll uncover more about their stories. But as things get serious, you'll have to make decisions that could change everyone's lives on the 4th floor. Can you solve the mystery and become the hero detective?
row.short_description: In 'Private Detective, Freeze,' set in futuristic Korea, you play as Freeze, an amateur detective, solving the murder of Hwang Jong-ha. Explore six rooms, gather clues, and unravel the connections between suspects and victim to uncover the truth.

row.name: Echocalypse: The Scarlet Covenant
row.detailed_description: Kemono Girl RPG has topped the free download list on App Store and Google Play in multiple countries or regions! Embark on a journey with 10 million players worldwide in a post-apocalyptic exploration, and stand alongside charming Kemono girls! Download now and enjoy a time-saving and relaxing card battle! Hundreds Of Charming Kemono Girls Await Nearly a hundred charming Kemono girls are waiting for your dispatch. Each Kemono girl has her own proficient skill, choose the ones that suit your battle style! You can also boost the Kemono girls in multiple dimensions to improve their combat Attributes, making you invincible in battles. Have a romantic date with the Kemono girl you fancy, increasing Affinity while also enhancing character Attributes! Time-saving and Relaxing Card Battles The skip battle and quick blitz functions save you time. You can greatly shorten the battle duration and save time spent on battles by unlocking the automatic battle and skip battle functions. Not only do some Story stages support skipping battles, but there are also more daily gameplays that support quick blitz, helping you avoid repetitive battles. Also, the game will provide you with lineup combination suggestions to assist you in improving your battle efficiency. Massive In-game Rewards For Everyone The price of drawing cards is lower than 99% of card mobile games, offering free SSR characters and a massive amount of items. With a hundred draws of self-selection, there's even a chance to get six top-tier SSR characters in the first week of beta. Top-tier battle squads can be easily filled up! Every day, there are 10 free draws, supplemented by a large amount of resources, pushing through the end of the world, and let's see who is superior in the arena! Quick and Easy Character Leveling One-click level inheritance, quickly cultivate a lineup of Kemono girls! Each game character supports one-click lossless inheritance between character levels, allowing for instant switching and efficient lineup changes. Cultivate a team of Kemono girls once and for all! Explore Multiple Game Modes A leisure gameplay with high degree of freedom and diverse categories. If you love Expedition and Battle, you can choose to compete in the arena, or regularly go to the port to fight with mysterious BOSS for rewards. If you like a warm and lively home, you can also freely DIY and create a personalized dormitory for you and your Kemono girls! If you are actively sociable, you can also join the Syndicate to make friends, exchange gifts, and jointly Recharge the High-energy Reactor for high returns.

Embark on a journey with 10 million players worldwide in a post-apocalyptic exploration, and stand alongside charming Kemono girls! Enjoy a time-saving and relaxing card battle!
