row.name: ONE PIECE Bounty Rush
row.detailed_description: Take the loot, pirates! - Victory rests on the berry in your hand! Bounty Rush is the first ONE PIECE 4 vs 4 multiplayer team action game. In this game, working with your team is the key to victory! Compete in real-time, with complete synchronization, against an enemy team and aim to steal their berries! - The world of ONE PIECE has been transformed into a 3D battlefield! The stages are filled with items that give you and your team an advantage, as well as obstacles that get in your way. Use whatever you can get your hands on and lead your team to victory! - Emerge victorious using distinctive ONE PIECE characters in Team Battle! In this mode, you can control popular ONE PIECE characters and battle against rival teams. Characters have different strengths too: those who excel at advancing the frontlines and those who are better at taking the defensive in the rear. Pick your playstyle and charge into battle!
row.short_description: Take the loot, pirates! Bounty Rush is a 4 vs 4 multiplayer team action game. Work with your team to capture the other teams' berries!

row.name: Roaches: The Birthday Party
row.detailed_description: Game simulates assembling a jigsaw puzzle. 7 different puzzle images are available. Each image is available as 25, 49 or 100 pieces puzzle and each can be assembled independently. Process of assembling is saved for each image, so if you leave the level or the game it will not be lost and you can continue later. There is also no time limit. Player can see the complete image anytime by by using the icon toggle in the top right corner of the screen. After finishing assembling the image (or even during the process) puzzle pieces can be randomly shuffled again. Game does not challenge the player with any kind of limits, so it's enjoyable process without any kind of pressure. It has minimalistic and relaxing ambient music. Images are funny and fictional. They are about different aspects of imaginary roaches having a birthday party. Take your time, enjoy jigsaw puzzle assembling and have a fun with roaches birthday party pictures!
row.short_description: Game includes 7 funny roach birthday party pictures as puzzles. Each puzzle is available as 25, 49 or 100 pieces. There is no time limit, reference image is always available during assembling. Take your time, enjoy assembling and have a fun with roach party pictures!

row.name: Superhero Cats
row.detailed_description: Check out other games! About the Game 🦸🏻‍♀️ In the Cat Universe, superheroes and villains are engaged in an epic battle! And the cats are going to help them in it. Explore the map in full and find the 100 kitty cats hidden here - for free! 🌈 Paint them in your favorite colors by simply clicking on them. You can choose a color in the pause menu. 🌒 Negative mode will show you the game in new colors. 🔮 Stuck? Use the hint button! 🕓 There's a time mode, for the fastest cat finders. 🏆 Also: 15+ real meow sounds Camera zoom in and out Brightness settings Suitable for all ages
row.short_description: 🦸🏻‍♀️ Hidden Superhero Cats - Find and paint 100 hidden cats in this epic superhero environment! Test your attentiveness and relax in this cozy and free game 😺

row.name: SPLITGATE: Arena Reloaded
row.detailed_description: No Factions. No Abilities. No Limits. SPLITGATE: Arena Reloaded fuses the best of Splitgate 1 & 2, bringing back that classic arena shooter feel. Play free now. The Arena Is Back: Hop into fast-paced matches with customizable loadouts or test yourself in Classic Arena with equal starts. Fight across fan-favorite modes like Team Deathmatch, King of the Hill, and Domination, or let loose in party modes like Gun Game and Shotty Snipers. Contest power-ups across the arena to gain temporary advantages and turn the tide of battle. Grind & Progress: Earn rewards with every match as you level up your Career, unlock weapons and cosmetics, and prove yourself on ranked leaderboards. Each weapon has its own progression path with unique camos to showcase mastery. Climb from Rookie to Prime across 1000+ levels to prove you are a master of the arena. New Maps, Weapons, & More: Experience 20 diverse arenas, including 5 new and remastered arenas. Battle aboard a moving land crawler on Hammerhead, navigate the massive irrigation complex of Terra13, or dominate classic maps like Oasis and Abyss. Customize your loadout with 18 different primary weapons and 9 unique secondaries, or pick up Power Weapons to dominate the arena. Portals With a Purpose: Utilize portals to outplay your opponents in ways no other shooter can match. Flank from impossible angles, escape certain death, or lock down key positions using Portal Overloading. Clear enemy portals with EMP Grenades and claim territory for your team.
row.short_description: SPLITGATE: Arena Reloaded fuses the best of Splitgate 1 & 2, bringing back that classic arena shooter feel. Play free now.

row.name: EOEOnline
row.detailed_description: EOEOnline is a fantasy MMORPG in a vast world with quirky and humorous characters and a depth of unique lore and world building. The game takes place in a dynamic world we're in game events become canon and build onto the game's lore and world. Players can explore multiple countries, realms all of which have unique histories and backstories. In typical mmorpg fashion game play consists of dungeon crawlers quests skills and levelling both combat and non combat. The game play focuses on freedom to do what you want and be who you want with no strict class system instead players can mix and match skill trees however they see fit. Most in game events come with unique weapons and armour and collectables and events that can be added to a player-built house. The story revolves around a growing military power collecting ancient powerful relics and mystical creatures with the player tasked to stop them while also contending with ancient evils uncovered from beneath the earth's surface and world beyond. The world has many mini games and collectables to be won. Find lore books and uncover the deep history of the world. Collect pets and give them unique hats Ride chickens and race hippos Fight in the area against npcs or friends Play minigame for unique rewards and build a house to show off your collections Multiple crafting methods and skills to build out your game play experience and unlock rewards and collectables including enchanting. Crafting alchemy and resource gathering. Join a pirate crew on an island hopping adventure or help the mages guild uncover ancient ruins.
row.short_description: EOEOnline is a fantasy MMORPG in a vast world with quirky and humorous characters and a depth of unique lore and world building. The game takes place in a dynamic world we're in game events become canon and build onto the game's lore and world.
row.notes: The game is not overtly inappropriate however humorous references to various inappropriate insinuations are employed however these acts are generally not directly shown.

row.name: Dragon Spirits 2 : Prologue
row.detailed_description: Dragon Spirits 2 is a creature-collecting RPG set in a modern urban environment. Players can explore a city filled with urban legends, venture into various otherworldly spaces, and form contracts with different dragon spirits. You can nurture these spirits, customize their abilities, strategize team compositions, and build a formidable dragon spirit squad. The difference between the prologue version and the full version: The prologue version unlocks 11 low-level maps. (That’s still plenty of content for a free game!) ◆Story Overview: Cognitive pollution in Metapolis◆ The protagonist is a game developer living in bustling Metapolis. Her ordinary life is disrupted when dragons from the game she developed appear in reality! Upon forming contracts with these dragon spirits, the protagonist realizes that the real world is being invaded by more dragons of unknown origin. The once vibrant city is no longer just a sleepless town of bright lights; people's minds are being increasingly contaminated, and the line between fiction and reality has blurred! The protagonist, also known as a pactsealer, embarks on a journey with dragons to uncover the mystery behind these events, restore the city to its former state, and form bonds with more dragon spirits. ◆80+ Dragon Companions◆ Assemble your dragon spirit team and command them in battle. But, before recruiting them as your new companions, you must fulfill their unique needs. ◆Create Your Unique Combat Style◆ Each dragon spirit has its strengths and team roles, requiring careful consideration when training and in battle. Analyze each dragon's abilities, tailor a unique combat strategy, and adjust their stats through skill setups and equipping items. ◆Explore the Boundary Between Virtual and Reality◆ Metapolis is a vibrant place, but the virtual world contamination has made it even more chaotic. Special zones known as Cocoon, scattered throughout the city, are responsible for breaking the boundary between virtual and reality. In the game, players will explore various Cocoons, each a chaotic vortex of unstructured information and lurking dangers. Of course, there are also wild dragon spirits and other enemies waiting. ◆Uncover the Dark Secrets of Metapolis◆ Apart from the Cocoons, there are plenty of regular areas in Metapolis. Navigate different parts of the city to uncover the mastermind behind this crisis. Along the way, you can also take a moment to enjoy the city's scenery and immerse yourself in Metapolis's everyday life. ◆Battles Between Pactsealers◆ Meet other pactsealers and their dragon spirits in side missions along the city. Enjoy battles against them, decipher their strategies, and deepen your bond with your dragon spirits, growing together into an unbeatable team.
row.short_description: In this modern urban-themed RPG, you can collect 80+ different dragon spirits, experiment with skill setups, assemble teams, and devise strategies to build your dragon spirit squad. Adventure through the virtual spaces in Metapolis, and uncover the conspiracy behind it all.

row.name: Clone War
row.detailed_description: About This Game 'Clon War' is a game in which you have to survive a fight against an influx of clones. How long can you survive? Let's fight enemies and be strong The game is played in a roguelike genre, and as the stage progresses, the enemies become stronger. Clearing the stage will give you a reward and you will grow too. Let's dress ourselves up After the game, you can get the goods based on the results, which you can use when you visit the store. Let's decorate ourselves with individuality, not only the appearance of the character, but also accessories and effects. Let's keep a record You can check various records, such as the highest stage level and the number of enemies defeated. Some records will appear on the leaderboard for others to see, so aim for high scores. How to manipulate You can click the ? icon at the top of the title screen to see how to operate it. Language Settings You can change the language in the game from Option > Language. Steam Leaderboard On the Steam Library page, you can check the ranking by clicking View My Challenges > Full Ranking Table.
row.short_description: It's a simple roguelike game that gets stronger by winning a fight against clones.

row.name: Kana
row.detailed_description: Master the fundamentals of the Japanese language with Kana ! In Kana, you get to learn and practice Hiragana and Katakana which are two of the writing systems in Japanese. Note: The game teaches through English! Hiragana and Katakana Charts for Learning Character Writing Practice Learn how to write each character with a stroke order visualizer. Typing Game Modes ENDLESS Practice recognizing characters by typing out Romaji (Japanese sounds represented by Roman alphabets) to match the characters. Competitive Match as much kana as you can to climb the leaderboard! Color Palettes! A selection of color palettes for users to customize the look of the game!
row.short_description: Start your Japanese learning journey by learning two of the writing systems in Japanese - Hiragana and Katakana!

row.name: Mereonozis 2D: The Kingdom of Gremlins
row.detailed_description: You will play for a robot who wakes up on an abandoned space station. To repair the station, you need to repair equipment and solve the puzzles. Beware of gremlins! They are not dangerous for you but they'll break everything you've repaired so far. They are also a part of a puzzle: you not only need to scare them away but you have to do it the right way! This is a metroidvania based on puzzles instead of battles. You open locations step by step. And you may freely navigate throught the unlocked locations. The station has a vast network of railcars. They will help you to move quickly between its compartments. On some levels you may try different machines: cranes, cable cars, manipulators etc. They may be controlled with special control panels in the bottom right corner. Sometimes you may see astonishing alien landscape behind the window or occasionally find forgotten diaries and documents in the underground compartments. They will not only help you to go through the puzzles but will also reveal the story behind the abandoned station.
row.short_description: A puzzle-bazed metroidvania. Help the robot to repair the station. But there are gremlins who will try to break everything you've just fixed!

row.name: Tiny Ski
row.detailed_description: Hi! This is my first game <3 (I have no idea what I'm doing) Embark on an exhilarating journey down some frosty slopes in this heart-pounding adventure at Tiny Ski Resort! This 2D pixel art game invites players to carve through snowy landscapes, compete against friends online, and delve into an enthralling story mode with branching narratives leading to several different endings. Thrilling Online Races: Strap on your skis and challenge friends or rivals from around the globe in adrenaline-fueled online races. Feel the rush as you zip through meticulously crafted ski runs, navigating treacherous obstacles and striving for victory. Story Mode with Endless Possibilities: Dive into the captivating narrative of Tiny Ski's story mode, where your choices shape the outcome. With multiple unique endings to discover, every decision you make influences the fate of your character and the world around them. Will you conquer the mountains or succumb to the challenges ahead? Constant Updates: Stay tuned for regular updates and new content additions, including fresh ski runs, exciting events, and more. With ongoing support and community engagement, the adventure never ends in Tiny Ski!
row.short_description: Welcome to Tiny Ski Resort! Where pixel art, skiing, multiplayer races, and a beautiful story all come together.

row.name: Project P
row.detailed_description: Project P is a straightforward minimalistic top down adventure game. Choose your class, enter the maze, kill the golem before it finds and kills you Key features 3 Different classes to choose from, each with their own skill Randomly generated levels : each run is different. Start by exploring the maze and remember the best places to pick a fight After every win, the golem grows stronger but so do you! Pick an upgrade after each level and reach the highest possible level Play with a precise visibility system to escape the golem and hit him when he cannot see you Listen carefully, the music may tell you if you are safe... or if you should run for your life!
row.short_description: Explore the maze, run for your life and aim your arrows carefully in this minimal top down survival game.Use the layout of the maze to sneak around, take your shot and run before you get spotted by the monster you are trying to take down.

row.name: The Chronicles of Penghao: Ming PlayTest
Is This A Platformer?
row.detailed_description: Overview: Is This a Platformer? is a fast-paced action platformer that throws players into a hilariously absurd adventure filled with quirky characters, over-the-top obstacles, and laugh-out-loud moments at every turn. Step into the shoes of Kenzu, a young Japanese video game otaku, suddenly pulled into a bizarre digital world. His mission? Rescue his brother from the clutches of a mysterious creature in a universe where nothing makes sense—but everything is a challenge Art Style: Is This a Platformer? brings its vibrant world to life with charming, retro-inspired pixel art. Think chunky, colorful pixels reminiscent of classic platformers but polished with modern touches. The result? A visual feast that blends nostalgia with fresh, creative flair. And where else will you find a laughing sun or a bunch of screaming grapes? Oh, and don’t forget the explosive Kaboom! effect—because why not? Gameplay: You’re just Kenzu—a regular guy with a killer jump and a mean punch. But in this world, every movement counts. Precision platforming, tight controls, and quick reflexes are your only allies as you leap, punch, and fight your way through absurd challenges. Boss fights? They're epic, over-the-top showdowns that mix intense platforming with wild humor and massive, unforgettable foes. Think you’ve got the skills to beat our toughest boss? Prove it. We dare you.
row.short_description: Play a fast paced action platformer where you fight grapes and a banana to save your dump brother.

row.name: Cookard
row.detailed_description: Wishlist More From Panitia GameDev About the Game Cookard is a cooking game where you run a restaurant by stacking cards to prepare and serve dishes to customers. Prepare Dish Every dish requires a certain set of steps and ingredients, which can typically be completed by dragging ingredient cards (such as Egg, Dough, Honey) to utensil cards (such as Oven, Stove). You can always check the Recipes section if you're at loss. As the game progresses, you'll unlock more recipes to cook! Serve Dish Dragging a 'Customer' card on top of a 'Table' card will reveal their desired dish. Serve them by placing their desired dish on top of them. Customers won't linger for very long, so make sure to deliver their dish in a timely manner! Buy & Trade Every dish requires a set of ingredient cards, and you'll need to stock up on them from time to time. Ingredients can be bought by placing a coins card on top of a store card, such as 'Store' or 'Fruit Stall'. Sometimes you'll find yourselves surrounded by unecessary stuff. It's good idea to sell them in the 'Trade House' to get coins in return. You could also trade various items to get other items, such as an additional Table or Oven, etc. Complete Quests Completing quests earns you rewards, often including new additions to the restaurant, such as new utensils and recipes. Progress! Hire Workers Tired of clicking Water Pump or Hand Crank? Hire workers to help you generate electricity! Put them on Running Wheel to kickstart your machinations! Automate Your Kitchen Who knows moving and sorting cards will be so tiring? Unlock magnet and use it to pull the cards from one place to another! Presskit Download the Press Kit here
row.short_description: Cookard is a cooking game where you run a restaurant by stacking cards to prepare and serve dishes to customers.

row.name: Tactishia
row.detailed_description: Tactishia Tactical board game with some similarity to chess but uses more tactical aspects to simulate better a battlefield experience. The game has offline option as well as game lobbies for 1 vs 1 multiplayer. The game lets you choose up to 18 pieces of 6 types of units per board, the online session lets each players to re-organize the chosen pieces on each side of his board. The offline session lets any player to freely choose any pieces to use.

row.name: Splash Dino
row.detailed_description: Drag objects (wooden boxes and triangles and other objects) to help the little dino throw the wooden ball into the water. And remember that dino can help you with tips (hints as black and red frames), skips and dino coins. At the beginning of the game you have 30 dino coins, 20 tips (hints) and 10 skips. Every second level you receive an additional dino coin. You can use dino coins to increase the number of tips and skips you have. Tips help you complete a level faster, while skips allow you to jump to the next level. Are you ready to test your brain with this colorful, cute and challenging puzzle game? Good luck! 115 levels.

row.name: Mortuar
row.detailed_description: Mortuar is psychological horror game where you and up to three other players are tasked with investigating haunted sites. Upon identifying what type of ghost haunts the area, you must exorcise it in order to finally free the realm of its unearthly presence. Make use of various ghost hunting equipment and closely follow your journal’s instructions in order to perform the ritual. Two locations to choose from Both set in an area resembling the infamous Hoia Baciu Forest, there are two distinct locations to choose from. Explore the old, abandoned church set on a hill, where even the priest who used to serve this godly place left in a hurry, or delve deep into the mysterious mansion that has been left abandoned for a long time for unknown reasons. Equip yourself accordingly Discover a diverse list of equipment that can aid you in identifying the ghost. You will find all the classics, such as EMF readers, flashlights and holy crosses and also other items which will then aid you in your quest to banish the ghost from the mortal realm. Terrifying encounters The ghost is not just an entity that aimlessly roams about, it’s a malevolent spirit who seeks vengeance upon the living. The ghost will start out more passive, manifesting only to drain your sanity at first. However, if you wander time in its territory, it will not hesitate to hunt you down. Watch out, it is always listening to you! Teamwork makes the dream work While you can battle the ghost on your own, your experience can be greatly enhanced by bringing in some friends! Cooperate with your team to identify the ghost faster and then to make the banishing process less dangerous.
row.short_description: Mortuar is a 1-4 player Online co-op psychological horror game. Delve deep into Hoia Baciu Forest where eerie sightings and paranormal activity have transpired. Make use of various ghost hunting equipment to first identify the ghost's type, then attempt to banish it back to the afterlife.

row.name: Cedric & Odious
row.detailed_description: Cedric & Odious is a pixel art action RPG set in a dark and treacherous fantasy world. A Bond Torn by Death Take the role of Cedric, a warrior king resurrected by his once-loyal friend, Odious, a brilliant but morally corrupt sorcerer. In life, their camaraderie was legendary. In death, Cedric finds himself bound to Odious's will, forced to carry out the sorcerer’s plans. Haunted by vague memories of their shared past and uneasy about Odious’s intentions, Cedric must decide: obey the man who saved him or face death again and again. Dynamic Combat and Tactical Mastery Challenging Enemies: Confront the harsh realities of a divided world, from the war-torn human realms to the ferocious wildling factions and the relentless forces of the demonic underworld. Adapt your strategies to face enemies that test your skill and resolve at every turn. Environmental Strategy: Utilize floating platforms and diverse landscapes to outmaneuver foes, turning the environment into your greatest ally. Powerful Items and Artifacts: Utilize an arsenal of unique passive and active items, from spell-breaking rings to explosive fire potions, to overcome overwhelming odds. Totally free game.
row.short_description: Battle through a dark fantasy world as a resurrected warrior king. Once loyal friends, you now serve at the mercy of Odious, a brilliant but corrupt sorcerer. Master tactical combat and magical artifacts in this challenging action RPG.
row.notes: This game contains blood and cartoonish violence.

row.name: PacaPomo
row.detailed_description: PacaPomo is a cross between a productivity app and a cozy farming game where you raise alpacas and cultivate a farm, all driven by the Pomodoro Technique! Stay focused with a calming and motivating experience for busy students and working professionals. Play while going about your daily routines and responsibilities! Stay Productive with PacaPomo! Set a pomodoro timer customizable to your liking. Focus on an IRL task set to cozy Peruvian inspired music. When you come back, you're rewarded with crops ready to be harvested and Alpacas happy to great you!  Nurture your Garden! Plant various local specialties to feed your alpacas with, or sell them for a bit of extra cash! You can also complete villager orders for a large prize, or cook unique meals with your crops to treat your Alpacas. Adopt and Care for your Alpacas! When you finish a pomodoro, you can take some time to pet your alpacas! Feed, shear, train and bond with your new friends.  Expand your Farm! Open up new terraces to unlock orchards, more alpaca pen space, and garden plots. Main Features Take advantage of the Pomodoro Timer for focus time, allowing you to stick to a schedule and improve concentration. You can customize your timer to your liking - with different times, tags, and long break options. A report card to track your progress on a daily, weekly, and monthly chart. Alongside is a To-Do List that you can fill out to track your goals. Unique, bespoke alpacas with different personalities and stories. These are acquired through adoption at the Alpaca Sanctuary. Every encounter is an exciting new addition to your farm! Customization options for Alpacas - allowing you to dress up your friends with silly hats, glasses, and special effects. Fun short minigames for interacting with your alpacas, including sheering and cooking. An original, calming soundtrack made by Peruvian musicians to chill or lock in to. A selection of unique crops and fruits to grow and harvest. Feed them to your alpacas, use them in food recipes, or complete villager orders. Long term progression through farm expansion - save up to buy terrace plots that will allow you to unlock orchards, more alpaca pen space and farming plots. Cross-platform cloud saves to ensure your progress is never lost! In today's fast-paced world, many struggle to balance work, responsibilities, and leisure time. PacaPomo aims to address this challenge by offering a free, fun and accessible way for people to relax and unwind while also being productive.
row.short_description: PacaPomo is a cozy, Free to Play productivity app where you raise alpacas and cultivate a farm, all driven by the Pomodoro Technique!

row.name: 业火 Hellfire
row.detailed_description: “阿难，是等皆以业火乾枯，酬其宿债，傍为畜生。” 《业火Hellfire》是一款中国本土题材的剧情悬疑解谜游戏。 故事发生在一个夏秋之交，年轻的摄影师回乡探寻故人。 但随着探查深入，深埋已久的回忆被悄然激起…… · 这是一个民智未开，偏远落后的村庄。 · 昏暗的天幕，奇怪的村民，破落的村庙，掉漆的神像。 · 这是一个既联动现实，又充满民间神秘主义的故事。 · 它灰暗怪诞，但或许正在幽暗处时刻发生着。 · 中式恐怖的核心不是鬼怪，不是追逐，不是血腥厮杀。 · 因为吃人的封建和铁链般禁锢女人的秩序远比它们恐怖。 · 这是一段因果已定的故事，恶业害身如火，当以火去之。 · 你将跟随主角的回忆，看业火如何吞尽腐朽。 “如果天塌下来，正义才能得到实现，那就塌吧。” 业余爱好者第一次尝试独立制作游戏，心有余，技术力不足，请见谅。 只愿能做事的做事，能发声的发声，有一分热，发一分光。

row.name: Ruby Dreams: Immortal Promise
row.detailed_description: The day has come for you to serve the Beaumont family at your mother’s request. As you venture into their mansion, you quickly find yourself captivated by the presence of your enigmatic hosts. At night you have dreams unlike any you’ve dreamt before. Guiding you through mysteries and rewarding you with knowledge of secrets that don’t belong to you. Use the secrets you’ve learned to tear down the walls around the Beaumont's hearts and earn your place in their embrace. Or use them to your advantage and learn about your mother’s complicated history with the family. Sebastian is the epitome of diligence and composure. But beneath that cool exterior lies a heart overflowing with care and protection, especially for those he treasures. Falling for him is easy because of his irresistible mix of strength and vulnerability, making every moment with him an adventure of the heart. Roderick has an irresistible charm and allure. He commands attention effortlessly, with his flirtatious demeanor which makes your heart flutter. Beneath that facade lies a complex man, capable of both darkness and tenderness. Alexander embodies arrogance and impulsiveness, yet within him resides a tender heart that he only reveals to those he truly cares for. His love towards someone can transform him from a self-centered to a protective and devoted man. A 2D visual novel story with choices A 3D world that reveals itself to you only in your dreams Three endings, that bringing you closer to one of your three mysterious hosts, and one 'bad' ending Puzzles leading to clues about how to reach the hearts of your masters Love progress bars that track your love with each master Voice acting during 3D dream sequences A gallery with art from all the locations you've visited A music player with all the songs you've heard Ruby Dreams: Immortal Promise was made by the Repulse team in a month, as part of the NaNoRenO 2024 game jam. Due to the nature of game jams and their limited time, we might have missed a bug here and there or overlooked some issues. Let us know if you find any issues and we might come back to fix them. Who knows, if you love the game, we might even expand it.
row.short_description: As a maid in the elegance of a vampire household, use clues from your dreams to earn the love of your masters.

row.name: The Aquarians
row.detailed_description: The year is 1882, and it’s nearing a peaceful summer in the small American town of Thornsworth, New Hampshire. Meanwhile, the prestigious yet mysterious organization Loci Quaerere has gathered evidence of a long-forgotten temple from a bygone society, the Aquarians. This temple has been determined to be somewhere in the woods surrounding the very same town. In a headline announcement, the organization has sought after a knowledgeable and capable local to perform the tasks of discovery and exploration. That local has turned out to be you. In this playable short, point and click your way through various rooms, puzzles, and your assigned taskbook, to uncover the mysteries of the temple, collect artifacts for sponsors, and fulfill your ultimate purpose.
row.short_description: A point-and-click playable short where you take the role of an artifact collector, navigating the Aquarian Temple's enigmatic architecture and locating its prized relics.

row.name: Arena of Trophies
row.detailed_description: GAME INFORMATION Master the art of collecting achievements in this new game, designed to satisfy your appetite for challenges and rewards. COLLECT ACHIEVEMENTS Immerse yourself in a world where every step, every decision, and every action contributes to your progress in collecting achievements. From simple tasks for beginners to complex challenges for veterans, this game offers a wide array of achievements waiting to be conquered. GLADIATORS Choose from fifteen different gladiators, each with a unique appearance reflecting their personality and origin. Although all gladiators behave the same in combat, the variety in their visual style gives players the option to choose a character they can identify with or that expresses their aesthetic preferences. From imposing armored titans to agile and lightweight fighters, each gladiator brings their unique presence to the battlefield. TRAPS The arena is not just about strength and combat skills; it's also a place full of dangers and cunning. Use traps scattered throughout the arena to your advantage to surprise your opponents or turn the tide of battle in your favor. LANGUAGES On the home page of our game, we strive to be open about our approach to translations. All language versions in our game are machine-translated, which means we utilize automated technologies to translate texts into various languages. This method allows us to efficiently expand the reach of the game and make it accessible to players worldwide. While we aim for the most accurate translation possible, it's important to realize that machine translation may not always capture the subtleties and nuances of the original text. There can be minor inaccuracies, but these do not alter the overall gaming experience. We are committed to providing quality translations and believe that despite occasional imperfections, players from different linguistic regions can fully experience and enjoy our game. We value feedback from our players and are ready to further improve and update the language versions based on their suggestions.
row.short_description: Join the epic battle in an arena filled with gladiators and test your skills in a game where every move can lead to glory or downfall. Collect achievements, refine your strategies, and become a legend in the endless fight for survival and recognition!
row.notes: The game contains blood, dismemberment, death, violence, and human bones. Not suitable for persons under 18

row.name: Sime Is Back
row.detailed_description: Sime Is Back is a delightful 2.5D jumping platformer that transports players to the idyllic Croatian Adriatic coast. In this whimsical tale, players step into the shoes of a fed-up fisherman who's tired of being exploited by greedy locals. Armed with nothing but his fish and accompanied by his faithful feline sidekick, our hero sets out on an epic journey to reclaim what's rightfully his – all while embarking on a quest for justice, revenge, and plenty of fish-flinging fun! - Fish-Flipping Frenzy: Dive into a chaotic adventure as you wield your fish to flip, slap, and smack pesky adversaries into submission across a variety of vibrant levels. - Quirky Enemies and Obstacles: Confront an eclectic cast of adversaries and environmental obstacles, including greedy locals, mischievous critters, perilous cliffs, and cunning traps. - Crate-Smashing Chaos: Immerse yourself in an action-packed adventure as you smash open crates scattered throughout each level, releasing a shower of coins essential for unlocking challenges. - Authentic Croatian Setting: Immerse yourself in the rich culture and scenic beauty of the Croatian Adriatic coast, with authentic landmarks, music, and cultural references woven seamlessly into the game's charming narrative. - Stunning 2.5D Environments: Explore meticulously crafted environments inspired by the breathtaking Croatian Adriatic coast, from quaint seaside villages to lush coastal landscapes and hidden caves. Sime Is Back promises an exhilarating blend of platforming action, coin-collecting madness, and scenic splendor, inviting players of all ages to embark on an unforgettable adventure filled with crate-smashing chaos and feline camaraderie.
row.short_description: Sime's back, celebrated by locals but tired of exploitation. Join him & his feline friend on a whimsical Adriatic journey. Armed with his fish, Sime confronts enemies, smashes crates & reclaims what's his. Dive into this charming adventure of chaos, camaraderie, & fish-flinging fun!

row.name: DIROK
row.detailed_description: Dîrok is a unique game. First, because it is the first game that combines Connect Four with deck building, and second, because it is the first real-time turn-based game. This means that while it's your turn to make your move, things are still happening on the board. This introduces a new level of strategy never seen before. Additionally, the game features more than 100 real historical figures with whom you can build your deck, and each will have a bio that helps us learn more about who they were. As if that weren't enough, the characters will have different levels of strength, defense, health, and agility, as well as unique abilities that can positively affect allies and/or negatively affect enemies, potentially changing the dynamics of the game at any moment.
row.short_description: Dîrok is a unique game. First, because it is the first game that combines Connect Four with deck building, and second, because it is the first real-time turn-based game. The game features more than 100 real historical figures with whom you can build your deck.

row.name: Zombie Killer
row.detailed_description: Dive into the heart-pounding action of Zombie Island, an adrenaline-fueled survival game that will push your skills to the limit! Are you ready to face hordes of ravenous undead in a battle for survival? In Zombie Island, you'll find yourself stranded on a desolate island infested with the walking dead. Armed with only your wits and a selection of powerful weapons, you must fight your way through wave after wave of zombies, each more relentless than the last. But beware – these zombies aren't your average shufflers. With our cutting-edge 3D audio technology, you'll hear every groan, every footstep, and every bone-chilling growl as the undead close in from all directions. Stay alert, or risk becoming zombie chow! But be warned: surviving on Zombie Island won't be easy. With each passing wave, the challenges will escalate, testing your reflexes, strategy, and nerve. Do you have what it takes to outlast the undead and emerge victorious? Prepare yourself for the ultimate test of survival. Gather your courage, lock and load your weapons, and get ready to face the zombie apocalypse head-on in Zombie Island – where every shot counts, and every scream could be your last. Join us now on Steam and prepare to experience the thrill of Zombie Island firsthand. The undead await – are you brave enough to face them?
row.short_description: Survive the undead onslaught in Zombie Island, where you'll battle hordes of zombies on a desolate island. Armed with powerful weapons and immersive 3D audio, every groan and footstep will keep you on edge. Compete for the highest score and see your name in the Hall of Fame.

row.name: Sandwich Sim
row.detailed_description: A game where you play as a slightly confused bear trying to assemble the ultimate meal no matter who tries to get in your way. Relax and go fishing, visit the grocery store, escape shadowy agents, and more on your way to achieve enlightenment via sandwich. Sandwich Sim is primarily a first person game whose main mechanic is moving and manipulating your hands to grab, move, and release items using your mouse. The game features full voice acting and subtitles, and a compelling and captivating story. This game was developed by a team of UCI students and graduates in 2024. The in game computer also contains a playable version of Sugar Bear which was developed by many of the same students for a game jam in 2023.
row.short_description: A game where you play as a slightly confused bear trying to assemble the ultimate meal no matter who tries to get in your way. Relax and fish, visit the grocery store, escape bureaucracy, and more on your way to achieve enlightenment via sandwich.

row.name: Combat Cat
row.detailed_description: Combat Cat is a fast-paced, side-scrolling, bullet hell where you fight against an endless horde of angry slimes as a combat ready cat! Shoot, dash and fly your way around the areas as slimes try to stop your journey! After each level the slimes grow in power, but so do you! Upgrade your weapon and cat with the thirty unique items the slimes drop along the way! Use these items for infinite customizability options! Homing shotgun? Super powered sniper? The choice is yours! Face off against four diverse slime types and three different challenging bosses as your journey progresses! If you're ready for a real fight try a higher difficulty or maybe even the truly chaotic slime rain mode! Or have fun and experiment in the creative mode to build the combat cat of your dreams! Go on now! Create your Combat Cat and survive as long as you can! Jump, Dash, and fly around the arena! Upgrade your weapon and cat for infinite combat options! Different game modes including creative mode for experimenting and slime rain for maximum chaos! Ending Stats screen to see how far you have come! Four slime types and three different bosses! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: A fast-paced, side-scrolling, bullet hell with an inventory system where a player can upgrade their weapons and player stats to survive as long as possible.

Investigate the crime scene, interrogate the witnesses, solve the mysteries and uncover the secrets until you catch the criminal! Expect an Ace Detective-style point and click game. You will navigate 3 episodes investigating murder cases. Find the contradictions in the witness statements and present the contrary evidence! Investigate beautiful hand painted crime scenes rich with detail, and talk to colorful characters on your search for the truth! 50 minutes of original music and intro song, over a dozen characters, and equivalent of 100 pages of script for your to enjoy Expected playtime: 6 hours.

row.name: Bullet Rain
row.detailed_description: Bullet Rain is a competitive shooter where the objective is to capture objectives on the map or eliminate the opposing team. Players can expect thrilling firefights and tactical challenges against other players. In a grim future, the skies unleashed a torrent of destruction as a colossal battleship bombarded the planet, earning its fearsome moniker “Bullet Rain” and alien life forms revealed themselves to humanity. Peaceful negotiations were never an option for them. Even the dragons fought among themselves to acquire resources. Earth became the battlefield of an unprecedented scale. Though the planet had to be evacuated, many remained behind to defend it. Welcome to the year 2102, three decades after the first appearance of dragons, where the face of Earth has forever changed. Humanity confronts the relentless reality that it is not alone in the universe. Dragons and other extraterrestrial species have revealed themselves and claim resources that once belonged exclusively to humans. Earth finds itself in an end-time scenario, marked by destruction and desolation. Cities have crumbled into ruins, once bustling streets now lay deserted and overgrown with vegetation. The remnants of human civilization serve only as a reminder of past grandeur and loss. Despite the apocalyptic landscape, humanity has not given up. With a mix of advanced technology, they wage a desperate battle against the overwhelming invaders. Each day is a struggle for survival, and the boundaries between good and evil blur in this endless conflict for resources and power. Amidst this chaos, clans and factions have formed, fighting for the remaining resources. Loyalty to a group can determine life and death as humanity strives to stand against the looming extinction. Yet even in times of darkness, there are glimmers of hope that keep faith in a better future alive. Welcome to 'Bullet Rain”. In Bullet Rain, all players stand on an equal footing, without any additional abilities or special skills. The focus is entirely on skill, teamwork, and strategic thinking. Each player can contribute their individual skills and experiences to lead the team to victory. With a variety of weapons and equipment at your disposal, there are numerous options to develop your own playstyle and compete in the 5-versus-5 battles. Showcase your shooting skills, collaborate closely with your teammates, and defeat the invaders in this action-packed competition for the fate of humanity.
row.short_description: This Game is a classic First Person Shooter. As it is still in development features and weapons will be added step by step. We hope you will enjoy our work!

row.name: Melon Man

Join Melon Man on his quest to collect all his melons in this vibrant and exciting adventure. Features: Juicy Gameplay: Jump and move your way with precision through a variety of levels filled with obstacles and tricky traps. Collect all the melons scattered across each level to unlock new levels. Various Difficulties: Do you have what it takes to play through the game on insane difficulty, or do you prefer extra lives? Highscores: Can you set the time record per level? Challenge your friends to see who's go the inner Melon Man skill! Catchy Tunes: Groove to the beat of different soundtracks that will have you humming along as you navigate each level. Challenging Levels: Test your platforming skills with progressively challenging levels that will keep you on your toes. Each stage introduces new obstacles and mechanics, ensuring every moment is filled with excitement and anticipation. MacOS and Linux support is planned for near future. PLEASE NOTE: The game is designed to be challenging and may have a learning curve.

Play as an aspiring art student and jump into each artists most iconic paintings to experience their art as intimately as possible while solving puzzles to complete the level. MOIA gives the player the chance to fully immerse themselves into the work of a famous artist while still getting a satisfying platformer experience.

row.name: Relict
row.detailed_description: Relict promises to be a thrilling fusion of genres, blending elements of third-person shooters, roguelikes, and tarot-based strategy. Set across three distinct planets—Koros, Thorm, and Serun—each characterized by its unique environmental challenges and aesthetic, this game invites players into a richly immersive universe fraught with peril and intrigue. Explore various planetary environments: Koros: Once an oceanic paradise, now desiccated and barren. Fight under the skeletal shadow of the creatures who once inhabited this planet as you encounter various corrupted sea themed life forms. Thorm: A frigid wasteland beneath a perpetually frozen sky. Challenges include traversing icy oasis, treacherous crevasses, and frost-covered ruins of the people who once called this planet home. Serun: Charred remnants of a once-vibrant forest, teeming with burnt and corrupted flora and fauna. Venture through the burning forests as you catch up to the source of the corruption and defeat unique fire themed enemies who once called the forest home. Third-Person Roguelike: Fast-paced and fluid combat emphasizing strategic positioning, reflexes, and resource management. Randomized enemy encounters, and mini bosses add challenge and replayability. Tarot Reading and Ability Acquisition: Collect tarot cards throughout the journey, each representing a unique ability or grace from various Tarot Deities. Perform tarot readings between stages to unlock new abilities, upgrade existing ones. Abilities range from offensive spells and defensive shields to passive enhancements and utility skills, allowing for varied playstyles and strategic depth. Objective: Confronting Nuraxis: With help from the deities, discover clues pointing towards Nuraxis, the true source of the corruption plaguing the planets. Confront Nuraxis in a climactic showdown, battling through waves of minions and treacherous obstacles as you fight to lift the corruption once and for all. Relict promises an immersive and challenging gaming experience, blending visceral combat, strategic depth, and mystical intrigue into a seamless and unforgettable adventure. With its captivating narrative, diverse gameplay mechanics, and stunning visuals, it's sure to captivate players seeking a fresh and compelling gaming experience.
row.short_description: Relict is a sci-fi 3rd person action adventure roguelike shooter with a unique tarot twist on player abilities and enemies. Taking the role of the fool, fight your way through three unique planets to save the universe from a great evil.

row.name: The Netcode Conflict
row.detailed_description: Welcome to 'The Netcode Conflict' We are working on an community event based futuristic multiplayer game in a big persistent Open world. Let`s start with us our development and create with us the next epic game. This Project, where gaming meets community in an unforgettable experience! We're not just about delivering fun and action-packed gameplay; we're all about tailor-making a game that speaks directly to you, our community. Together, we're crafting something truly special – a game that's not just played, but lived and cherished. Join us on this journey, and let's create gaming history together! Explore a futuristic open world to discover new areas, find items, and improve your defenses against enemies. Be Careful and Loot your Equipment to be Ready for the Battle! Advance through challenges, earn points and become truly epic. Team up or fight solo to take over the control point system. Fight against powerful AI guarding the Obelisks to claim rare Netcode Fragments. Survive to improve your skills and discover special abilities. Be the last man standing and hold the control point system to unlock special features.  Find valuable loot in buildings inside and outside the city. Spice up your character with rare loot you uncover in the world Craft special items like Ammo and Regen Units to be ready for battle. Meet AI-Sy , your trusted ally for locating loot, spotting enemies, and providing healing support. In this post-apocalyptic cyberpunk survival shooter, set in a world devastated by war over the 'Netcode,' you have the choice to go solo or team up with friends. You begin randomly somewhere in the world in a landing pod and start with a unique character (Facade). At first, you start without equipment and must quickly scavenge loot. Explore the world and get into a city to capture the control point and earn points that make you unique. Step into our world, where passion knows no bounds! Here's the kicker – we're doing all of this without a budget, pouring our hearts and souls into this project during our precious free time. Despite the lack of funds, our dedication knows no limits. So buckle up and get ready to embark on an adventure like no other, fueled purely by love for gaming and community spirit!
row.short_description: The Netcode Conflict is a community-event-driven online multiplayer game. Our goal is to develop and improve the game together with the community. We host regular events where players can win in-game rewards. TNC is still actively in development, and your ideas and feedback help shape its future!
row.notes: Violent content

The game is about a girl (Megan) on an ordinary day, literally the game takes place in a single day. Featuring: • Single player platform game. • Support for controllers. • Surreal enemies. • 5 power ups. • 5 levels and bosses. • 2 endings.

row.name: No Way Out
row.detailed_description: 'No Way Out' is an intense and thrilling survival horror game where players take on the role of a volunteer trapped in a panic-stricken hospital. In this hospital infested with terrifying mutants, players must bravely face their fears, find a way to escape, and uncover the horrifying truth behind the hospital. Heart-Pounding Horror Experience: The game offers a gripping and immersive horror experience, with realistic visuals and spine-chilling sound effects that keep players on the edge of their seats, immersed in the terror. Challenges and Exploration: Players must explore various areas of the hospital, searching for clues to uncover the truth and essential items for survival. They must also evade the pursuit of mutants and strive to survive. Puzzles and Decision-Making: The game features a variety of puzzles and challenges that require players to think on their feet and make crucial decisions that impact the game's progression and outcome. Tense Combat and Escapes: When confronted by mutants, players must cleverly use the environment to hide or flee, protecting their lives and continuing their search for an escape route. Engaging Storyline: 'No Way Out' weaves a captivating storyline, gradually unraveling the secrets behind the hospital and revealing the truth behind the terrifying events. Additional Information: 'No Way Out' is a game designed for players who enjoy immersive survival horror experiences. Challenge your courage and wit—see if you can survive the horrors of the hospital and uncover the truth behind the events!
row.short_description: 'No Way Out' is an intense and thrilling survival horror game where players take on the role of a volunteer trapped in a panic-stricken hospital. Players must bravely face their fears, explore various areas of the hospital, and search for a way to escape while uncovering the truth behind the events.

row.name: Mercapolis
row.detailed_description: You´ve just been fired from a major supermarket chain.. Now build your own and show them who´s the boss! Organize and build the different structures wherever and however you want. You'll have at your disposal various types of structures, such as shelves or workstations, to expand the range of products in your supermarket, such as quality meat, the freshest fish, or a delicious cheesecake. Manage your time and your product stock daily. The day will pass quickly, and you'll need to ensure that your shelves are always full. To do this, manage the warehouse, expand it with each upgrade, and hire employees to automatically stock products during the day. Use your manager intelligent and hire the best employees. Each employee will be different from the last. You'll need to use your eagle eye to distinguish the best employees for each task, assigning each one a primary and a secondary duty. Oh, and don't forget to pay them their salary! Every day is different in Mercapolis, adapt to each day as if it were the last. Various random events will occur during the day, and you'll need to be prepared as a manager to face them. Robberies, fires, or even health inspectors issuing fines if you're not vigilant enough. Project made for the Espetos Studios in Interactive Product Design degree of U-tad, University of Technology, Arts and Design.
row.short_description: Build and manage your own supermarket. Place orders for seasonal products, stock them on the shelves, and get ready to survive a workday full of surprises. Hire employees and keep your customers happy in Mercapolis.

row.name: CrimeBloc
row.detailed_description: CrimeBloc Free-to-Play Text-Based Crime MMO Set in the Eastern Bloc Step into the shadows of the post-Soviet underworld. CrimeBloc is a gritty text-driven MMO where you rise through the ranks of organized crime in the Eastern Bloc. For over 18 years, thousands of players have forged criminal empires, fought brutal turf wars, and survived in a world where betrayal is currency. Build Your Empire. Enforce Your Will. Eliminate Your Enemies. Classic Text-Based Gameplay with Depth Experience the strategic richness of text-based gaming. Every action matters. Your rise to power depends on smart decisions, alliances, and ruthless efficiency. Persistent Online World Join an active, player-driven underworld where crime families form and fall, cities are contested, and operations span days or weeks. Every choice shapes your legacy. Extensive Criminal Activities Steal rare cars, rob banks, commit heists, or take out your rivals. With dozens of criminal options, from small street hustles to major operations! There are many paths to domination. Player vs Player Combat Challenge other players to fights, assassinate enemies, or raid their assets. Warfare in CrimeBloc is strategic, brutal, and unforgiving. Deep Progression System Train your stats, upgrade equipment, acquire properties, and unlock high-level crimes. Build a unique character to suit your criminal style. Operate Across Eastern Bloc Cities From Moscow to Odessa, each city presents different risks and opportunities. Control them, exploit them, or burn them to the ground. Player-Run Casinos and Gambling Test your luck! CrimeBloc features player-owned casinos where you can wager your in-game cash on games like slots, roulette, blackjack, video poker, and more. Become a high roller, or invest in your own casino to profit from other players' risk. Gambling is fully integrated into the economy and offers both entertainment and strategic opportunities. 100% Free to Play CrimeBloc is free to play and always has been. Success is earned through strategy, persistence, and street smarts. Whether you are a veteran of old-school browser games or a newcomer seeking something different, CrimeBloc offers a deep and uncompromising look into the digital criminal underworld. Form alliances, betray partners, and climb to the top! if you can survive the climb. The Bloc is waiting. Do you have what it takes?
row.short_description: Free-to-Play Text-Based Mafia MMO Set in the Eastern Bloc. A gritty text-based MMO where you rise through the ranks of organized crime in the Bloc. For 18 years, players have forged criminal empires, fought brutal turf wars, and survived in a world where betrayal is currency.

row.name: Cat Got Your Tongue
row.detailed_description: Cat Got Your Tongue is an old-school horror point-and-click game. And let me tell you, you'll feel what it's like to be in the wrong place at the wrong time. Turn your screen brightness to the fullest... My previous game was 'too bright,' so I decided to make this one the darkest and the gloomiest. No complicated puzzles. There are no intricate puzzles in this game, but there's intricate gameplay where you, as the player, will have to figure things out. The game is built on exploring rooms and memorizing them. Look for items and use them to avoid a deadly fate. Because, you're not alone in the house... There's something bigger and thicker living here, something more evil, and hungry... lurking in the shadows. The House Cat. Playing tag with it, you should run immediately if you don't want to end up in someone's trash.
row.short_description: Cat Got Your Tongue is a horror point-and-click game where you have to escape from the Home Cat by exploring the darkest corners of the house.

row.name: Nightmare Kart
row.detailed_description: You are a beast hunter, conscripted against your will to participate in a most peculiar local custom: a tournament where participants race atop mysterious vehicles comprised of copper and steam. Race through blood-soaked gothic streets atop one of 12 unique vehicles as you seek answers behind the origin of this nightmare. Wield powerful weapons to reduce your opponents to scrap, slaughter beasts to raise your top speed, perform tricks and drifts to generate Æther to boost, and overcome challenging boss encounters to unlock the secrets behind this terrible dream. Start your engines, the first race is about to begin. *Controller required for local multiplayer! *This is a free game, but if you want to donate, you can do so here! Ko-fi.com/lwmedia0554
row.short_description: Zoom through gothic streets in this horror themed vehicular combat racing game!

row.detailed_description: The game consists of finishing several levels, solving by clicking with the mouse or using the keyboard to complete the tasks. Classic - by clicking on a square, the others around it change inversely (cross). Do this until all the squares are 0. Pusher - with the help of the keyboard, press the key indicated on the screen, until the matrix is ​​completely finished. row.name: Parts of the Elephant
row.detailed_description: Parts of the Elephant is a short and moody visual novel where you decide which threads to follow as the world keeps moving around you. Explore the liminal space of a creepy hotel, find interesting strangers, and learn lessons vicariously through the brief glimpses of their lives that you can peer into - or just make an ass out of yourself until you pass out drunk in someone's bed. Tonight is a dark puddle for you to play around in, and no-one's going to care about the mess until the harsh light of tomorrow comes.

row.name: Bomber Royale
row.detailed_description: This tiny game provides a short retro arcade experience. Gameplay In each short game that lasts a few minutes, the player picks a character, each with their unique character ability, the goal is to destroy the enemies and become the last one standing! The player is able to place bombs to destroy obstacles and damage their enemies, pick up power-ups to enhance their character and items to hinder their enemies. Control Move - WASD (Keyboard) & Left Joystick (Xbox Controller) Place Bomb - J (Keyboard) & X (Xbox Controller) Push Bomb - K (Keyboard) & A (Xbox Controller) Character Ability - L (Keyboard) & B (Xbox Controller) Use Items - U, I, O (Keyboard) & LB, Y, RB (Xbox Controller) Multiplayer Plug in one Keyboard and one Xbox Controller or two Xbox Controllers to enjoy a local two-player game！
row.short_description: A retro arcade experience.

row.name: 佛兰德斯的狗 A Dog of Flanders Playtest
The Aching Aversion
row.detailed_description: A 3D RPGMaker Horror game about exploring a weird bunker. The bunker will have different horrors or surreal worlds waiting within it, all depending on how you broke into it! 6 different bunkers! 16 unique endings! Collect all of the endings, and explore all of the bunkers to figure out how to reach the final bunker... Atmospheric audio and a unique 3D art style come together to create an experience you will remember! A continuation of The Aching Aversion: Blood Orange Dreams... 'Everyone has seen it at some point, we all have an aversion to it, the bunker has invaded your mind at some point in your life. No one has ever entered it... And if the inside has never been seen, how can one be so sure that the inside really exists. Whether it is a safe room, an armoured bunker, a torture dungeon or just empty space depends on the 'input details' of the entrant. No one can try to enter what they have an aversion to.' 7 Steam achievements to unlock.
row.short_description: A 3D RPGMaker Horror game about exploring a weird bunker. The bunker will have different horrors or surreal worlds waiting within it, all depending on how you broke into it! 6 different bunkers! 16 unique endings!
row.notes: This game contains gore, horror, suicide and violence.

Find a group and take down the wild beasts, create equipment to aid your progress. One of the most interesting features is that you can equip wings, runes, Mounts and other special items. which can be upgraded over dozens of levels, with each level improving both your character's appearance and stats. - You will be able to explore the mapping and talk to other players. - Play the dungeons and collect Items to access the Creation of equipment and medicines - Rune system - Mining system - Equipment system - Skin System - Wing System - Mounting system
row.short_description: Legends Resurrected Online It is a Free MMORPG with a classic 2D style. Explore and discover the wide variety of weapons and items you can obtain. Find a group and take down the wild beasts, create equipment to aid your progress.

row.name: 鑽石俱樂部-皇家尊爵
row.detailed_description: 歡迎來到《鑽石俱樂部-皇家尊爵》！ 除了感受到無比的奢華氣氛之外，當然就是讓玩家流連忘返的各種休閒娛樂平台囉！ 每個設施都有需要注意的還有遵守的規則，玩家可自由選擇其中一類設施進行娛樂。 除了真實呈現娛樂的過程外，也會有許多不一樣的特色讓您體驗絕佳的感受！ 休閒娛樂平台 分別由「麻將區」、「撲克區」、「機台區」組成。 目前為各位開放「台灣正宗十六張麻將」、「德州撲克」，以及「水果盤」。 當然，還有更多的遊戲，即將陸續開放給各位玩家唷！ 全新VIP系統 當玩家滿足特定條件後，可提升【VIP會員階級】，獲得會員服務升等或開啟特定功能。 ◆一般會員：新註冊的貴賓，VIP等級為一般會員。 ◆普級會員：玩家完成首儲後，立即升級為普級會員。 ◆玩家後續達到指定儲值額後，可再往上升級為青銅、白銀、黃金、鑽石會員。 我的收集冊 相信各位的道具欄中都有著許多撲克牌，最近更多了刮刮卡以及勳章等物品。 別懷疑！這就是《鑽石俱樂部-皇家尊爵》所獨有的「我的收集冊」功能！ 現在，各位的撲克牌以及許多收集物品，都能夠置放進專屬的「我的收集冊」並能獲得獎勵。 有收集癖的你(妳)，快來瘋狂收集吧！ 公會（俱樂部）評鑑機制 「一日俱樂部，終身俱樂部」，這樣的口號想必未來非常的會令會員們認同喔！ 因為每個俱樂部未來都將接受嚴苛…不對，是未來都將接受評鑑系統評分。 依照所屬的俱樂部人數、上線時間、參與度、以及公會比賽時的表現，將作為評鑑的依歸喔！ 當俱樂部每週達成評鑑的時候，獎勵就要爆發囉！ 想知道究竟評鑑系統葫蘆裡賣什麼藥嗎？我們一起看下去吧！ 想要贏得遊戲，笑迎人生？現在就來《鑽石俱樂部-皇家尊爵》吧！
row.short_description: 歡迎來到《鑽石俱樂部-皇家尊爵》！　　　　　　　感受無比的奢華氣氛，體驗流連忘返的休閒娛樂。　在這裡讓你贏的是遊戲，笑的是人生！

row.name: Spark
row.detailed_description: Spark is an adventure-puzzle game that encourages selflessness and provokes thoughtful problem solving. You are Spark, an animated and bright bundle of energy. Through exploring an electronic maze in the depths of a computer, you come to understand your purpose in life of bringing connection, vitality, and exuberance to those around you. By connecting components, solving puzzles, and powering your world, you find purpose through selfless action and dedication to a larger goal. Spark: Virtue Through Voltage. Plug in conductors to unlock progression throughout the stages! Manipulate switches to power your objectives. Connect batteries to their sockets to unlock new gameplay possibilities. Play through three different levels, along with a tutorial to show you the ropes. Uncover a mysterious story that reveals your greater purpose as Spark.
row.short_description: You are Spark, an animated and bright bundle of energy. Through exploring an electronic maze in the depths of a computer, you come to understand your purpose in life of bringing connection, vitality, and exuberance to those around you. Spark: Virtue Through Voltage.

row.name: 2.5 DIMENSIONAL SEDUCTION: Angels on Stage!
row.detailed_description: The anime '2.5 Dimensional Seduction' debuts its first game! Get your cameras ready for the cosplay battle RPG '2.5 Dimensional Seduction: Angels on Stage!' STORY '2.5 Dimensional Seduction' follows Masamune Okumura, a high schooler in love with the fictional character Liliel, and Ririsa Amano, a new student who dreams of becoming the said character. After Ririsa asks Okumura to help her achieve her dream, he's roped into becoming the cameraman for her Liliel cosplays! As the two work together, they experience the fires of passion within cosplayers and learn from their trials and tribulations. The lines between reality (3D) and fiction (2D) blur in this hot-blooded cosplay drama! CHARACTERS ■ Masamune Okumura (VA: Junya Enoki) A second-year high schooler and leader of the Manga Club, he is a proud otaku. He has long loved the fictional character Liliel and calls her his 'waifu.' After Ririsa joins the Manga Club, he becomes her cosplay cameraman. ■ Ririsa Amano (VA: Kaori Maeda) A freshman otaku obsessed with manga and anime. She's especially into the outfits girls wear in fiction. After attending her first event in junior high, she decided to express her love for Liliel through cosplay. Ririsa's cosplay is so top-level it astounded the Liliel-maniac Okumura. ■ Mikari Tachibana (VA: Akari Kitō) Ririsa's classmate and ultra-popular fashion model. She's adoringly called 'Mikarin' by her fans. As a childhood friend of Okumura, she's been in love with him for 10 years. But unfortunately, due to his infatuation with 2D, her feelings are unnoticed. ■ Mayuri Hanyuu (VA: M.A.O) The new Home Economics teacher at Okumura's high school. She is popular among the students for being drop-dead gorgeous and easy to talk to. Her identity back in college is 'Mayura,' one of the Four Heavenly Queens of Cosplay. GAME FEATURES - Strike a pose in this fresh, new cosplay battle! Charm your rival cosplayers and audience with stunning poses! Impress your way to victory! Your options range from familiar poses, to brand new ones! There're even group shoots...! And don't miss out on special poses with over-the-top effects! - Raise a character's bond level and learn new things about them! Spend time with your favorite character and deepen your relationship! - Relive the world of '2.5 Dimensional Seduction' in-game! Follow the story of Okumura and Ririsa through top-quality 3D Graphics, animated cutscenes, and a main story fully voiced by the Japanese cast! - Experience the never-before-seen '2.5 Dimensional Emotion (Mayuri)'! From her love for Lustalotte, to how she became a cosplayer, there's more to learn about Mayuri. Read her origin story in this game-exclusive spin-off! - Live the otaku life through club activities! AFK to obtain materials that level up your beautiful cosplayers to then tackle quests and challenges! - Enjoy 'Angels on Stage' characters and the extravagant voice cast! Masamune Okumura (VA: Junya Enoki) Ririsa Amano (VA: Kaori Maeda) Mikari Tachibana (VA: Akari Kitō) Nonoa (VA: Sayumi Suzushiro) Aria Kisaki (VA: Sayumi Watabe) Nagomi (VA: Aya Yamane) Mayuri Hanyuu (VA: M.A.O) Magino (VA: Yuka Nukui) Ogino (VA: Tomokazu Sugita) and more!!

Obtain materials, level up your beautiful cosplayers, and deepen your bond with them! Now, shine out your best with your angels on stage!

[Nightmare Files] Clap Clap
row.detailed_description: WISHLIST THE NEXT GAME IN THE NIGHTMARE FILES SERIES! About the Game You see a newspaper ad about a house-sitting job. Since you're short on money, you decide to sign up. What awaits you... Did I mention that the house you'll be staying at has the latest home automation systems of the 80s!? Now you know! Simply clap twice in any room in the house to toggle the lights on/off. We sure are lucky that there are no entities around that can take advantage of this. Immerse yourself in the environment with amnesia-like physical interactions, volumetric audio and PS1 style graphics. It ain't much, but it's honest work. I suggest you don't go snooping around too much, it's for your own good.
row.short_description: Clap Clap is a short indie horror game that puts you in the shoes of a house sitter, experiencing strange occurrences in a seemingly ordinary home.

row.name: Moonray: Battle Lands
row.detailed_description: Enter the surreal battlegrounds of Moonray, a free-to-play third-person PvP battle arena set in a breathtaking science fantasy world. In this skill-based combat experience, you'll fight to win the favor of the gods across floating islands and impossible architecture, where only the most skilled warriors will claim victory. MASTER THE ART OF COMBAT Moonray's combat system rewards skill, strategy, and quick reflexes. Choose your fighting style from an arsenal of unique weapons, each with distinct advantages and combo potential: Agile Sabre : Strike with lightning speed, chaining fluid combos that leave opponents struggling to counter Powerful Cleaver : Deliver devastating blows that can turn the tide of battle in a single, well-timed strike Precision Blaster : Pick off enemies from a distance with accurate shots that disrupt their strategies Explosive Cannon : Control the battlefield with area-of-effect damage that can catch multiple opponents in its blast Master the timing-based combo system that rewards practice and precision. Learn to balance offensive aggression with defensive counters, creating a combat dance where every move matters and split-second decisions determine victory or defeat. DOMINATE THE VERTICAL BATTLEFIELD The grappling hook is your key to battlefield dominance in Moonray. This versatile tool transforms how you approach combat: Quickly escape dangerous situations when outnumbered Close the distance on ranged opponents for devastating melee attacks Access strategic vantage points for battlefield control Surprise enemies with unexpected angles of attack Create your own combat style by mastering vertical movement The most feared warriors in Moonray aren't just skilled with their weapons—they're masters of movement, using the grappling hook to outmaneuver and outthink their opponents. COMPETE ACROSS MULTIPLE GAME MODES Test your skills in a variety of challenging game modes designed to showcase different aspects of combat mastery: Deathmatch (8-Player) : Every warrior for themselves in a chaotic free-for-all where only the strongest survive Team Deathmatch (4v4) : Join forces with allies to outfight and outwit the opposing team Objective-Based Modes : Capture strategic points and complete tactical goals while fending off enemy attacks Duel Mode (1v1) : The purest test of skill—face a single opponent with nowhere to hide and no one to rely on but yourself Each mode offers a unique challenge, requiring you to adapt your strategies and master different aspects of Moonray's combat system. BATTLE IN SURREAL, DYNAMIC ARENAS The environment itself can be your greatest ally or deadliest enemy. Use explosive barrels to create chaos, navigate collapsing bridges that change the battlefield mid-fight, and adapt to dynamic obstacles that force constant tactical reassessment. PROGRESS AND CUSTOMIZE Your journey in Moonray is one of constant growth and personalization: Advance through a rewarding level-based progression system Unlock powerful new weapons with unique combat characteristics Customize your warrior with distinctive character skins Express your personal style with a variety of cosmetic items Climb the competitive leaderboards to prove your mastery Every match brings you closer to new options for customization and combat, ensuring that your experience in Moonray continues to evolve as you play. IMMERSE YOURSELF IN A STUNNING WORLD Moonray's visual and audio design creates an unforgettable sensory experience: Explore otherworldly landscapes with impossible architecture and surreal beauty Witness breathtaking lighting effects that enhance the dreamlike atmosphere Experience the impact of combat through responsive visual feedback and particle effects Lose yourself in the electronic-orchestral hybrid soundtrack that dynamically responds to the action Feel every blow through impactful sound design that gives weight to each combat encounter The post-human world of Moonray is unlike anything you've experienced before—a vibrant, surreal battleground where the ruins of a once-thriving civilization provide the stage for your combat prowess. JOIN THE FIGHT Moonray is constantly evolving, with regular updates bringing new content and refinements to the experience. Currently in alpha stage, the game is expanding to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, and Mobile, with cross-platform play planned to unite warriors across all systems. Will you rise to the challenge? The gods are watching, and only the most skilled combatants will earn their favor. Enter the arena, master your weapons, and claim your place among the legends of Moonray. SKILL-BASED COMBAT SYSTEM Master Moonray's deep combat mechanics that reward practice and precision. Chain devastating combos, time your defensive counters perfectly, and develop your own fighting style with a variety of weapons that offer distinct advantages and playstyles. REVOLUTIONARY GRAPPLING HOOK MOVEMENT Dominate the vertical battlefield with the grappling hook, a game-changing tool that lets you quickly escape danger, close distance on enemies, access strategic vantage points, and create unexpected angles of attack that will keep your opponents guessing. DIVERSE GAME MODES Test your skills across multiple challenging formats including chaotic 8-player Deathmatches, strategic 4v4 Team battles, objective-based competitions, and intense 1v1 Duels that showcase pure combat mastery. SURREAL, DYNAMIC ARENAS Fight across meticulously designed maps featuring floating islands, impossible architecture, and interactive elements that change mid-battle. Use the environment to your advantage with explosive hazards, collapsing bridges, and strategic choke points. PROGRESSION AND CUSTOMIZATION Advance through a rewarding level-based system that unlocks powerful new weapons, distinctive character skins, and various cosmetic items. Express your personal style while expanding your combat options with each match you play. BREATHTAKING AUDIOVISUAL EXPERIENCE Immerse yourself in Moonray's stunning post-apocalyptic world featuring vibrant colors, dramatic lighting, and otherworldly landscapes. Experience the impact of combat through responsive visual feedback and a dynamic electronic-orchestral soundtrack. EXPANDING UNIVERSE Currently in alpha stage with regular updates bringing new content and refinements. Expanding to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, and Mobile with cross-platform play planned to unite warriors across all systems.
row.short_description: Enter the battlegrounds of Moonray, a free-to-play third-person PvP battle arena set in a breathtaking world. In this skill-based combat experience, you'll fight to win the favor of the gods across floating islands and impossible architecture, where only the most skilled warriors will claim victory.

row.name: Boneless
row.detailed_description: Boneless is an experimental Virtual Reality physics sandbox game built to test the limits of what's possible in VR. The game features unique maps, unique weapons, such as guns and swords and multiple enemies. Guns: Pistol (With attachments) Revolver Shotgun UZI MP5 (with attachments) Rifle (with attachments) Heavy Rifle (with attachments The different weapons can be spawned using the UI: There are three different maps, each with a day and night variation. These include: Arena: Court: City: You can engage in hand to hand or ranged combat with enemies. Or both! The game also features two handed guns with scopes such as rifles. There are many melee weapons including a two handed katana. The game also features a parkour course with a zipline in the warehouse map. There is also an external camera for video recording.
row.short_description: Boneless is an experimental Virtual Reality physics sandbox game built to test the limits of what's possible in VR. The game features unique maps, unique weapons, such as guns and swords and multiple enemies.

row.name: Lovebugz: An Anthro Insect Dating Sim
row.detailed_description: Don't be afraid. These bug girls aren't here to hurt you (most of them, anyway). You're a human garbage man, but one fateful morning you accidentally ask a giant housefly out on a date. Play through a handful of bite-sized dates in this chapter-based visual novel world with point and click exploration elements. Use point and click mechanics to explore an island, room by room, talking to an assorted cast of different bugs and humans (and crabs). Date a handful of different bug girls, learn how they live their lives, and help them with their problems. Choose from different choices that may determine how the date goes. Play through a chapter-based storyline. New chapters will be released in the future. A cute, cartoony art style. Collectable candies!
row.short_description: A point and click visual novel about bug girls.

row.name: Where are We?
row.detailed_description: Trapped in an unknown space for unknown reasons, the two adventurers must now turn their teamwork for finding treasure into one for survival and escape! Will adventurers escape from the unknown space and get treasure again? Where We Are is a multi-play puzzle game set in a mysterious incident that happened to two adventurers who found the treasure. Two players become two adventurers and share the information given to each other to solve a puzzle to find out where they are and why they came here. This game requires clear communication and communication skills to deliver all the information through the microphone by voice. Enjoy interesting puzzles with a real-life escape experience! This game requires both players to have a working PC-compatible microphone. Our game is inspired by We were Here Series.

row.name: 箱庭小駅伝2
row.detailed_description: あなたのPCの中に箱庭駅伝狂会ができて、高校は年2回、大学は年3回の駅伝大会を開催するようになります。 箱庭感覚の駅伝シミュレーションゲームです。 各高校15人、1741高校で計26115名の選手と、各大学40人、40大学で計1600名の選手が駅伝大会出場、さらには駅伝界の頂点を目指して練習に励んでいます。 あなたはどん底の状態にある大学と高校の駅伝チームの監督を兼務しチームを運営します。 高校の主なイベントは以下のとおりです。 4月　新入生が入ってきます。 7月下旬　全国高校体育大会1500m 8月上旬　全国高校体育大会5000m 10月下旬　全国高校駅伝都道府県予選 11月下旬　駅伝地区大会 12月下旬　全国高校駅伝 3月中旬　春の高校居間駅伝 大学の主なイベントは以下のとおりです。 4月　新入生が入ってきます(高校3年生8705名の中から選手獲得可能、また、あなたが監督している高校の選手は優先的に選択できます)。 5月　陸上トラック5000ｍ、10000ｍ、ハーフマラソンの大会が行われます。 6月　「11月駅伝」の予選会が行われます。 8月　夏合宿が行われます。夏合宿は能力を大きく伸ばすチャンスです。 10月　「10月駅伝」が行われます。また、「正月駅伝」の予選会も行われます。 11月　「11月駅伝」が行われます。 1月　「正月駅伝」が行われます。 3月　「学生ハーフ」ハーフマラソン大会が行われます。 駅伝界の頂点を目指してもよいですし、目指さなくてもよいですし、ただ記録を眺めているだけでもよいですし、 お好きなプレイスタイルでご自身のペースでお楽しみください。
row.short_description: 箱庭感覚の駅伝シミュレーションゲームの第二弾、高校駅伝も加わりました！

row.detailed_description: Customers... Don't let them find out... Rip-off! A thrilling rip-off adventure where if the customers find out, you'll explode!
