The player will need to go from island to island combating enemies to strengthen themselves for the lower levels. The game continuously gets more difficult the further down you go. Incorporate a twitch stream into your game to spice things up! Through multiple chat commands the twitch chat can inflict harm or grant aid to the player.
row.short_description: Archipelago is a fast paced movement roguelike set on a cluster of floating islands. Slash, slice, and dash your way through the sky to challenge the final boss. Will skill alone allow you to prevail?

row.name: Siren's Call: Escape Velocity - Prologue
row.detailed_description: Inspired by games like Persona 4, Higurashi, and Doki Doki Literature Club, Siren’s Call: Escape Velocity is a tropical cocktail of delicious summertime dread. As a story that begins at the end, all that's standing between you and adulthood are your old party members. Your best friends. After a summer of deadly fights with supernatural creatures known only as 'Sirens,' you and your friends finally have time to relax and enjoy yourselves. But in the wreckage of a job well done...it's become obvious just how fleeting their time with you actually is. Even so, it's your job to say goodbye to each of them and go to college. It's your job to be an adult. Still, it's five of them versus one of you. And after years of friendship and an entire summer of fighting side-by-side, these people know exactly what it takes to make you want to stay home...for just a bit longer. A game that's designed to make you as unsure of yourself as humanly possible, Siren's Call takes full advantage of every aspect of the visual novel format to deliver a mind-warping storytelling experience. Can you get the 'Hell' out of Florida? Will you reach Escape Velocity?
row.short_description: Welcome to your endless summer! Escape its influence before the town of Siren's Call erases you completely. This version of the game is a free prologue and covers the first part of this story.
row.reviews: “The early '10s-teenage-summer-beach atmosphere and the amazing soundtrack create the perfect setting for the themes of friendship, love, growing up and moving on. In general, I am a huge fan of the whole 'cute things turn scary' trope, but please understand that this game is so much more than that. I don't mean to compare, but if you're a fan of DDLC, you'll most likely enjoy Siren's Call.” Recommended – Zee-o “This is, hands down, one of the best visual novel experiences I have ever been through, if not the best. You absolutely will not know what you are about to witness when you play this. Every character feels alive. You will grow to care about every one of them, especially the main character[..]Everything in this game is treated about how it should be in real life, making for a realistic experience that really sits with you.” Recommended – Casca “Siren’s Call: Escape Velocity is a thoughtful coming-of-age story wrapped in a slow-burn mystery that artfully tackles its themes and cleverly takes advantage of the possibilities of the visual novel medium. Come for the thrill and atmosphere and stay for the heart.” 9/10 – Nook Gaming
row.notes: emotional shutdowns and/or meltdowns relating to an autism spectrum disorder

row.name: さいこねえとデスゲーム
row.detailed_description: Collect banknotes to survive. Deposit 100 million yen into the ATM to survive. Avoid dangers such as TVs that will kill you if you are seen and dangerous floating objects. Explore while avoiding yellow panels. The sisters, who have decided to participate in the death game, are wearing the latest collars with built-in sensors around their necks. If the sensor reacts to danger, it goes bang. It's game over. The floor of the death game venue is a collection of panels. White is a safe zone that does not change color, but is within the range of the sensor. Green is a panel that changes to yellow, where safety and danger are mixed. Panels directly above a floating object will change to yellow. Yellow panels are dangerous. Even the slightest hesitation will kill you. This work was created using Unity.

row.name: Apples And Bananas
row.detailed_description: Hey there! I am Sam, CEO of Piggle Studios. I am 13 years old and have been a game developer since I was 9. Welcome to the whimsical world of 'Apples and Bananas'! Dive into a charming adventure set on Fruit Island, home to various fruit nations and kingdoms. When the mischievous Dr. Banana brainwashes his banana followers to declare war on the peaceful Apple Nation, it's up to Jack the Apple to save the day! With engaging gameplay and fun mechanics, embark on a quest to stop Dr. Banana's evil plans and restore harmony to Fruit Island! Embark on an epic journey filled with humor, action, and fruit-themed fun in 'Apples and Bananas'! Will you be able to save Fruit Island from chaos and restore harmony between apples and bananas ?

row.name: Black Screen
row.detailed_description: This game does not imply a certain way of interaction. You are free to come up with your own method of playing. Whatever you do or press, nothing unusual will happen. *** FROM WALKING SIMULATORS AND NOT GAMES TO BLACK SCREEN A new kind of entertaining Action/RPG When the habit of consciousness to see the embodiment of rules, goals, victories and defeats in computer games disappears, then we will only see a pure, gameplay work of art. I transformed myself with zero incentives and fished myself out of the whirlpool of rubbish of the Computer Games Industry. I destroyed the horizon ring of invisible walls, and left the circle of conventions, from the boundaries of the world in which the game designer and gaming foundations are contained. This damned ring, revealing more and more new things, leads the designer from the goal to death. And only the cowardly consciousness and the paucity of creative forces in the designer succumb to deception and set their games on the rules, fearing to lose the foundation on which the animal and the industry based their games. Making laws, challenges and punishments is like shackling your feet. Only stupid and powerless designers cover their templates with sincerity. Games need truth , but not sincerity. Conventions have disappeared like smoke for a new culture, and the game moves towards the self-goal of creativity, towards mastery over limitations. Animal games and its principles The animal was the first to lay down the principle of the game. Animals, including humans, have been playing for as long as they have existed. Games take on a competitive nature to help them survive by developing skills and social connections. In order for the game to be fair and productive, rules arise. Thus, play is a principle, an instinct inherent in animals. The original scheme of the animal was the framework on which generations hung more and more new discoveries that they found in their animal nature. And the scheme became more and more complicated and reached its peak at the birth of arcades, platformers, RPGs and shooters. The developers of these periods wrote the game in its full form, both external and internal. The game was assembled, and its internal state was expressed. But despite their enormous skill, they still did not complete the idea of the animal: Indulging instincts in code. And it is a mistake to believe that their time was the brightest flowering in media and that the younger generation needs to strive for this ideal at all costs. This idea is false. It draws young forces away from the modern flow of life, thereby disfiguring them. Their bodies fly on airplanes, and art and life are covered with old robes. Therefore, they cannot notice the new beauty in our modern life. For they live on the beauty of past decades. That's why Walking Simulators, Simulators of poor stones, Experimental games, Art games, Not games and Black Screen were incomprehensible. These designers threw off the robes of the past and stepped out into modern life and found new beauties. And I say: That no industry dungeons can withstand the coming time. Concepts move and are born, and we make new and new discoveries. And what is open by us cannot be closed. And it is absurd to force our time into the old concepts of the past. The technical side of our time is moving further and further forward, and games are trying to move further and further back. That is why all those people who follow their time are higher, greater and more valuable. Fig garden Our time of the 21st century is multifaceted, many conflicting truths are being fought. A shopping area is imagined, where the crowd looks like collectible figurines that have come out of gaming stores onto the street of experimentalism. They laugh, they are indignant, they are surprised that everything is no longer similar, entertaining. And they rejoice when they see old games, franchises, posters, art books, retro console cartridges, keychains, gamepads or joysticks. At the head of the junk square are experienced sellers-authorities, offering high-quality goods, skillfully woven with aesthetics, taste and fun. And others said more simply: «Pure entertainment and nothing more.» Young people flock to these sales festivals. Covering their heads with a philistine cap, young people flaunt themselves on holidays in the garden of industry genres! And the maestros are happy, because the tombstone was erected on modern young souls. Walks were taken with young people through the garden of industry. Action, immersion, fun, fantasy, replayability — everything was here and seemed brilliant. The cessation of pain seemed like joy, in countless transverse plexuses the nodes of the branches of the skill tree converged, but the authorities immediately tried to dispel this impression and explain that under the muslin of design everything comes out differently — «diversity». And it was no longer a meagerness of thoughts, but a «variety of mechanics»; the whole garden of the industry was obsessed with the number of game elements. There were quests, leaderboards, countdowns, rewards, experience bars, victories, defeats and many others. But where it was no longer possible to hide and the stereotypes overstepped their boundaries, the authorities covered up this debauchery with the fig leaves of graphics. The entire fig garden of the gaming industry was guarded so that the uglies would not penetrate its fence, tear off the fig leaves and destroy the beauty of the garden. The youth fell asleep in fragrant graphic well-being, and only the elders stayed awake, protecting them from evil trends. But one fine day a comet appeared on the horizon, the noise and the whirlwind came to the elders, everything trembled from their whirlwind, the tail of the comet — the Screen — swept away, knocking down all the trinkets of the old foundations. ABANDON THE SUITCASES OF WISDOM We are the generation of the 21st century — the result of the old and the page of a new book, the credit of time opened to us, we have completed a volume of 6 decades, and a new book of old, outdated foundations has been added to our archive library. There, a wise archaeologist will hide it from time, because time does not tolerate traces of its crime and sooner or later eats them. We divide time with a sharp edge and put on the first page a plane in the form of a Screen, black as a secret, the plane looks at us dark, as if hiding new pages of the future. It will be the seal of our time, on whatever and wherever it is launched, it will not lose its face. I say to EVERYONE : abandon the foundations, abandon aestheticism, abandon playability, abandon the suitcases of wisdom, because in the new culture your wisdom is ridiculous and insignificant. I untied the knots of wisdom and freed the consciousness of graphics. Quickly take off the rough skin of decades, so that it will be easier for you to catch up with me. I overcame the impossible and made abysses with my breath. You are in the nets of the horizon, like fish! I throw your way. Hurry up! — Because tomorrow you won’t recognize me. ***

row.name: I Wanna Be A Game Dev!
row.detailed_description: Graduation is coming. In other words, everything that makes your life great is about to disappear. But that won't stop you from making the most of senior year! Does that mean making new friends (or lovers)? Buckling down on your passion project? Just chilling out? You decide! Features 15-20 hours of story content! Choose what to do after school, whether that be playing arcade games, hanging out at the maid cafe, or deepening relationships with your classmates! Put your dev skills to the test with a variety of minigames and trivia questions! A fully explorable world! Characters Amelia Lee - The perfect student, who can figure out anything except 'what kids are into these days.' Britney Summers - A lazy class clown who's only made it this far through sheer luck. Chloe Suzuki - The level-headed girl who keeps everyone on track--or so she wants people to think. Daniel Harrington - Son of the school principal, and he won't let you forget it. And many more!
row.short_description: Live out your school days as you navigate the rocky world of game development! Can you make an amazing game, or will something get in the way?

row.name: Lifting Unlimited
row.detailed_description: This is Lifting Unlimited, a fun, engaging, powerlifting simulator. Your goal? Become the Strongest Person in the World. Lifting Unlimited involves training and progressing in the three powerlifting lifts, the squat, the bench press, and the deadlift. Immerse yourself in the world of powerlifting! Lifting Unlimited’s realistic weightlifting progression patterns make it a challenge to discover the most efficient way to make progress in each lift. But be wary of large weight jumps which risk an injury! Keep your nutrition up by drinking frequent protein shakes to ensure you continue progressing. Once you are sufficiently strong, you can compete in Local, State, National, and International Competitions, attempting to score the highest total in the three lifts. Your placement in these differing levels of competition earns coins that can be used to customize your character's appearance. Start your weightlifting journey with Lifting Unlimited!
row.short_description: Lifting Unlimited is a fun, fast-paced, strategic lifting game. Train in the Bench Press, Squat, and Deadlift to increase your total through difficult progression. Compete in state, national, and international competitions to set Earth-shattering Records! Start your weightlifting journey today!

row.name: Sadball

Meet Strange Pins Some pins are different... Perform Expressive Stunts Explore with style! Go for a Strike! Can you play a perfect game? More Info Polished support for keyboard and controller! Learn hundreds of tricks with an in-game discovery system! Explore 48 open ended levels! Eat ten different fruit, each with a unique effect! Deep momentum-based combat with a dual parry system! Fast, expressive movement with support for speedrunning! An accessible learning curve! Uncover a rich, atmospheric narrative that doesn't interrupt gameplay!
row.short_description: Chase pins as a bowling ball with dreamlike abilities in a surreal bowling alley.

row.name: Oedoshigusa
row.detailed_description: You are a kunoichi who sneaked into Oedojou. If you think it's not Japan, turn back. If you think it's Japan, don't turn back. Escape from patrolling soldiers. 'Oedoshigusa' is a short stealth walking simulation in which the player proceeds while judging what seems to be Japanese culture, Japanese culture is a short stealth walking simulator. The 'Japanese culture' is based on the author's own prejudice and mood at the time of creation. It is a so-called '8 like' game and has nothing to do with 'Exit 8'. ■Play time 10 to 20 minutes Video distribution guideline You can distribute the video without permission. row.name: AbraTabia Kingdom
row.detailed_description: AbraTabia is a magical adventure game where you can build and defend your own kingdom. Grow your citizen population while managing food, gold and resources. Upgrade buildings and research technologies to enhance your soldiers and player character. Army battles with siege weapons and more. Dramatic open field battles, with up to 300 soldiers on each side. 25 graphical monsters, 9 types of animals for cattle and hunting. 5 types of realistic siege weapons to destroy enemy walls. Dramatic spell effects, and unique player spells. Includes over 100 cutscenes with full audio, lip sync and dynamic camera angles. Your kingdom's development is built on a storyline system where each page of the story is a short, skippable cutscene and a task assigned to each. Tasks include unlocking buildings, quests, and various battles. You continue to play the game by managing citizen growth, building and research upgrades, flying around your kingdom doing quests, mini games and defending against monster attacks. - 12 special buildings, 45 player chosen buildings, and 12 research trees. - Your Queen is the main character with the most powerful magic and evolution over time. - Daily quests, battles and mini games. Magical monster attacks and fights. - Upgrading buildings and research will increase your soldier and player strength and abilities. There is a primary attack spell that is the core of magical fighting, named Magical Beam. This spell shoots out like a projectile, which requires aiming. Most other spells have a cooldown and instantly hit their targets or cause an AOE effect, but magical beam shoots out like a yoyo / boomerang, and requires real aim. The beam also 'connects' with other beams in various situations, where both beams meet in the middle, creating a Spell Lock. Then each player uses a slider to move the beam towards the other player by being closest to the slider's target value. New Chapters with more story and activities will be released over time. Around one chapter every 1-2 months is the goal. Chapters have 12-20 tasks in them each. Game will be released with the first 4 chapters. Storyline Roadmap - Chapter 1 lays the base story and is mostly cutscenes unlocking primary buildings and introducing you to the game characters. - Chapters 2-5 is unlocking buildings and quests, with some of monster fights to introduce combat to the player. - Chapters up to 20 'planned' and in testing but not listed to comply with Steam rules. Regular content updates planned.
row.short_description: AbraTabia is a magical adventure game where you can build and defend your own kingdom . Grow your citizen population while managing food, gold and resources. Upgrade buildings and research technologies to enhance your soldiers and player character. Army battles with siege weapons and more.

row.name: Nightmare House: The Original Mod
row.detailed_description: Enter the haunting world of Nightmare House. This is the definitive edition of the highly acclaimed horror classic 'Nightmare House 2'. Initially released in 2010 as a Source mod for Half-Life 2, the Nightmare House series captivated players with its intense atmosphere and gripping gameplay. After fighting your way through an abandoned house, you wake up in the teared down, ironically named hospital ‘Never Lose Hope’. As you navigate these eerie halls, encounter terrors and enemies, team up with otherworldly allies and try to survive the unending hordes of horrors coming your way. If you manage to pull through, you might finally escape. Key Features The Full Package: Combining the original “Nightmare House 1”, its sequel “Nightmare House 2”, and “The Lost Files” into one accessible complete game. For free. Legacy of Horror: An old school horror game that became a cult classic. Rather than cowering from the terrors, fight back against the jump-scares. If you've yet to experience classic Source horror - this is probably the best way to begin. Lost And Confused: You are trapped in Nightmare House, with a haunting ghost following your every step. She’s out to get you, but you must get out of here. Never Lose Hope. Auto Scare System: Engineered to catch you off-guard, this system delivers dynamic scares to ensure you're never truly safe.
row.short_description: Wake up, it’s time for the real nightmare to begin. Make your way through a terrorizing house, uncover the secrets of a haunted hospital, fight through hordes of the undead, and try to escape Nightmare House.
row.notes: Zombies, blood and violence.

row.name: Neurose Neurones
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the den of madness! You wander into an abandoned factory chasing after a kitty that has run away. There you will find a family that has gone mad. And the ghosts of young people who lost their lives here... Will you be able to bring the kitty home safely? And... will you be able to get to the bottom of the ghosts' deaths and the cause of the family's madness...? This is a 3D action game and the contents are fictional. It is not related to any real person, group, or incident. game description This horror action game features a young girl who wanders into an abandoned factory in pursuit of her beloved cat, which has run away. Her goal is to avoid relentless attacks from the “Neurons Family,” the owners of the abandoned factory, and bring back her beloved cat, but that is not enough to reach the truth... There is a truth that can be revealed by saving the souls of the ghosts and defeating the family. There are four different endings. It will not be easy to see them all. In order for the weak protagonist to win over the ghosts, it is important to know where and when to perform the only action he can perform, which is to “push them away. The game's low stats, uncomfortable controls, unreasonable traps and enemies, and the inability to save will test your skills.... Distribution and live action are welcome! row.name: Off Air
row.detailed_description: Off Air is a first person shooter where the player is pitted for their life in a gameshow of scrap, lead, and views. Shoot and move your way at top speed around your robotic opposition using a wide arsenal of weapons and movement that can adapt to any scenario. Smile big for the camera as you throw yourself into challenge after challenge with one goal in mind: defeat the final boss and get Off Air.
row.short_description: Jump, slide, and smash your way through an arena of blood thirsty robots in Off Air. A first person shooter where there are only two rule: Survive and Smile for the camera. Use your wits and speed and dodge around waves of enemies in an ever devolving world of chaos and lead.

row.name: One Room Nightmare
row.detailed_description: Seek the right answer amidst time's pause. You find yourself trapped in a room in an apartment. This room is home to a variety of monsters that are lurking and waiting for you. Turn on lights, open and close doors, hide in the shadows... You have many options. Identify the characteristics of the approaching enemy, manage power and time, and act appropriately. If you make the wrong choice, you will be... ■Features 1. Turn-based system Time stands still and the enemy does not act until you do. Think carefully about what you should do next. 2. Research system Observe enemy behavior to gain experience points. Use these points to unlock new information and learn countermeasures. 3. Resource Management This room power is not infinite. Keep an eye on your remaining power and avoid blackouts. ■Controls Left click: Interact Right click: Open notebook Move cursor to the edge of the screen: Move viewpoint
row.short_description: Turn-based strategy horror. Terror in a confined space. Manage your limited power and time to protect yourself from the oncoming enemies and survive until dawn.

row.name: Hell Miners
row.detailed_description: Hell Miners is an exhilarating 2D platformer roguelite, originally designed for mobile gaming, now fully optimized for PC! Master drag-and-release mechanics to scale to treacherous heights, and dodge deadly traps. As you venture through the underworld, collect gold to enhance your gear and abilities. Dodge or defeat fierce monsters as you ascend with your gold and gains. Can you survive the infernal challenges and make your grand escape from Hell? Harness the power of precision with our mobile click-and-drag mechanic, now built for PC. Strategically propel your character to eye-watering heights, navigating through treacherous obstacles with finesse. Every click counts as you aim to escape Hell, not just for survival but for all the riches that await. Climb higher, earn more scores, and secure your spot among the elite on the top 10 leaderboard. Reach for the heavens and leave your mark in Hell Miners! Prepare to face the wrath of Hell's inhabitants as you journey through the underworld. Encounter a myriad of monstrous adversaries, each with their own unique abilities and challenges. From sinister demons to relentless spectres, every foe poses a formidable threat to your escape. Adapt your strategy, hone your reflexes, and unleash your skills to overcome these nightmarish foes. Will you emerge victorious against the terrors that lurk in the depths of Hell? Gather gold as you traverse the perilous depths of Hell, unlocking a plethora of valuable items to aid in your ascent. Enhance your gear and abilities with a diverse array of upgrades, from enchanted weapons to mystical artefacts. Strengthen your defences, amplify your attacks, and unleash devastating powers upon your adversaries. With each run, amass wealth and invest wisely to bolster your chances of success. Forge your path to victory with the riches of the underworld in your grasp.
row.short_description: Hell Miners is an action-packed 2D platformer roguelite where you dodge traps, defeat monsters and collect gold to build on your arsenal of powers, all while ascending to greater heights!

row.name: Shards of Epoch Past
row.detailed_description: Shards of Epoch Past is a score-attack platformer with minimalistic gameplay and roguelike elements. Eldritch entities have invaded and destroyed your reality, and as your world falls apart all that you can do is to cling to your life for as long as you can. There is no longer any hope for survival. But maybe, just maybe, there is a way to take revenge... Features : minimalistic, survival-platformer gameplay with permadeath. Survive increasing diffuculty for as long as you can to ramp up your high score, or discover the secret to beating the game 3 secret stages, for a total of 4 eldritch gods to face 7 metoroidvania-like movement abilities to unlock in varying order, ensuring each run poses a unique challange many other collectible upgrades to fill your brain with happy progression juices infuriating randomness
row.short_description: Eldritch entities invaded and destroyed your reality! All hope is long gone! Cling to your life for as long as you can in this simple, yet addictive, free-to-play platformer with Lovecraftian themes.

row.name: Brickorium
row.detailed_description: Enter the world of Brickorium, an exhilarating rogue-lite brick-breaker game! Take on increasingly challenging waves of bricks, earn gold, and unlock a variety of bonuses to enhance your abilities. Test your reflexes in this thrilling arcade challenge where every playthrough is unique. Your objective is to build a deck of bricks with various colors and unique abilities. Strategize and customize your brick arsenal to overcome the game's original challenges.
row.short_description: Enter the world of Brickorium, an exhilarating rogue-lite brick-breaker game! Take on increasingly challenging waves of bricks, earn gold, and unlock a variety of bonuses to enhance your abilities. Test your reflexes in this thrilling arcade challenge where every playthrough is unique.

row.name: Game Builder Tycoon - Prologue
row.detailed_description: Create and sell games, gain fame and wealth, research new technologies, manage taxes and salaries, take loans if needed, and compete with 5000 companies. Experience the thrill of running your own studio in Game Builder Tycoon. Design standout games by selecting key elements like art, features, quests, dialogue, music, level, and world design. Work solo in the prologue, choose the genre, theme, platform, game size, art style, viewpoint, and features. Launch your game in the market and create sequels. Imagine a platformer game set in a sci-fi world with 2D-pixel art and multiplayer options. The possibilities for customization are endless! Choose your character and define their role—be it as a coder or an artist. Each character has three attributes: IQ, creativity, and insight, which affect six skills: tech, art, writing, design, music, and marketing. Create a unique character that fits your vision. As you progress, continuously train yourself in various ways to stay ahead in the competitive market. As your game progresses, research and unlock new elements. Discover new genres like survival or simulation, themes like zombies or pirates, devices like consoles or mobile, game sizes, art styles like semi-realistic or stylized, features like localization or tutorials, viewpoints like isometric or third-person, and marketing strategies like free demos or media advertisements. With over 60 things to unlock, the possibilities are endless to create your next hit games. Feeling unmotivated? Don't worry, you're competing with 5000 other companies. They are smart and hardworking, just like your team. Create better games and use effective marketing tactics to earn more and stay ahead. Experience advanced features including hiring systems, new offices, more unlockable features, game publisher mode, longer gameplay, and countless new explorations waiting for you in the full game.
row.short_description: Game Builder Tycoon - Prologue is a free simulation game in which you begin your journey as an indie game developer. Personalize your character, craft hit games, manage marketing and research stuff. Create best game on the planet!

row.name: Video 2 Live Wallpaper
row.detailed_description: Video 2 Live Wallpaper is a free and easy-to-use app for Windows to play/set videos as live desktop wallpapers. Simply drag a video into the app window and click 'Make Wallpaper' or press the Shift + F hotkey. That's it! Additional Features ( optional toggles ): - Image wallpapers. - Audio playback (from video). - Live spectrum visualizer -> pickup any audio playing on the computer. - Live system/hardware info -> print current CPU/GPU/memory stats. - Interactive date-time label.
row.short_description: Play/set videos as live desktop wallpapers.

row.name: Dungeons of Blood and Dream Playtest
Project: Ether
row.detailed_description: Stop Time. Be a Witch. Save the World. Project: Ether is a 30-minute vertical slice student project featuring approachable stealth mechanics, diverse story, and unique visuals. You play as Zhay, agent codename Spirit, who came back from their previous mission with a mysterious soul imbued in their prosthesis only known as The Kid. Explore the mysterious UAD research labs and beyond with the power to enter the Ether dimension with the help of your COVEN witches, Haumea and Bari. Will Spirit find out the mysteries of COVEN and UAD? Can they save the world against the nefarious General Bryant and his unstoppable Guard Bots? Approachable Stealth Light and Darkness Are Binary. Tap into the Ether dimension to stop time, see through walls, and see more information. Use Hex projectiles to distract enemies or shutdown cameras- manipulate the environment to your will. Accessibility: Features full keyboard and mouse controls rebinding & high-contrast mode. Diverse story Featuring an all-trans, all-POC cast of characters- fully voice-acted by our all-POC and queer voice cast! Heavy Narrative Focus About Found Family. Solve narrative puzzles in Detective Segments. Unique Visuals Features anime-inspired, cel-shaded visuals; a departure from other realistic, gritty stealth games. Visual Novel segments in the beginning and end
row.short_description: Project: Ether is a magical sci-fi stealth game about trans witches fighting robots. Stop Time, Be a Witch, Save the World.

row.name: CARAMBOLA
row.detailed_description: Carambola is a VR serious game that blends immersive storytelling, puzzle-solving, and cultural education to promote cultural awareness through the stars . Designed for the Meta Quest 2 & Pro , Carambola invites players into an escape room-style experience where learning is woven naturally into gameplay. Step into a beautifully crafted virtual world where you'll explore constellations and myths from different cultures , using your acquired knowledge to solve progressively challenging puzzles. Each level is designed to enhance knowledge retention , using a mix of riddles and interactive environments to engage players on a deeper cognitive level. Carambola is built on the principle that games can teach , and VR is a powerful tool to foster immersion and understanding. As players advance, they’ll encounter puzzles inspired by real-world cultural traditions , encouraging problem-solving and critical thinking through an engaging, story-driven experience. Key Features : ✨ Immersive VR Escape Room Gameplay – Designed exclusively for Meta Quest Pro 2 , immerse yourself in an atmospheric world that encourages focus, discovery, and exploration. 🌍 Explore Cultural Constellations – Learn about mythologies and constellations from various cultures around the world. 🧩 Puzzle-Based Learning – Solve riddles and cultural puzzles that reinforce knowledge through interactive challenges. 📚 Progressive Level Design – Move from a guided tutorial room to problem-solving challenges, culminating in a deep dive into Chinese cultural astronomy . 🎓 Designed for Learning First – Education is at the heart of Carambola, using intrinsic player motivation to build cultural awareness and knowledge retention through play. Whether you're a fan of VR puzzles, educational games, or are simply curious about the stars and stories of other cultures, Carambola offers a unique experience where learning becomes an adventure . Brought to you by Team Carambola , TsungHan Yang - Creative Lead Caroline Chou - Producer/Art Director Nikhil Medanki - Gameplay Engineer Lance Mendoza - Instructional Design Researcher Collaborators: Kai Jacobs - 3D Modeler Siddharth Subramanian - U.I. Designer Mohesha Bajpai - Design Assistant Special thanks to Scott Durand for music, Vishwaas Khare for 3D assets, and Samantha Conde for research guidance.
row.short_description: A VR educational puzzle game where players explore constellations from different cultures, solve escape room-style riddles, and apply real-world knowledge to progress. Designed to promote cultural awareness through immersive, hands-on learning.

row.name: Birds Adventure
row.detailed_description: Embark on an exciting journey with Flynn, a brave bird whose peaceful life is interrupted when his son is captured. Determined to retrieve him, Flynn plunges into a dangerous quest through stunning lands fraught with peril. Fly through lush forests, cities, and dark caverns as you uncover the secrets behind the origin of the bubble threatening your family. Throughout the journey, Flynn will encounter fascinating characters, each with their own story and role to play in this tale. Get ready for a thrilling, action-packed experience where every move is crucial. Skillfully dodge approaching bubbles, collect clues as you prepare to unravel and confront what caused this chaos. *Art and music credits will be in the game.
row.short_description: Embark on an exciting journey with Flynn, a brave bird whose peaceful life is interrupted when his son is captured. Determined to retrieve him, Flynn plunges into a dangerous quest through stunning lands fraught with peril.

row.name: Rise & Fall - Online Digital Edition
row.detailed_description: Rise & Fall is a full control strategic game. Each player controls a civilization trying to expand and progress in a fantasy world. This world displays a unique landscape where glaciers live on islands and huge cliffs are common barriers and challenges to overcome. In this gorgeous land each player starts with a small tribe including a village, a citizen and a ship and will grow to a full civilization with more of the pre-mentioned units but also temples, merchants and the precious highlanders, the only ones able to pass those astonishing cliffs. Rise & Fall is a very immersive and addictive game, easy to understand, with no luck or randomness involved. The initial creation of the world by itself is a real pleasure and each game brings a different map to the table. The new players will enjoy the game for its “easy access” aspect. Since all the actions you can do are displayed on the six cards of a player’s deck, this makes the game really accessible right from the start. The more exigent strategist players will love the game for its full control aspect and the fact that the learning curve seems to be a constant line of progression.
row.short_description: Risse & Fall is a game involving strategic units positioning, territory control and opportunity seizing designed by Christophe Boelinger (Dungeon Twister, Earth Reborn, Archipelago, Living Planet...). Each player leads a nation trying to expand and progress in a fantasy world.
